66428.recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間幾乎完全被流線狀、漩渦狀排列的梭形纖維組織占滿，只剩少量造血細胞與脂肪，旁邊骨小樑增厚且邊緣不規則（新骨形成）；「流線狀纖維化加骨硬化」是纖維期骨髓纖維化的典型切片表現。
features: Dense intertrabecular fibrosis with streaming, swirling fascicles of spindle cells
Marked reduction of hematopoietic cells and fat; only rare adipocyte spaces remain
Thickened bony trabeculae with irregular contours and small marrow islands trapped within bone (osteosclerosis)
Scattered small clear spaces, likely compressed/dilated sinusoids, within the fibrotic stroma
Megakaryocytes are inconspicuous at this magnification
66428.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine section shows intertrabecular spaces almost entirely replaced by fibrous tissue composed of streaming and swirling fascicles of spindle cells. Residual hematopoiesis and fat are markedly reduced, with only scattered small clear sinusoidal spaces. The bony trabeculae are thickened with irregular contours and entrapped marrow islands, consistent with osteosclerosis. Megakaryocytes are not well assessed at this power, and reticulin/trichrome staining is needed to grade fibrosis. Findings are consistent with an advanced fibrotic stage of myelofibrosis.

ddx.dx: Secondary myelofibrosis (metastatic carcinoma, granulomatous infection, autoimmune myelofibrosis)
ddx.vs: Look for keratin-positive tumor cells, granulomas, or lymphoid aggregates without MPN-type megakaryocyte atypia, and for absent JAK2/CALR/MPL mutations.
Fibrotic foci contain spindle mast cells that are tryptase/CD117-positive with aberrant CD25, often with eosinophils.
Marrow fibrosis contains a diffuse infiltrate of evenly spaced cells with fried-egg cytoplasm that are CD20+/annexin A1+/BRAF V600E-positive, without osteosclerosis.
Fibrosis is peritrabecular with osteoclastic tunneling resorption rather than diffuse intertrabecular streaming fibrosis.

exam.answer_en: Advanced fibrotic-stage myelofibrosis — intertrabecular marrow replaced by streaming spindle-cell fibrosis with osteosclerosis
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 看到髓腔被旋渦狀梭形細胞取代，問「這是什麼、要加什麼染色」；答 myelofibrosis，加 reticulin/trichrome 分級。
Overt PMF 的 WHO 主要條件包含：巨核細胞增生與異型並伴 MF-2/3 纖維化、JAK2/CALR/MPL 或其他 clonal marker、不符合其他 myeloid neoplasm。
髓腔被纖維取代後常伴 extramedullary hematopoiesis，臨床表現為明顯脾腫大。
治療重點：JAK inhibitor（如 ruxolitinib）改善脾腫大與症狀；allo-HSCT 是目前唯一可能治癒的方式。
exam.pitfall_zh: 梭形細胞旋渦排列易被誤認為間質腫瘤或 metastatic sarcomatoid tumor；需 IHC（keratin、CD61 等）排除轉移並確認殘存巨核細胞。

quiz.q: 此 trephine 的髓腔主要被什麼取代？確認纖維化等級需加做哪兩種染色？
quiz.a: 纖維組織（streaming fibrosis）；reticulin 與 trichrome。

66364.recognize_zh: 這是一張正面胸部 X 光（chest X-ray），可見心臟縱膈陰影明顯擴大、雙側中下肺野模糊浸潤、兩側肋膈角變鈍（右側較明顯），代表肺水腫合併肋膜積液，與體液（body fluid）檢體的臨床背景相關。
features: Frontal (likely portable AP) chest radiograph with markedly enlarged cardiomediastinal silhouette
Bilateral mid and lower zone hazy ground-glass opacity with increased interstitial markings
Blunting of both costophrenic angles with dependent opacity, more prominent on the right, consistent with pleural effusions
Upper lung zones relatively lucent; no pneumothorax evident
Non-morphologic image: no cytologic information is provided
66364.describe_en: Frontal chest radiograph demonstrates a markedly enlarged cardiomediastinal silhouette. There are bilateral mid and lower zone ground-glass opacities with increased interstitial markings, suggestive of pulmonary edema. Both costophrenic angles are blunted, more so on the right, indicating bilateral pleural effusions. This is a radiologic image and offers no morphologic data; its role is to provide clinical context for the corresponding pleural or pericardial fluid cytology.

ddx.vs: A globular 'water-bottle' cardiac silhouette can mimic cardiomegaly and is separated by echocardiography rather than plain film.
A mediastinal mass widens the superior mediastinum with a lobulated contour and is best defined by CT, whereas this silhouette enlargement is predominantly cardiac.
Infectious consolidation tends to be patchy or lobar with air bronchograms, while edema is symmetric, perihilar/basal and accompanied by effusions and cardiomegaly.

66236.recognize_zh: 左上方一顆顆粒狀血小板大小接近紅血球，與右下方小淋巴球的核相近；整個視野正常大小血小板非常稀少，紅血球形態大致正常，符合巨大血小板合併血小板減少的 Bernard-Soulier 症候群。
features: Giant platelet at upper left approaching the diameter of adjacent red cells, with centrally concentrated purple granules and a pale hyaline rim
Marked paucity of normal-sized platelets in the field (apparent thrombocytopenia)
Small mature lymphocyte for size comparison
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes or spherocytes
No leukocyte inclusions (Döhle-like bodies) seen in the single leukocyte present
66236.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells without fragmentation. Platelets are markedly decreased in the field, and the platelet present at the upper left is a giant form approaching the size of a red cell, with granules concentrated centrally. A small mature lymphocyte is present; the leukocyte shows no cytoplasmic inclusions. In the appropriate clinical context, giant platelets with thrombocytopenia are consistent with Bernard-Soulier syndrome, which is confirmed by absent ristocetin-induced aggregation and reduced GPIb-IX-V on flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: MYH9 disorders show similar giant platelets but have blue Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils and normal ristocetin aggregation.
ITP shows a spectrum of mildly enlarged young platelets rather than uniformly giant platelets, with normal GPIb expression and normal ristocetin response.
Gray platelets are large but pale gray and agranular, unlike the granulated giant platelet here.
EDTA-induced clumps form aggregates of normal-sized platelets, whereas this is a single enlarged platelet.

exam.answer_en: Bernard-Soulier syndrome — giant granulated platelet approaching red cell size with thrombocytopenia; lymphocyte for size reference
pearls_zh: 考法：以旁邊小淋巴球為比例尺，問血小板大小是否異常；接近紅血球或小淋巴球大小即為 giant platelet。
BSS = 血小板少、巨大、ristocetin 不凝集；缺 GPIb-IX-V 導致血小板無法經 vWF 黏附於受損內皮下。
與 vWD 區分：vWD 的 ristocetin 異常可被加入正常血漿矯正，BSS 不能（缺陷在血小板本身）。
Flow cytometry 測 CD42b（GPIbα）/CD42a（GPIX）表現減少是快速確認方法；基因檢測 GP1BA、GP1BB、GP9。
exam.pitfall_zh: 巨大血小板易與 MYH9-related disorder 混淆；兩者都有巨大血小板與血小板低下，但 MYH9 中性球有藍色 Döhle-like 包涵體且 ristocetin 凝集正常。

quiz.q: 左上方顆粒狀結構是什麼？加入正常血漿能否矯正此病人的 ristocetin 凝集異常？
quiz.a: Giant platelet；不能（BSS 缺陷在血小板 GPIb，vWD 才可矯正）。

66044.recognize_zh: 四顆異常前骨髓細胞的核呈雙葉、摺疊或蝴蝶狀（bilobed/folded），細胞質中度嗜鹼、顆粒稀少，形態符合低顆粒型急性前骨髓性白血病（hypogranular APL, M3v）。
features: Four large atypical cells with moderate amounts of blue-gray cytoplasm
Nuclei deeply folded, creased or bilobed (butterfly/crumpled-paper appearance)
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli not prominent
Cytoplasm largely hypogranular with only faint dust-like granules; irregular cytoplasmic margins with small blebs
No Auer rods or faggot cells visible in this field
Background red cells with overlapping/clustered arrangement; no normal leukocytes in view
66044.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows four large abnormal cells with moderate, pale basophilic cytoplasm and irregular cytoplasmic outlines. Their nuclei are markedly folded, creased, or bilobed, with finely dispersed chromatin. Cytoplasmic granules are sparse and fine, and no Auer rods or faggot cells are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with abnormal promyelocytes of the hypogranular (microgranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent confirmation of PML::RARA and coagulation screening for DIC is recommended.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes also have folded nuclei but show gray-blue cytoplasm with vacuoles, NSE positivity and weak MPO, whereas M3v cells are strongly MPO positive and CD34/HLA-DR negative.
Classic APL cells have dense azurophilic granules obscuring the nucleus and frequent Auer rod bundles, whereas these cells are hypogranular.
Normal promyelocytes have a round eccentric nucleus with a perinuclear Golgi zone and abundant evenly distributed primary granules, not folded bilobed nuclei.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma cells with cleaved nuclei (e.g., Sézary cells)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells have condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, lack myeloid granules, and are MPO negative with a lymphoid immunophenotype.

exam.answer_en: Abnormal promyelocytes of hypogranular (microgranular) APL in blood — deeply folded bilobed nuclei with sparse fine granules
pearls_zh: 考法：標題寫 promyelocyte，但考點在「異常」：正常 promyelocyte 為圓形偏心核、有 Golgi 淡染區與豐富顆粒；此圖為摺疊/雙葉核、顆粒稀少，應答 APL M3v。
周邊血出現大量此類細胞時，需立即做 PT、aPTT、fibrinogen、D-dimer 與血小板，評估 DIC。
確診靠 PML::RARA（FISH/RT-PCR）；少見變異如 t(11;17) ZBTB16::RARA 對 ATRA 反應差，是常考例外。
ATRA/ATO 治療中若出現呼吸困難、肺浸潤、體重增加與低血壓，應懷疑 differentiation syndrome，給 dexamethasone。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 monocytic leukemia 的 promonocyte；APL M3v 為 MPO 強陽性、NSE 陰性、HLA-DR 陰性，promonocyte 則 MPO 弱、NSE 陽性且胞質常有空泡。

quiz.q: 圖中四顆細胞與正常 promyelocyte 在核形上最大的差別是什麼？應懷疑何種診斷？
quiz.a: 核深度摺疊或雙葉（蝴蝶狀），而非圓形偏心核；hypogranular APL（M3v）。

65788.recognize_zh: 這是流式細胞儀散佈圖，不是形態學影像：紅色異常細胞群 cCD3 陽性、MPO 陰性（綠色為 MPO+ 顆粒球作內部對照），CD22 與 cCD79a 陰性；橘色小群為 CD22+/cCD79a+ 的正常 B 淋巴球，確認腫瘤細胞為 T 系。
features: Plot 1: dominant red population is cytoplasmic CD3 positive and MPO negative; green granulocytes are MPO positive/cCD3 negative as internal control
Plot 2: red population CD22 negative across the cCD3-positive range; small orange cluster is CD22 positive/cCD3 negative
Plot 3: red population cCD79a negative, with a gated residual B-lymphocyte population (orange) co-expressing CD22 and cCD79a
Plot 4: CD22-positive cells are CD34 negative (mature B cells), and the red population is CD34 negative
Lineage conclusion: T-lineage without myeloid or B-lineage co-expression
65788.describe_en: This figure shows flow cytometry lineage-assignment plots rather than a morphologic image. The abnormal population (red) is positive for cytoplasmic CD3 and negative for MPO, cytoplasmic CD79a, CD22 and CD34. Internal controls behave appropriately, with MPO-positive granulocytes (green) and a small population of CD22/cCD79a-positive, CD34-negative mature B cells (orange). Findings establish T-lineage without evidence of myeloid or B-lineage co-expression, consistent with the T-cell neoplasm (hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma) in this case.

ddx.vs: T-ALL is also cCD3 positive but usually expresses TdT and/or CD34 or CD1a, whereas this population is CD34 negative.
MPAL T/myeloid would show MPO co-expression on the cCD3-positive population, which is absent here.
NK cells may express cytoplasmic CD3 epsilon but lack surface CD3 and TCR, requiring surface CD3 and TCR gamma-delta/alpha-beta staining to separate.

65020.recognize_zh: 這是右側下肢（膝部與遠端股骨）X 光片翻拍，影像有明顯摩爾紋（moiré），遠端股骨髓腔僅見模糊的斑駁透亮區，病灶邊界與硬化邊緣在此解析度下無法清楚辨識，需搭配另一張影像判讀。
features: Plain radiograph of the right distal femur and knee, photographed from a monitor with moire artifact
Subtle mottled lucency in the distal femoral diaphysis/metaphysis
Well-defined sclerotic margins cannot be confirmed at this resolution
No obvious pathologic fracture, periosteal reaction or soft-tissue mass visible
Image quality limits assessment of lesion number and borders
65020.describe_en: Frontal radiograph of the right distal femur and knee, photographed from a display screen, shows subtle mottled lucency within the distal femoral shaft and metaphysis. Because of moire artifact and low contrast, the size, number and margins of any lytic lesions, including the reported sclerotic rims, cannot be reliably assessed on this image. No obvious pathologic fracture or aggressive periosteal reaction is seen. The image is only partially supportive of the reported lytic lesions and should be interpreted together with better-quality views; in the clinical context, the findings would be compatible with skeletal Langerhans cell histiocytosis.

ddx.vs: Myeloma lesions are punched-out lytic defects without sclerotic rims in adults, often in the axial skeleton.
A Brodie abscess is usually solitary and metaphyseal with a thick sclerotic rim and sometimes a sequestrum.
These produce permeative moth-eaten lysis and metaphyseal lucent bands rather than well-marginated lesions.
Benign fibrous lesions are eccentric cortical, multiloculated or ground-glass lesions, and histology lacks Langerhans cells.

65724.recognize_zh: 低倍下幾段骨髓切片主要由粉紅色、寬大相連的骨小樑組成，髓腔被擠壓到幾乎消失，只剩零星紫色細胞區；這種骨多髓少的低倍影像提示骨質硬化。
features: Fragmented cores composed predominantly of eosinophilic bone
Broad, anastomosing trabeculae with marked narrowing to near obliteration of intertrabecular marrow spaces
Only small, patchy residual foci of hematopoietic cells
One solid pale homogeneous fragment consistent with cortical bone or cartilage
Low magnification limits cytologic assessment
65724.describe_en: Low-power view of bone marrow core biopsy fragments shows that the specimen is composed predominantly of bone, with broad, anastomosing and widened trabeculae that nearly obliterate the intertrabecular marrow spaces. Residual hematopoietic tissue is scant and patchy, and one fragment consists of solid pale homogeneous tissue, likely cortical bone or cartilage. Cellular detail cannot be assessed at this magnification. The findings indicate marked osteosclerosis with reduced marrow space, supportive of osteopetrosis in the appropriate clinical and radiographic context.

ddx.vs: PMF osteosclerosis is accompanied by atypical megakaryocyte clusters and reticulin fibrosis in adults, rather than primary bone overgrowth in an infant.
Sclerotic metastases contain cohesive keratin-positive tumor cells between the new bone.
A tangential sample of normal cortex contains compact bone with Haversian canals but normal trabecular spacing elsewhere, whereas all fragments here show widened trabeculae.

64764.recognize_zh: 組合圖：A 右上臂明顯腫脹、皮下靜脈怒張；B 肱骨 X 光可見骨質破壞；C、D 軸切面 CT 顯示右肩周圍巨大軟組織腫塊包圍並破壞肱骨頭、壓迫周邊構造；E 治療後腫塊消失。骨頭破壞合併大軟組織腫塊，是漿細胞瘤的影像線索。
features: Panel A: marked swelling of the right upper arm with prominent dilated superficial veins
Panel B: radiograph of the humerus with cortical destruction and deformity consistent with a pathologic fracture
Panels C-D: axial CT showing a large enhancing soft-tissue mass around the proximal humerus with fragmented, destroyed bone and compression of adjacent tissues
Panel E: post-treatment CT with resolution of the soft-tissue mass
No tissue morphology is shown; diagnosis relies on biopsy and marrow findings
64764.describe_en: Composite clinical and imaging figure. The clinical photograph shows marked swelling of the right upper arm with dilated superficial veins, and the radiograph shows destruction of the proximal humerus consistent with a pathologic fracture. Axial CT images demonstrate a large soft-tissue mass centered on the proximal humerus with fragmented residual bone and compression of surrounding structures, and the post-treatment CT shows complete resolution of the mass. These images are non-morphologic; a lytic bone lesion with a large extraosseous soft-tissue component is consistent with a plasmacytoma in the setting of multiple myeloma, which requires histologic confirmation of clonal plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Metastatic carcinoma is keratin-positive on biopsy, whereas plasmacytoma shows CD138-positive light chain-restricted plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of bone
ddx.vs: Primary bone lymphoma shows CD20-positive large B cells rather than monotypic plasma cells.
Sarcomas show matrix mineralization and mesenchymal histology rather than sheets of plasma cells.

65660.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片可見多個核分葉減少或染色質團塊化的發育不良嗜中性球（箭頭，pseudo-Pelger/abnormal segmentation），而成對免疫染色中 CD138 陽性漿細胞聚集區 p53 反而陰性、背景造血細胞 p53 強陽性，顯示 TP53 突變來自治療相關 MDS 而非骨髓瘤。
features: BM biopsy H&E: hypercellular marrow with interstitial plasma cells and trilineage hematopoiesis, including atypical megakaryocytes
BM aspirate: dysplastic neutrophils with hyposegmented, clumped or abnormally lobated nuclei (arrows); background myeloid precursors and plasma cells
CD138: plasma cells forming interstitial aggregates and sheets in part of the core
p53: strong diffuse nuclear staining in background hematopoietic cells, largely sparing CD138+ plasma cell aggregates; inset shows strong nuclear p53 in precursor cells
65660.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with increased plasma cells and background hematopoiesis. The aspirate smear shows dysgranulopoiesis, including neutrophils with hyposegmented, abnormally lobated and clumped nuclei. Paired immunostains demonstrate CD138-positive plasma cell aggregates, whereas strong p53 nuclear overexpression is present in the background hematopoietic cells but not within the plasma cell aggregates, localizing the TP53-mutant clone to the myeloid compartment. In the setting of prior cytotoxic therapy and a complex karyotype, findings are consistent with residual plasma cell myeloma and a concurrent myelodysplastic neoplasm with biallelic TP53 inactivation, post-cytotoxic therapy.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with TP53 mutation/17p deletion only
ddx.vs: p53 overexpression would be localized to the CD138-positive plasma cells rather than to background myeloid cells.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related dysplasia-like changes (drug effect, lenalidomide, G-CSF)
ddx.vs: Reactive changes lack strong diffuse p53 overexpression, complex karyotype and high-VAF TP53 mutations.
Requires 20% or more myeloid blasts, which are not seen in this aspirate.

ddx.dx: Acquired Pelger-Huet anomaly from drugs (e.g., mycophenolate)
ddx.vs: Drug-induced pseudo-Pelger cells occur without multilineage dysplasia or a p53-overexpressing clone and resolve after withdrawal.

65532.recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆大而圓的細胞，比周圍中性球大很多，細胞質是均勻的深藍色，右上緣有個小小的細胞質突起；核圓、染色質細緻開放。周圍幾乎全是分葉核與帶狀核顆粒球，看不到成熟紅血球前驅細胞，指向 parvovirus B19 導致的純紅血球再生不良。
features: Isolated large round cell, roughly 2.5–3 times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Large round central nucleus with finely granular, open chromatin and faint pale inclusion-like areas
Thin to moderate rim of intensely basophilic cytoplasm with a small peripheral cytoplasmic protrusion
Background dominated by bands and segmented neutrophils, with an eosinophil and scattered small lymphocytes
Maturing erythroid precursors not evident in this field
65532.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows abundant granulocytic cells, mainly bands and segmented neutrophils, with scattered lymphocytes and an eosinophil; maturing erythroid precursors are not identified in this field. A large isolated proerythroblast is present, with a round central nucleus, open finely granular chromatin and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm bearing a small cytoplasmic protrusion. Findings are consistent with a giant proerythroblast associated with parvovirus B19 infection and pure red cell aplasia.

ddx.vs: Normal pronormoblasts are smaller (about 15–20 µm) and accompanied by a full spectrum of maturing normoblasts, unlike this giant cell in an erythroid-depleted background.
Myeloblasts have less intensely blue cytoplasm, may show granules or Auer rods, and are MPO positive, whereas this cell has deep erythroid-type basophilia and a bleb.
Plasmablasts show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and prominent nucleolus and are CD138/MUM1 positive.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature erythroid cells replacing the marrow rather than a single giant proerythroblast among normal granulopoiesis.

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19 pure red cell aplasia — isolated giant proerythroblast amid granulocytes, maturing erythroid precursors absent
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「整個視野缺了哪一系？」，答紅血球系；再指中央大細胞問名稱：giant proerythroblast。
Transient aplastic crisis：慢性溶血（hereditary spherocytosis、sickle cell disease、thalassemia）病人感染 B19 時血紅素急降，需輸血支持。
B19 IgM 可協助免疫正常者診斷；免疫低下者需 PCR，因抗體反應可能不足。
持續性 B19 PRCA：減低免疫抑制並給予 IVIG。
exam.pitfall_zh: 單一大圓細胞易被當成 plasmablast 或 megakaryoblast；B19 原紅血球細胞質均勻深藍、邊緣有小突起、無核周淡染 hof（plasma cell 特徵）。

quiz.q: 此骨髓視野缺少哪一系前驅細胞？中央大細胞稱為什麼？
quiz.a: 紅血球系（erythroid precursors）；giant proerythroblast（parvovirus B19）。

65404.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中箭頭指出咬痕細胞（bite cell）與水泡細胞（blister cell），另有紅血球鬼影（ghost）、半鬼影（hemighost）與球形紅血球，這組氧化性溶血變化配合吃蠶豆史，指向 G6PD 缺乏的蠶豆症。
features: Numerous bite cells and blister cells with hemoglobin retracted to one side (arrows)
Red cell ghosts with lost hemoglobin (arrowheads) and hemighosts (carets)
Scattered spherocytes lacking central pallor (asterisks)
Occasional echinocytes and polychromatic red cells
Platelets present; rare leukocytes
65404.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked red cell changes of oxidative hemolysis, including numerous bite cells and blister (eccentrocyte-like) cells, red cell ghosts, hemighosts and scattered spherocytes. Occasional polychromatic cells are present, consistent with a reticulocyte response. Platelets are adequate and no schistocytes or red cell agglutination are evident. Findings are consistent with acute oxidative hemolysis, as seen in G6PD deficiency (favism); a Heinz body preparation and G6PD assay, preferably after recovery, are recommended.

ddx.vs: Spherocytes predominate without bite cells, blister cells or ghosts, and the course is chronic rather than an acute trigger-related crisis.
Characterized by schistocytes (helmet cells, triangles) with thrombocytopenia rather than bite and blister cells.
Also shows bite cells and Heinz bodies, but G6PD activity is normal and hemoglobin stability testing is abnormal.
Shows spherocytes with a positive direct antiglobulin test, without oxidative bite/blister cells or hemighosts.

exam.answer_en: G6PD deficiency (favism) with acute oxidative hemolysis — bite cells, blister cells, ghost and hemighost cells
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭等標記分別問 bite cell、blister cell、ghost cell；再問蠶豆中的氧化物質：vicine／convicine 代謝物 divicine、isouramil。
G6PD 缺乏為 X-linked；急性期活性可因網狀紅血球增多而假性正常，宜約 3 個月後複驗或做基因檢測。
合併 methemoglobinemia 時避免 methylene blue（需 G6PD 產生 NADPH，無效且可加重溶血），改用 ascorbic acid、輸血或換血。
Heinz bodies 需 supravital stain（crystal violet、new methylene blue）才看得到，Wright stain 下不可見。
台灣新生兒篩檢已常規納入 G6PD 缺乏症，是本地常考主題。
exam.pitfall_zh: ghost／hemighost 與球形紅血球易被誤判為 HS 或 AIHA；急性誘因史、bite/blister cell 與 DAT 陰性支持氧化性溶血。

quiz.q: 此病人合併 methemoglobinemia，為何不宜使用 methylene blue？
quiz.a: Methylene blue 需 G6PD 產生的 NADPH 才能作用，G6PD 缺乏者無效且會加重溶血

65340.recognize_zh: 畫面中央的嗜中性球核分成六葉以上（hypersegmented neutrophil），周圍紅血球大小不一，可見卵圓形紅血球（ovalocyte）與淚滴細胞（dacrocyte），部分中央淡染區擴大，符合維生素 B12／葉酸缺乏。
features: Central neutrophil with six or more discrete nuclear lobes (hypersegmentation)
Neutrophil cytoplasm with fine pink granules, normal cell size
Red cells with anisopoikilocytosis including ovalocytes/elliptocytes and teardrop cells
Many red cells with enlarged central pallor (hypochromia) and some red cell fragments
Occasional platelet at edge; no nucleated red cells in field
65340.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with six or more nuclear lobes, meeting criteria for hypersegmentation. Red cells display anisopoikilocytosis with oval to elliptical forms, teardrop cells, occasional fragments, and many cells with increased central pallor, suggesting coexisting iron deficiency or a dimorphic picture. No blasts or nucleated red cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia due to vitamin B12 and/or folate deficiency, possibly with concomitant iron deficiency; serum B12, folate, methylmalonic acid and iron studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: An inherited benign trait with hypersegmentation in otherwise normal blood and no macro-ovalocytes or anemia.
MDS more often shows hyposegmented (pseudo-Pelger) or hypogranular neutrophils, and B12/folate levels are normal.
Morphology is identical, so medication history and normal vitamin levels separate it.
Hypochromic microcytes and pencil cells may show mild hypersegmentation, but macro-ovalocytes are absent and MCV is low.

exam.answer_en: Hypersegmented neutrophil (≥6 lobes) — consistent with megaloblastic anemia (vitamin B12/folate deficiency)
pearls_zh: 考法：指中央嗜中性球數分葉；常用定義為任一顆 ≥6 葉，或 5 葉者佔嗜中性球 ≥5%。
分葉過多常比 macrocytosis 更早出現；合併缺鐵（dimorphic）時 MCV 可正常，分葉過多仍是巨母紅血球性變化線索。
鑑別 B12 與 folate：B12 缺乏時 methylmalonic acid 與 homocysteine 皆升高，folate 缺乏僅 homocysteine 升高。
B12 缺乏原因：pernicious anemia（anti-intrinsic factor 抗體）、胃切除、metformin、PPI、純素食；只補 folate 可能掩蓋並惡化神經症狀。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把兩顆重疊嗜中性球誤算成分葉過多；計數時各葉需以細絲相連且在同一細胞邊界內，MDS 的 pseudo-Pelger 則是分葉過少。

quiz.q: 圖中央嗜中性球的異常叫什麼？最常見的病因？
quiz.a: Hypersegmented neutrophil；維生素 B12 或葉酸缺乏（megaloblastic anemia）

65276.recognize_zh: 組織切片中可見多個圓形「花冠狀」構造：中央膨大的囊泡（vesicle）周圍放射狀排列瓶梗（phialides），外緣堆滿成串的小圓形分生孢子（conidia），背景也布滿散落孢子，這是麴菌（Aspergillus）分生孢子頭的典型外觀，常見於暴露於空氣的腔室如鼻竇。
features: Multiple radiate conidial heads with a central swollen vesicle
Phialides arranged radially around the vesicle, forming a sunburst pattern
Dense rims and sheets of small round brown conidia at the periphery and in the background
Conidiophore stalk sections visible at the center of some heads
Fungal ball-like aggregate without identifiable host tissue in this field; tan-brown tinted H&E
65276.describe_en: Section of nasal cavity material shows a fungal aggregate composed of sheets of small round conidia and several well-formed conidial heads. Each head consists of a swollen central vesicle with radially arranged phialides bearing chains of conidia, producing a sunburst appearance. Host tissue and tissue invasion are not evaluable in this field. The fruiting bodies are characteristic of Aspergillus species, a form typically produced in air-exposed cavities such as the paranasal sinuses; fungal culture is needed for species identification.

ddx.vs: Mucorales show broad, ribbon-like, pauci-septate hyphae with right-angle branching and sporangia with a columella rather than radiate conidial heads with phialides.
Penicillium forms brush-like (penicillate) branched conidiophores without a swollen vesicle.
Fusarium has acute-angle septate hyphae like Aspergillus but does not form vesicular conidial heads and produces banana-shaped macroconidia in culture.

exam.answer_en: Aspergillus fungal aggregate (nasal/sinus) — radiate conidial heads with swollen vesicle, phialides and chains of conidia
pearls_zh: 考法：指花冠狀構造問病原；答 Aspergillus conidial head（vesicle + phialides + conidia）。組織中出現分生孢子頭代表與空氣接觸的腔室，如鼻竇或空洞。
組織中菌絲形態：septate、寬度一致、約 45° 銳角二分叉；GMS、PAS 染色可凸顯。
臨床分型：fungus ball（非侵襲，手術清除）vs invasive fungal sinusitis（看組織與血管侵犯，屬急症，需清創加 voriconazole 等抗黴菌藥）。
輔助檢查：血清或 BAL galactomannan、培養定種；A. niger 感染可伴 calcium oxalate 結晶。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常與 Mucorales 混淆；Mucor 為寬帶狀、少分隔、近直角分支菌絲，形成孢子囊而非放射狀瓶梗。錯認會選錯藥，voriconazole 對 Mucor 無效。

quiz.q: 圖中放射狀花冠構造由哪三部分組成？代表哪一屬黴菌？
quiz.a: Vesicle、phialides、conidia；Aspergillus。

65084.recognize_zh: 低倍下可見多個大小不一的濾泡與擴大的套區，左上角小型生發中心周圍套區呈同心圓排列，旁邊有管壁明顯的血管朝濾泡延伸；但在此倍率下，血管穿入生發中心形成「棒棒糖」（lollipop）的影像並不十分清楚。
features: Low-power lymph node with multiple follicles of variable size and expanded mantle zones
Small follicle (upper left) with concentric mantle zone lymphocytes adjacent to a prominent vessel
Vessels coursing through interfollicular areas toward follicles; definite radial penetration of a germinal center is not well resolved
Pale, variably sized germinal centers including larger pale nodules on the right
Increased interfollicular vascularity with congested vascular spaces
65084.describe_en: Low-power view of the lymph node shows preserved architecture with multiple follicles of varying size, some with small germinal centers surrounded by expanded, concentrically layered mantle zones. Prominent vessels traverse the interfollicular region and approach the follicles, with increased interfollicular vascularity. Vessels radially penetrating germinal centers (lollipop follicles) are suggested but not clearly resolved at this magnification. The findings are compatible with Castleman disease-type morphology in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.dx: Unicentric Castleman disease, hyaline vascular type
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; UCD is a single-station mass with more pronounced hyalinized penetrating vessels, regressed germinal centers and stromal proliferation, and lacks systemic inflammatory symptoms.
Reactive follicles have large polarized germinal centers with tingible-body macrophages and lack concentric mantles and penetrating hyalinized vessels.
AITL shows regressed follicles with arborizing high endothelial venules, but has clear-cell atypical TFH cells and expanded CD21+ FDC meshworks outside follicles.
HIV nodes may show follicle lysis and regressed follicles, but clinical serology and florid follicular hyperplasia with follicle lysis distinguish them.

exam.answer_en: Castleman disease-type morphology (compatible with idiopathic multicentric CD) — small follicles with concentric mantles and prominent vessels approaching them
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍下請考生找 lollipop：血管由濾泡間放射狀穿入萎縮生發中心、外圍同心圓套區；本圖穿入不明顯，應保守答「Castleman 型特徵」。
Castleman 組織特徵組合：regressed GC、onion-skin mantle、twinning、lollipop、濾泡間血管增生；單一特徵不具專一性，需組合判讀並配合臨床。
UCD 與 iMCD 形態重疊，最終分類靠影像上的淋巴結區域數與全身發炎症狀；UCD 以手術切除為主，iMCD 以 anti-IL-6（siltuximab）為一線。
Castleman-like 變化可見於 HIV、自體免疫疾病、AITL 與淋巴瘤周邊，報告前需排除。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把普通穿越濾泡間的血管過度判讀為 lollipop；真正 lollipop 是玻璃樣變血管放射狀插入萎縮生發中心；AITL 的樹枝狀 HEV 需以 PD1、CD21 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中 Castleman 型濾泡若要稱為 lollipop，血管與生發中心需呈何種關係？
quiz.a: 玻璃樣變血管呈放射狀穿入萎縮的生發中心（像棒棒糖的棒子）。

64956.recognize_zh: A 張 H&E 為瀰漫片狀、細胞質少的小至中型藍色細胞圍繞血管浸潤；B、C 為核染色陽性（TdT、PAX5），D、E 為膜染色（CD19 弱、CD10 強），F 的 CD34 腫瘤細胞陰性僅血管內皮著色，這組免疫表型指向前驅 B 淋巴母細胞。
features: Panel A (H&E): diffuse sheets of monotonous small-to-medium blasts with scant cytoplasm infiltrating around small vessels
Blasts with fine chromatin, round to irregular nuclei and occasional nucleoli; no glandular breast elements seen in this field
Panel B: strong diffuse nuclear TdT positivity
Panel C: diffuse nuclear PAX5 positivity
Panels D-E: weak membranous CD19 and strong membranous CD10 staining
Panel F: CD34 negative in blasts with positive internal control in endothelial cells
64956.describe_en: Biopsy of the breast mass shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of small-to-medium blasts with scant cytoplasm and fine chromatin, arranged around small vessels (A). By immunohistochemistry, the neoplastic cells are strongly positive for TdT (B) and PAX5 (C), weakly positive for CD19 (D), strongly positive for CD10 (E), and negative for CD34 (F), which highlights only endothelial cells. This profile indicates an immature B-cell phenotype. In a patient with a history of B-lymphoblastic leukemia, findings are consistent with extramedullary relapse of B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells are TdT-negative mature B cells with surface immunoglobulin, Ki-67 near 100%, starry-sky pattern and MYC rearrangement.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and are TdT-negative, often CD20-strong.
Myeloid sarcoma expresses MPO, CD117, lysozyme or CD33 and lacks PAX5 and TdT in most cases.

ddx.dx: Lobular breast carcinoma or small round cell tumor
ddx.vs: Lobular carcinoma is cytokeratin-positive and E-cadherin-negative, and Ewing sarcoma expresses CD99/NKX2.2 without PAX5.

64956.stain: H&E; IHC: TdT, PAX5, CD19, CD10, CD34

64636.recognize_zh: 視野中絕大多數紅血球呈兩端鈍圓、邊緣平行的橢圓形或雪茄形（elliptocytes），比例明顯超過 30%，而中央淡染區仍保留、無明顯碎片或球形紅血球，符合遺傳性橢圓形紅血球症。
features: Majority of RBCs (well over 30%) are elliptocytes/ovalocytes with rounded ends and parallel sides, some elongated cigar or rod forms
RBCs are roughly normocytic with central pallor retained in many cells
No significant schistocytes, microspherocytes, or teardrop cells in this field
Scattered platelets of normal size and granularity
Single mature segmented neutrophil with normal granulation
64636.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a striking population of elliptocytes and ovalocytes comprising well over 30% of red cells, including elongated rod- and cigar-shaped forms with smooth, rounded ends. Red cells otherwise appear approximately normocytic with preserved central pallor; fragments, microspherocytes and poikilocytes suggestive of pyropoikilocytosis are not prominent in this field. Platelets appear adequate in number and morphology, and the single neutrophil is unremarkable. In the setting of normal hemoglobin and iron studies, findings are consistent with hereditary elliptocytosis (common, likely mild/carrier phenotype).

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytic cells with thin elongated pencil cells in a minority of RBCs, whereas here the elliptocytes are normochromic and dominate the field with normal iron studies.
Teardrop cells taper to a single pointed tail and are accompanied by leukoerythroblastosis, unlike the symmetric rounded-end elliptocytes seen here.
HPP shows marked microcytosis with fragments, microspherocytes and bizarre budding poikilocytes and severe hemolysis, which are absent in this field.
SAO shows stomatocytic ovalocytes with one or two transverse slits or bars, whereas these elliptocytes lack slit-like central pallor.

exam.answer_en: Hereditary elliptocytosis — predominant normochromic elliptocytes/ovalocytes (well over 30% of RBCs) without fragments or microspherocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：整片均勻的兩端鈍圓橢圓形紅血球，要答 hereditary elliptocytosis，並說明「無碎片、小球形細胞」以排除 HPP。
致病機轉：紅血球骨架水平連結（horizontal interaction）缺陷，常見 α-spectrin（SPTA1）、β-spectrin（SPTB）或 protein 4.1（EPB41）變異，多為體染色體顯性。
臨床：多數為無症狀或輕微代償性溶血，不需治療；嚴重溶血者才考慮脾切除。父母之一常有相同血片。
非遺傳性橢圓形紅血球也見於缺鐵、海洋性貧血、MDS、骨髓纖維化，判讀需結合 MCV、鐵學與家族史。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與缺鐵的 pencil cell 或骨髓纖維化的淚滴細胞混淆；HE 細胞為正常色素、兩端對稱鈍圓且占大多數，pencil cell 低色素少量，淚滴細胞只有單一尖尾。

quiz.q: 這張血片中占多數的紅血球形態是什麼？最常見的致病蛋白缺陷為何？
quiz.a: Elliptocytes（hereditary elliptocytosis）；spectrin（α/β）或 protein 4.1 缺陷

64700.recognize_zh: 嗜中性球細胞質內有多顆大小不一、深紫至藍灰色的異常巨大顆粒（A、B），淋巴球細胞質內則見單一顆明顯偏大的圓形紫色顆粒（C、D），這種跨細胞系的巨大顆粒是 Chédiak-Higashi 症候群的特徵。
features: Neutrophils contain multiple abnormally large, coarse, dark purple to blue-gray cytoplasmic granules of variable size (panels A-B)
Neutrophil in panel A also shows cytoplasmic vacuoles and irregular inclusions
Lymphocytes contain a single large round purple cytoplasmic granule (panels C-D)
Nuclear segmentation and chromatin of neutrophils otherwise mature; lymphocyte nuclei with condensed chromatin
Background red cells and platelets without notable abnormality
64700.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa, digital microscopy) shows neutrophils containing numerous abnormally large, coarse, dark purple to gray-blue cytoplasmic granules of varying size, with occasional vacuoles. Lymphocytes contain a single, strikingly large, round purple cytoplasmic granule. Red cells and platelets appear unremarkable. In a child with partial albinism, neutropenia and recurrent infections, findings are consistent with Chédiak-Higashi syndrome (confirmed by LYST sequencing).

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine, evenly distributed, dark azurophilic granules of uniform size that do not form giant granules and do not involve lymphocytes.
Alder-Reilly granules are dense, fine-to-coarse and diffusely fill neutrophils and often lymphocytes, but are not few, giant, discrete inclusions.
MYH9 inclusions are pale blue, spindle-shaped Döhle-like bodies with giant platelets and thrombocytopenia, whereas here granules are round, purple and platelets are normal.
Acquired giant granules occur in dysplastic or leukemic myeloid precursors with blasts and cytopenias, not in otherwise mature neutrophils and lymphocytes of a child with albinism.

exam.answer_en: Chédiak-Higashi syndrome — giant abnormal cytoplasmic granules in neutrophils and lymphocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指嗜中性球或淋巴球內的巨大顆粒問診斷——答 Chédiak-Higashi syndrome；重點是「跨細胞系」皆有巨大融合的溶小體顆粒。
遺傳：LYST 基因突變，體染色體隱性，造成溶小體運輸異常。
臨床四聯：部分眼皮膚白化症（銀灰髮）、反覆化膿性感染（嗜中性球趨化/殺菌差）、出血傾向（血小板 dense granule 缺乏）、進行性神經病變。
Accelerated phase 即 HLH 樣表現，是主要死因；根治需造血幹細胞移植，但無法改善神經病變。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 toxic granulation 或 Alder-Reilly 顆粒；毒性顆粒細小均勻且只見於嗜中性球，CHS 則是少數巨大、大小不一的顆粒，連淋巴球也有。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴球內單一巨大紫色顆粒與嗜中性球巨大顆粒，指向哪個疾病與哪個基因？
quiz.a: Chédiak-Higashi syndrome；LYST

64572.recognize_zh: 數個嗜中性球與單核球周圍被大量小血小板緊密包圍、黏附成團，其他區域血小板稀少，這種繞著白血球排列的血小板就是血小板衛星現象（platelet satellitism）。
features: Neutrophils and a monocyte rimmed and overlapped by numerous adherent platelets
Platelet clusters confined to leukocyte surfaces, forming small leukocyte-platelet aggregates
Few free-lying platelets in the background
Leukocytes otherwise show normal segmented or folded nuclei
Background red cells normochromic with one small lymphocyte in the corner
64572.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several neutrophils and a monocyte surrounded by rosettes of adherent platelets, with platelets clustered on and around the leukocyte membranes. Free platelets in the intervening background are sparse. The leukocytes and red cells are otherwise unremarkable. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-dependent phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia; recommend a repeat count in citrate or a fingerstick smear.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumps float free in the background rather than rimming leukocytes, though both cause pseudothrombocytopenia.
True thrombocytopenia shows few platelets throughout the smear with no clumps or satellites, and the count does not correct in citrate.
Here platelets sit on the cell surface at the periphery rather than within cytoplasmic vacuoles.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism — platelets rosetting around neutrophils and a monocyte, an EDTA-dependent in vitro artifact causing pseudothrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：病人自動血球計數血小板低但無出血，考官指嗜中性球周圍的血小板問「怎麼處理？」——答假性血小板低下，改用 citrate 管重抽或看指尖血抹片。
機轉：EDTA 依賴性自體抗體（多為 IgG）在試管內使血小板 GPIIb/IIIa 與中性球 Fcγ receptor 結合，屬體外現象，無臨床出血意義。
Citrate 管計數需校正抗凝劑稀釋；報告時應註明血小板衛星現象與計數不可靠，避免不必要的輸血或骨髓檢查。
常與 EDTA 誘發的血小板凝集同時出現；判讀一定要看抹片邊緣（feathered edge）是否有血小板團塊。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被當成白血球吞噬血小板或真性血小板低下；衛星現象中血小板貼附在白血球表面外圍而非細胞質內，且換 citrate 抗凝後計數恢復正常。

quiz.q: 圖中白血球周圍環繞血小板的現象叫什麼？會讓自動血球計數出現什麼錯誤？
quiz.a: Platelet satellitism（EDTA 依賴）；假性血小板低下（pseudothrombocytopenia）

64380.recognize_zh: 兩格各有一顆嗜中性球，核分成六到七個分葉、以細絲相連，細胞大小與顆粒大致正常，數得出 ≥6 葉即為過度分葉嗜中性球。
features: Two neutrophils (one per panel), each with 6-7 discrete nuclear lobes connected by thin chromatin strands
Dense, clumped mature chromatin; no nucleoli
Cell size only mildly enlarged; pale pink cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
No toxic granulation, Dohle bodies or vacuoles
Background red cells normocytic without obvious macro-ovalocytes; rouleaux-like overlap in thick areas
64380.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, shown as two high-power panels, contains neutrophils with six to seven nuclear lobes joined by fine chromatin filaments. The cytoplasm is pale with normal fine granulation, and there is no toxic granulation or vacuolation. The accompanying red cells in these fields do not show conspicuous macro-ovalocytosis. Findings are consistent with neutrophil hypersegmentation, a nonspecific finding that raises megaloblastic anemia but also occurs with iron deficiency, myeloid neoplasms including myeloproliferative neoplasms, hydroxyurea and G-CSF.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic states show hypersegmentation together with macro-ovalocytes, high MCV and low B12/folate, which must be excluded by red cell indices and vitamin levels.
Botryoid neutrophils have rounded lobes clustered radially around a central clearing, in hyperthermia, rather than a linear chain of lobes.
The rare inherited form is lifelong and familial with otherwise normal counts, whereas acquired hypersegmentation tracks with a nutritional, drug or neoplastic cause.

exam.answer_en: Hypersegmented neutrophils — neutrophils with 6–7 nuclear lobes, classically suggesting megaloblastic anemia (B12/folate deficiency)
pearls_zh: 考法：數核葉。常用判定：出現任一 ≥6 葉的中性球，或 5 葉中性球超過約 5%，即為過度分葉。
Megaloblastic anemia 中過度分葉可早於 macrocytosis 出現；B12 缺乏時 methylmalonic acid 與 homocysteine 皆升高，葉酸缺乏僅 homocysteine 升高。
其他原因：hydroxyurea、methotrexate 等抗代謝藥、G-CSF、缺鐵、腎衰竭、骨髓增生性腫瘤。
B12 缺乏需找原因（pernicious anemia、胃切除、長期 metformin）；補充葉酸前應先排除 B12 缺乏，以免神經病變惡化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把兩顆重疊的中性球或 botryoid 中性球當成過度分葉；需確認各葉以細絲相連屬同一細胞，botryoid 的核葉則呈放射狀圍繞中央。

quiz.q: 哪一個生化檢查可區分 B12 缺乏與葉酸缺乏？
quiz.a: Methylmalonic acid：B12 缺乏時升高，葉酸缺乏時正常（homocysteine 兩者皆升高）。

64316.recognize_zh: 中央這顆嗜中性球的核分裂成約 8–9 個小圓葉，呈放射狀排列像一串葡萄（botryoid），細胞質仍有正常顆粒；背景紅血球有許多皺縮棘狀細胞（echinocytes）。
features: Single neutrophil of normal size with a nucleus fragmented into multiple (about 8-9) small, round, dense lobes arranged radially in a grape-cluster (botryoid) pattern
Lobes are compact and similar in size, connected centrally rather than in a linear hypersegmented chain
Cytoplasm pale pink with fine neutrophilic granules; no vacuolation or Dohle bodies
Background red cells include numerous crenated echinocytes and some elliptical and irregular forms
Scattered platelets and a platelet clump present
64316.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil whose nucleus is divided into multiple small, round, closely packed lobes radiating from a central point, producing a botryoid (grape-cluster) configuration. The cytoplasm contains normal fine granules without toxic changes. The background red cells show prominent crenation with numerous echinocytes, a pattern that may reflect in vivo or in vitro (storage/drying) change. Findings are consistent with botryoid neutrophil nuclear change, classically described in hyperthermia (heat stroke), severe burns, and alcohol intoxication.

ddx.vs: Hypersegmented neutrophils have six or more lobes strung in a linear chain with thin filaments and often macro-ovalocytes, rather than tightly clustered radial lobes.
Apoptotic neutrophils show several very dense, perfectly round, disconnected nuclear fragments with hypereosinophilic shrunken cytoplasm, rather than connected lobes in a cell of normal size.

Delayed processing causes nuclear lobe rounding and separation along with cytoplasmic vacuoles and echinocytes; clinical history and a fresh smear are needed to distinguish it from true botryoid change.

64188.recognize_zh: 核偏位、細胞質淡藍色的類漿細胞淋巴球，其細胞質中有一顆紅紫色、邊界清楚的大型嗜天青顆粒（giant azurophilic granule），是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群淋巴球的典型表現。
features: Lymphocyte slightly larger than a red cell with an eccentric round nucleus (plasmacytoid appearance)
Clumped chromatin with a vague nucleolus-like condensation
Moderate pale-to-medium blue cytoplasm with slight perinuclear clearing
Single large, round, discrete red-purple azurophilic granule in the cytoplasm
Background normochromic red cells with an occasional crenated cell
64188.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a plasmacytoid lymphocyte with an eccentric nucleus, clumped chromatin, and moderate blue cytoplasm containing a single large, well-defined azurophilic granule. The surrounding red cells are normochromic with occasional crenated forms. A single oversized cytoplasmic granule of this type in a lymphocyte, especially when similar giant granules are found in neutrophils and monocytes, is consistent with Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: LGLs have several smaller azurophilic granules in abundant pale cytoplasm rather than one giant granule.
Alder-Reilly lymphocytes show multiple dark granules, often within vacuoles, and neutrophils have diffuse coarse dark granulation.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytoid lymphocyte or plasma cell with Russell body
ddx.vs: Russell bodies are pale pink to colorless immunoglobulin globules, often larger and multiple, rather than a dense azurophilic granule.
These appear in myeloid blasts or dysplastic granulocytes of AML/MDS rather than in lymphocytes of a child with albinism and immunodeficiency.

exam.answer_en: Chediak-Higashi syndrome — lymphocyte with a single giant, well-defined azurophilic granule
pearls_zh: 考法：淋巴球胞質內一顆超大紅紫色顆粒，問診斷；需同時在嗜中性球、單核球、嗜酸性球找到巨大顆粒才支持 CHS。
功能缺陷：NK 與 cytotoxic T 細胞 degranulation 異常，是 CHS 易進入 HLH 樣 accelerated phase 的原因。
嗜中性球趨化與殺菌能力下降、常見中度 neutropenia，導致 S. aureus 等化膿性感染反覆發生。
與 Griscelli syndrome type 2、Hermansky-Pudlak syndrome 同屬「albinism＋免疫或血小板異常」考點；CHS 的特徵是巨大顆粒。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 large granular lymphocyte：LGL 胞質內為多顆細小嗜天青顆粒，CHS 淋巴球則是少數一至數顆異常巨大顆粒；也要與 plasma cell 的 Russell body（均質粉紅、非紫紅顆粒）區分。

quiz.q: CHS 病人淋巴球出現此巨大顆粒，與哪種致命併發症的免疫缺陷有關？
quiz.a: NK/CTL 脫顆粒異常，易發生 HLH 樣 accelerated phase。

64124.recognize_zh: 周邊血片中單一顆中大型不成熟細胞，核圓、染色質呈細顆粒點狀、胞質為一圈淡色邊緣；題目提到異常前骨髓球與 Auer 小體，但這張圖的解析度下看不清楚 Auer 小體或粗大嗜天青顆粒，需要搭配其他視野判讀。
features: Single medium-to-large immature-appearing cell among red cells, about 2 times red cell diameter
High N:C ratio with a round, slightly eccentric nucleus
Finely stippled, granular-appearing chromatin; nucleoli not clearly resolved
Thin rim of pale cytoplasm; distinct azurophilic granules or Auer rods cannot be confirmed at this resolution
Red cells show stacking consistent with a thicker area of the film
64124.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single medium-to-large immature cell with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, a round nucleus with finely stippled chromatin, and a thin rim of pale cytoplasm. Heavy azurophilic granulation, bilobed nuclear folding, and Auer rods described for this case are not clearly resolved in this image, likely because of focus and resolution. The image alone therefore does not permit confident classification beyond a circulating immature myeloid-appearing cell. If abnormal promyelocytes with Auer rods are confirmed on the film, urgent evaluation for acute promyelocytic leukemia (coagulation studies, PML::RARA testing) is warranted.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have fine chromatin, visible nucleoli, and few or no granules, whereas APL promyelocytes are packed with coarse azurophilic granules and often multiple Auer rods (faggot cells).
Normal promyelocytes have a paranuclear hof, an eccentric nucleus with nucleolus, and never contain Auer rods.
Hypogranular APL cells have bilobed or butterfly-shaped nuclei with sparse visible granules, requiring PML::RARA testing to confirm.
Lymphoblasts lack granules and Auer rods and are MPO-negative, TdT-positive.

64060.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆早期紅血球前驅細胞（前紅血球母細胞／嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞），細胞質深藍、邊緣集中許多圓形清晰空泡，部分顆粒球前驅細胞也見空泡，符合銅缺乏引起的造血前驅細胞空泡化。
features: Cluster of early erythroid precursors (pronormoblasts/basophilic normoblasts) with round nuclei, fine chromatin and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Multiple discrete, round, clear cytoplasmic vacuoles in the erythroid precursors, concentrated at the cell periphery
Scattered granulocytic precursors (promyelocyte, myelocytes, bands) with some showing occasional vacuoles
Erythroid and myeloid maturation present; no increase in blasts evident in this field
Background red cells and fine stain precipitate/debris
64060.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows granulocytic and erythroid precursors with maturation. Several early erythroid precursors with deeply basophilic cytoplasm contain multiple round, sharply demarcated clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, and occasional granulocytic precursors are also vacuolated. There is no obvious increase in blasts or overt megaloblastic change in this field. In a child on long-term parenteral nutrition with pancytopenia, findings are consistent with copper deficiency; similar vacuolization may be seen with zinc toxicity, alcohol, chloramphenicol, Pearson syndrome or myelodysplastic neoplasm, so serum copper and ceruloplasmin should be checked and iron stain assessed for ring sideroblasts.

ddx.vs: MDS shows multilineage dysplasia (hypolobated megakaryocytes, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, nuclear budding) with possible increased blasts and clonal cytogenetics, whereas copper deficiency vacuoles reverse with copper replacement.
Pearson syndrome shows identical vacuoles with ring sideroblasts in infancy together with exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and mitochondrial DNA deletion.
These produce the same pronormoblast vacuoles and are distinguished by exposure history.
Burkitt cells are uniform lymphoid blasts with sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and absent maturation rather than vacuolated erythroid precursors within a maturing marrow.

exam.answer_en: Copper deficiency — cytoplasmic vacuolization of early erythroid and granulocytic precursors
pearls_zh: 考法：指早期紅血球前驅細胞胞質內多顆清楚圓空泡，問原因；在長期 TPN、胃繞道手術或補鋅病史下，答 copper deficiency。
檢查：serum copper 與 ceruloplasmin 降低；鐵染色可見 ring sideroblasts；血液常見貧血與 neutropenia，血小板多較不受影響。
Zinc 過量（如含鋅假牙黏著劑、鋅補充劑）誘導腸上皮 metallothionein 截留銅，導致續發性銅缺乏，需同時驗 serum zinc。
神經學：可合併 myeloneuropathy，表現似 B12 缺乏的 subacute combined degeneration；補銅後血球通常可恢復，神經症狀則可能殘留。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤診為 MDS（空泡、ring sideroblasts、dysplasia 都可重疊）：copper deficiency 核型正常、無增加 blasts、補銅後可逆；另需鑑別酒精、chloramphenicol 與 Pearson syndrome 的空泡。

quiz.q: 長期 TPN 的兒童全血球低下，骨髓前驅細胞出現多顆胞質空泡，最可能的營養缺乏為何？應驗哪兩項血清檢查？
quiz.a: Copper deficiency；serum copper 與 ceruloplasmin（並可驗 zinc）。

63996.recognize_zh: H&E 中是一片單調、小到中型的淋巴細胞，核輪廓略不規則、染色質濃縮、胞質稀少，缺乏大型中心母細胞或免疫母細胞，間有散在粉紅色上皮樣組織球；右側 cyclin D1 呈瀰漫性核陽性，符合被套細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse monotonous sheet of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells
Slightly irregular to angulated nuclear contours with condensed to moderately dispersed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant cytoplasm; absence of admixed large centroblasts, immunoblasts, or proliferation centers
Scattered single pink epithelioid histiocytes and thin hyalinized vessels
Cyclin D1 IHC: strong diffuse nuclear positivity in the neoplastic cells
63996.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, monotonous infiltrate of small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclear contours, condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and scant cytoplasm. Large transformed cells and proliferation centers are not seen, while scattered single epithelioid histiocytes and small hyalinized vessels are present. Cyclin D1 immunostain shows strong diffuse nuclear positivity in the neoplastic cells. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma; assessment for blastoid/pleomorphic features, Ki-67, p53, and SOX11 is recommended for prognostication.

ddx.vs: SLL shows round nuclei with proliferation centers containing prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts and is cyclin D1 negative (except in proliferation centers) and LEF1 positive.
Follicular lymphoma has cleaved centrocytes admixed with centroblasts in a follicular pattern and is CD10/BCL6 positive and cyclin D1 negative.
Marginal zone lymphoma shows monocytoid cells with pale cytoplasm, plasmacytic differentiation, and is CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.

ddx.dx: Cyclin D1-positive plasma cell neoplasm or hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These can express cyclin D1 but show plasma cell or hairy cell cytology with CD138 or annexin A1/CD103 expression, respectively, rather than monotonous small lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: Mantle cell lymphoma — monotonous small-to-medium irregular lymphoid cells with pink histiocytes and diffuse nuclear cyclin D1
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 單調小細胞加上 cyclin D1 核陽性，問診斷與背後染色體；答 MCL，t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH。
表型：CD5+、CD23 通常陰性、CD200 常陰性或弱、SOX11+、cyclin D1+；cyclin D1 陰性 MCL 可有 CCND2 重排，以 SOX11 陽性協助診斷。
預後因子：Ki-67 ≥30%、TP53 突變/缺失、blastoid 或 pleomorphic 變異、MIPI 分數；TP53 異常者對傳統化療反應差。
Leukemic non-nodal MCL 多為 SOX11 陰性、IGHV 突變、臨床較惰性；BTK inhibitors 是 MCL 常考的標靶治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 CLL/SLL 混淆（兩者皆 CD5+）；CLL 有 proliferation centers、CD23+、CD200+ 且 cyclin D1 陰性，MCL 單調無增生中心且 cyclin D1/SOX11 陽性。

quiz.q: 右側免疫染色呈瀰漫核陽性的抗體為何？其對應的染色體轉位是什麼？
quiz.a: Cyclin D1；t(11;14)(q13;q32) CCND1::IGH

63804.recognize_zh: 這張 CD45 免疫染色中，片狀排列的大型腫瘤細胞呈強而完整的細胞膜陽性（膜狀棕色環繞淡藍色細胞核）；典型古典何杰金淋巴瘤（cHL）的 RS 細胞應為 CD45 陰性，因此這種瀰漫陽性支持灰區淋巴瘤（gray zone lymphoma）。
features: Sheets of large neoplastic cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei
Strong, diffuse, complete membranous CD45 staining on the large cells
Cohesive sheet-like growth without a prominent small-lymphocyte background in this field
Stained stromal/vascular elements interspersed; section edge at lower left
63804.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD45 (LCA) on a tissue biopsy shows sheets of large atypical lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei. The large neoplastic cells demonstrate strong, diffuse membranous CD45 positivity. This is contrary to the CD45-negative Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells of classical Hodgkin lymphoma and, together with the H&E and other immunostains, supports a diagnosis of B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between DLBCL and classical Hodgkin lymphoma (gray zone lymphoma). Morphologic detail of the tumor cells is limited on this single immunostain.

ddx.vs: HRS cells of cHL are CD45 negative, CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and are scattered in an inflammatory background rather than forming CD45+ sheets.
PMBL is also CD45+ with sheets of large cells but has strong CD20/CD79a, OCT2/BOB1 and a consistent DLBCL morphology with compartmentalizing sclerosis, lacking cHL-like areas or CD15.
ALCL is CD30 strong and uniform with T-cell/cytotoxic markers and absent PAX5, and CD45 may be variable.
Non-hematopoietic tumors are CD45 negative and express keratin or S100/melanocytic markers.

63676.recognize_zh: G 帶染色核型圖中，第 5 號染色體一條正常、另一條（紅色箭頭）長臂明顯變短，代表 5q 缺失（del(5q)）；性染色體為 XX，其他染色體未見明顯異常，是 del(5q) MDS 的細胞遺傳學證據，非形態學影像。
features: G-banded karyogram with chromosomes arranged 1-22 plus sex chromosomes
One chromosome 5 shows a markedly shortened long arm with loss of distal q-arm bands (red arrow)
Homologous chromosome 5 retains normal length and banding
Two X chromosomes (female karyotype); no Y
No other numerical or structural abnormality apparent in this single metaphase
63676.describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram of a single metaphase. One homolog of chromosome 5 shows an interstitial/terminal loss of long-arm material (arrow), while the partner chromosome 5 is normal; the sex chromosomes are XX and no additional abnormalities are apparent in this cell. Precise breakpoints cannot be determined at this image resolution, but the pattern is typical of del(5)(q13q33)-type deletions. Findings are consistent with 46,XX,del(5q), which, as a sole abnormality (or with one additional abnormality other than -7/del(7q)) and without increased blasts, supports myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: A derivative chromosome 5 from an unbalanced translocation carries extra banded material from another chromosome, which requires FISH or SKY to exclude when banding is ambiguous.
Therapy-related or high-risk MDS/AML shows del(5q) with three or more additional abnormalities (often TP53-associated), whereas this metaphase shows an isolated deletion.
Monosomy 5 shows complete loss of one chromosome 5, whereas here both homologs are present with only long-arm shortening.

exam.answer_en: 46,XX,del(5q) — G-banded karyogram with loss of 5q material on one chromosome 5 (MDS with isolated del(5q))
pearls_zh: 判讀方法：逐對比較同源染色體長度與帶型；箭頭處 5 號長臂變短而短臂與著絲點正常，其他染色體無增減，寫作 46,XX,del(5)(q…)。
考法重點：常見缺失區段涵蓋 5q31–q33；標準分析需計數足夠中期細胞（一般 20 個），結構異常需 ≥2 個細胞才算克隆。
FISH 輔助：核型失敗或中期細胞不足時，可用 5q31 探針（如 EGR1）搭配 5p 對照探針偵測 del(5q)。
解讀情境：單獨 del(5q) 或加一個非 -7/del(7q) 異常且芽細胞低 → MDS-5q，預後較佳；若在複雜核型中並常合併 TP53，預後極差。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤讀為 monosomy 5 或不平衡轉位：monosomy 5 會少一整條，不平衡轉位則缺失物質接到他條染色體上；本圖為同一條 5 號長臂縮短、染色體總數正常。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指是哪一號染色體的何種異常？
quiz.a: 第 5 號染色體長臂缺失，del(5q)

63612.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的原始細胞（blast）核質比很高、染色質細緻，核的一側可看到一塊顏色較淡、像杯口凹陷的區域（cup-like invagination），周圍還有多顆類似的原始細胞。
features: Medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Arrowed blast shows a pale, clear nuclear invagination occupying part of the nucleus (cup-like morphology)
Finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this resolution
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules visible in the blasts
Several similar blasts in the field indicating a blast-rich aspirate
63612.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows numerous medium-sized blasts with high N:C ratio, finely dispersed chromatin and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm. The arrowed blast displays a pale nuclear invagination spanning a portion of the nucleus, imparting a cup-like appearance; Auer rods are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, a morphology associated with NPM1 and FLT3-ITD mutations; confirmation requires flow cytometry (typically CD34-negative, HLA-DR-negative) and molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Microgranular APL cells have bilobed or butterfly-shaped nuclear folding and faint granules with strong MPO, whereas cup-like blasts have a single invagination and PML::RARA is absent.
Monoblasts and promonocytes have more abundant grey-blue cytoplasm and folded, convoluted nuclei rather than a discrete cup-shaped clear invagination.
Cup-like blasts lack accompanying multilineage dysplasia and are typically CD34-negative with NPM1 mutation.
Lymphoblasts may show nuclear clefts but are MPO-negative and express TdT and CD19/CD10 on flow cytometry.

exam.answer_en: AML with NPM1 mutation (suggested) — marrow blasts with cup-like nuclear invaginations
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭處核側淡染凹陷的芽細胞，問「此形態與哪些突變相關？」答 NPM1 與 FLT3-ITD；再問下一步則答 flow 加分子檢查。
Flow：常 CD34 陰性、HLA-DR 陰性，CD33、CD117 陽性、MPO 陽性；此表型需以 PML::RARA 排除 APL。
分子追蹤：NPM1 突變可用 qPCR 作為 MRD 標記，治療後轉錄本持續或上升提示復發風險。
分類：WHO 5th 中 AML with NPM1 mutation 不需芽細胞 ≥20%；ICC 2022 要求 ≥10%。預後上無 FLT3-ITD 者屬 ELN 2022 favorable。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 B-ALL 淋巴母細胞：lymphoblast 細胞質極少、MPO 陰性、CD19/CD10/TdT 陽性，無杯口狀淡染凹陷；也須以 PML::RARA 排除 microgranular APL。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指芽細胞核的特徵形態叫什麼？最常伴隨的兩個基因異常為何？
quiz.a: Cup-like blast（杯口狀核凹陷）；NPM1 突變與 FLT3-ITD

63548.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中央靠近脂肪空泡處有兩顆並排、均質亮粉紅色的圓形球體，就是細胞質內免疫球蛋白堆積形成的 Russell bodies；周圍是細胞密度高的造血組織夾雜多顆核偏心的漿細胞。
features: Two adjacent round, homogeneous, glassy eosinophilic globules (Russell bodies) near an adipocyte
Hypercellular marrow with mixed hematopoietic elements including erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and maturing granulocytes
Scattered cells with eccentric nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm consistent with plasma cells
Occasional larger cells with vesicular nuclei; no sheets of atypical plasma cells clearly identifiable
Image resolution is moderate and limits cytologic detail
63548.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoietic elements between adipocytes. Near the center, two adjacent round, homogeneous, brightly eosinophilic intracytoplasmic globules are present, consistent with Russell bodies. Scattered plasma cells with eccentric nuclei are identified, but sheets of plasma cells are not clearly evident and resolution limits cytologic detail. Russell bodies reflect immunoglobulin accumulation in distended endoplasmic reticulum and are seen in both reactive and neoplastic plasma cell proliferations; CD138 and kappa/lambda staining are needed to assess plasma cell burden and clonality.

ddx.vs: Erythrocytes are smaller, biconcave and paler centrally, whereas Russell bodies are larger, spherical, uniformly dense and PAS-positive.
Dutcher bodies overlie or invaginate the nucleus as apparent intranuclear inclusions, whereas these globules are separate from the nucleus in the cytoplasm.
Eosinophils have many small coarse orange granules and bilobed nuclei rather than one or two large smooth homogeneous globules.

63484.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中雙側大腿有大片融合的紫紅色瘀斑（ecchymoses），邊緣轉為黃綠色，代表新舊出血並存；左上方另見少量點狀出血（petechiae）。若血小板與凝血檢查正常，需考慮血管性或營養缺乏（如壞血病）原因。
features: Large confluent purple-red ecchymoses over both thighs
Yellow-green discoloration at the margins indicating resolving, older hemorrhage
Mottled, finely stippled texture within the bruised areas
A few scattered petechiae on the upper left thigh
No visible hematoma swelling, wound, or skin breakdown
63484.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows extensive, bilateral, confluent ecchymoses over the thighs with purple-red central areas and yellow-green borders, indicating hemorrhage of varying ages. A few petechiae are present on the upper thigh. No visible trauma, open wounds, or tense hematomas are seen. This is a clinical image without cellular morphology; the pattern of spontaneous large-area skin bleeding warrants platelet count, PT/aPTT, fibrinogen, factor XIII and von Willebrand studies, and if normal, evaluation for vascular fragility or nutritional deficiency such as scurvy.

ddx.vs: Presents with large spontaneous soft-tissue bleeds in older adults but has an isolated prolonged aPTT that does not correct on mixing and a low factor VIII with an inhibitor.
Bleeding is predominantly petechial and mucocutaneous with a markedly low platelet count, rather than large ecchymoses with a normal count.
Accompanied by perifollicular hemorrhages, corkscrew hairs, and gum disease with normal platelet count and coagulation tests.

ddx.dx: Anticoagulant or warfarin/vitamin K deficiency coagulopathy
ddx.vs: Shows a prolonged PT/INR that corrects with vitamin K or plasma, with a relevant medication or malabsorption history.

63356.recognize_zh: 黏液胭脂紅（mucicarmine）染色下，淋巴球整體呈紅色，但細胞邊緣的球形包涵體保持蒼白、未被染成紅色，表示包涵體不含黏液（mucin）；背景的小紅點為血小板。
features: Small round lymphocytes stained diffusely red-magenta by the carmine/counterstain
Pale, unstained globular cytoplasmic inclusions at the cell periphery, singly or in small groups
No carmine-positive (mucin) material within the inclusions
Numerous small scattered red-stained platelets; green arrow indicates a small platelet-sized particle next to a lymphocyte
Red cells are faint ghost outlines in the background
63356.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained with mucicarmine shows small lymphocytes containing pale, globular cytoplasmic inclusions that fail to take up the carmine stain. No mucin-positive material is identified within the inclusions. Scattered platelets are present, and red cells appear only as faint outlines. Findings indicate that the cytoplasmic inclusions in these CLL lymphocytes are mucin-negative.

ddx.vs: Signet-ring cells contain mucicarmine-positive mucin vacuoles and are large epithelial cells, not small lymphocytes.
Lipid vacuoles stain with Oil Red O and are seen in neutrophils and monocytes as well, whereas these inclusions are confined to lymphocytes.
Immunoglobulin globules are typically PAS-positive and demonstrate light-chain restriction by immunocytochemistry, which separates them from stain-negative inclusions.
Storage-disease vacuoles are multiple small punched-out vacuoles in otherwise normal lymphocytes and may stain with PAS or toluidine blue, unlike the large globules here.

63292.recognize_zh: 這張鐵染色（Prussian blue，核固紅對比染色）看起來是骨髓抹片而非切片：有核細胞核呈粉紅色，只見零星細小的藍色鐵顆粒，未見環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）或明顯的巨噬細胞鐵儲存。
features: Nucleated marrow cells with pink nuclear fast red-counterstained nuclei in a smear background of red cells
Only rare, fine, scattered extracellular blue iron granules
No perinuclear rings of blue granules in erythroid precursors (no ring sideroblasts identified in this field)
No iron-laden macrophage or particle included in this field, limiting assessment of storage iron
Out-of-focus areas and uneven thickness limit evaluation
63292.describe_en: Iron stain (Prussian blue with nuclear fast red counterstain) of what appears to be a bone marrow aspirate smear, rather than a core biopsy section as labeled, shows scattered nucleated cells with only rare fine extracellular blue granules. No ring sideroblasts are identified among the nucleated cells in this field, and no marrow particle or macrophage is present to grade storage iron. Evaluation is limited by focus and the small number of cells. Findings do not demonstrate ring sideroblasts in this field; a full assessment of storage iron and sideroblasts on particle-containing aspirate smears is required.

ddx.dx: Ring sideroblasts (e.g. MDS with SF3B1 mutation)
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts show five or more blue granules encircling at least one-third of the erythroblast nucleus, which is not seen here.
Absent storage iron can only be concluded on adequate particles without blue staining, which are not included in this field.
Precipitate is irregular, refractile and lies in varying planes, whereas true hemosiderin granules are uniform blue-green and associated with cells or particles.

63228.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片高倍下成片的漿細胞：核圓、明顯偏位，染色質呈車輪狀粗塊，細胞質豐富、深嗜鹼性並可見核旁淡染區（hof）與小空泡；漿細胞大量取代正常造血細胞，支持多發性骨髓瘤。
features: Sheets of plasma cells replacing normal hematopoietic elements
Round, eccentrically placed nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin; occasional small nucleolus
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with perinuclear hof in many cells
Scattered small clear cytoplasmic vacuoles; no Russell bodies or crystals evident
Mostly mature-appearing cells with mild variation in size; rare immature form with finer chromatin
Few residual small lymphocytes/erythroid precursors and an eosinophilic granulocyte; fat spaces present
63228.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows sheets of plasma cells that largely replace the normal hematopoietic elements. The plasma cells have round, eccentrically placed nuclei with coarse clock-face chromatin, occasional small nucleoli, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent perinuclear hofs and scattered small vacuoles. Most cells appear mature, with only mild variation in size and rare cells showing finer chromatin. Only a few residual lymphocytes, erythroid precursors and a granulocyte are present. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm such as multiple myeloma, pending quantification on an adequate aspirate and clonality assessment (kappa/lambda).

ddx.vs: Reactive plasmacytosis rarely exceeds 10-20%, plasma cells are scattered or perivascular rather than in sheets, and they are polytypic for kappa and lambda.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with a clonal B-cell component (CD19/CD20+) and MYD88 L265P, not a pure sheet of plasma cells.
Osteoblasts occur in cohesive clusters, are larger with finer chromatin, and have a clear zone located away from the nucleus rather than a juxtanuclear hof.

Plasmablastic lymphoma cells are large with fine chromatin, prominent central nucleoli and high mitotic activity, often EBER-positive in an immunocompromised host, unlike the mature plasma cells here.

exam.answer_en: Multiple myeloma — sheets of plasma cells with eccentric clock-face nuclei, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hof replacing marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：指成片細胞問漿細胞三要素（偏心核、車輪狀染色質、核旁 hof），再問下一步：漿細胞比例計數與 kappa/lambda 克隆性。
IMWG：clonal BMPC ≥10%（或活檢證實 plasmacytoma）加上 CRAB（高血鈣、腎功能不全、貧血、溶骨病灶）或 SLiM（BMPC ≥60%、FLC ratio ≥100、MRI >1 個 ≥5 mm 病灶）。
Flow 異常漿細胞：CD38+、CD138+、CD19−、CD45− 或弱，常異常表現 CD56，細胞質輕鏈限制。
FISH（CD138 純化後）：high-risk 包括 t(4;14)、t(14;16)、del(17p)、1q gain/amp；t(11;14) 與 venetoclax 反應相關。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與反應性漿細胞增多或造骨細胞混淆：反應性漿細胞散在、多株且通常不超過 10–20%；造骨細胞成簇、淡染區遠離核。

quiz.q: 圖中漿細胞核旁的淡染區稱為什麼？對應哪個胞器？
quiz.a: Perinuclear hof；Golgi apparatus

63164.recognize_zh: 拼圖顯示骨髓瘤少見形態：1A–C 漿細胞胞質內有成束針狀、類似 Auer rod 的結晶；2A 周邊血為類淋巴漿細胞樣小細胞，2B–C 骨髓切片實性增生的中型非典型細胞；3A 周邊血漿細胞表面有毛狀突起（inset），3B–C 為瀰漫間質浸潤的小到中型漿細胞樣細胞。
features: 1A-C (aspirate): plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hof and bundles of slender needle-like, Auer rod-like cytoplasmic crystalline inclusions
2A (PB): small lymphoplasmacytoid cells with condensed chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
2B-C (trephine, H&E): solidly packed hypercellular marrow with medium-sized atypical cells having irregular nuclei, coarse chromatin and scant cytoplasm
3A (PB): circulating cells with irregular hair-like cytoplasmic projections (inset), mimicking hairy cells
3B-C (trephine, H&E): diffuse interstitial infiltrate of small to medium plasmacytoid cells with high N:C ratio, with a residual megakaryocyte
63164.describe_en: Composite figure of three plasma cell myeloma cases with unusual morphology. In case 1, the bone marrow aspirate shows atypical plasma cells containing bundles of needle-like crystalline cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Auer rods. In case 2, the peripheral blood shows small lymphoplasmacytoid cells and the trephine biopsy shows solid sheets of medium-sized atypical cells with irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm. In case 3, circulating plasma cells show hair-like cytoplasmic projections, and the trephine shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of small to medium plasmacytoid cells. Findings are consistent with morphologic variants of plasma cell myeloma that can mimic acute myeloid leukemia, lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma and hairy cell leukemia; CD138, light chain and flow cytometric studies are required.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with Auer rods (for case 1)
ddx.vs: AML blasts with Auer rods have fine chromatin and MPO positivity, whereas these crystal-containing cells have clock-face chromatin, a hof and CD138/light chain restriction.

LPL contains a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid cells and plasma cells with CD19/CD20 positive B cells and MYD88 L265P, whereas myeloma cells are CD19-negative, CD20 usually negative and MYD88 wild-type.
Hairy cells are CD20, CD11c, CD25, CD103 and annexin A1 positive with BRAF V600E, whereas hairy plasma cells are CD138 positive with cytoplasmic light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell or other small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These express pan-B markers (CD19/CD20) and surface light chains, and mantle cell lymphoma shows cyclin D1 with SOX11, while plasma cell myeloma lacks pan-B markers.

63100.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片為富細胞、左移的顆粒球系增生，並有嗜鹼性球與嗜酸性球（B、C），呈 CML 樣貌；但核型（D）未見費城染色體，而 FISH（E、F）仍顯示 BCR::ABL1 融合訊號位於 der(9) 上，提示隱匿性插入或複雜易位造成的 Ph 陰性 CML。
features: Panel A: hypercellular aspirate particle with abundant cellular trails
Panels B-C: granulocytic proliferation across maturation stages (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands) with basophils and eosinophils
Panel D: G-banded karyotype without a visible Philadelphia chromosome (apparently normal 46,XY)
Panel E: interphase/metaphase dual-color FISH with fusion signals in nuclei
Panel F: metaphase FISH localizing a BCR::ABL1 fusion signal to der(9), with both chromosome 22 homologs labeled
63100.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears are hypercellular with a granulocytic proliferation showing the full spectrum of maturation, accompanied by basophils and eosinophils, a picture typical of chronic myeloid leukemia. Conventional karyotype does not show a Philadelphia chromosome. Dual-color BCR/ABL1 FISH nevertheless demonstrates fusion signals, and metaphase FISH localizes the fusion to a derivative chromosome 9 rather than chromosome 22. Findings are consistent with Philadelphia-negative, BCR::ABL1-positive CML arising through a cryptic insertion or complex rearrangement; RT-PCR for transcript type is recommended for monitoring.

ddx.vs: aCML has marked dysgranulopoiesis without basophilia and is BCR::ABL1-negative, whereas FISH here shows a BCR::ABL1 fusion.
CNL shows predominantly mature neutrophils with few precursors, no basophilia, CSF3R mutation and absence of BCR::ABL1.
Reactive neutrophilia has toxic granulation, no basophilia and no clonal BCR::ABL1 fusion.
Classic cases show a visible Ph chromosome on karyotype with fusion on der(22), while here the karyotype is Ph-negative and fusion localizes to der(9).

63036.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多個中到大型的異常前骨髓細胞，核呈雙葉、摺疊或蝴蝶形（bilobed），細胞質淡紫、顆粒細小不明顯，視野中看不到 Auer 小體，符合微顆粒型急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）；右下另有一個顆粒粗大、正在破裂的細胞。
features: Numerous medium to large abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed, folded or butterfly-shaped nuclei
Fine chromatin with indistinct nucleoli
Moderate lilac cytoplasm with sparse, fine dust-like granules (hypogranular); no Auer rods identified in this field
One disrupted cell (lower right) with coarse purple-red granules spilling from the cytoplasm
Background red cells show crenation (echinocytes); platelets markedly decreased
63036.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a leukocytosis composed of medium to large abnormal cells with bilobed, folded or butterfly-shaped nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale lilac cytoplasm containing only fine, inconspicuous granules. No Auer rods are identified in this field, and one disrupted cell with coarse azurophilic granules is present. Platelets are markedly reduced and background red cells show crenation. Findings are consistent with the microgranular (hypogranular) variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia; urgent PML::RARA confirmation and coagulation studies are indicated.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts and promonocytes have folded nuclei but gray-blue cytoplasm with fine vacuoles, are strongly nonspecific esterase positive and HLA-DR positive, whereas microgranular APL cells are strongly MPO positive and HLA-DR/CD34 negative.
Classic APL cells are packed with coarse granules obscuring the nucleus and often contain faggot cells, while the microgranular variant shows sparse fine granules and high WBC.
NPM1-mutated AML may be HLA-DR/CD34 negative but lacks bilobed promyelocytes and PML::RARA.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell or large cell lymphoma in blood
ddx.vs: Lymphoid cells are MPO negative with basophilic or hairy cytoplasm and B- or T-cell markers.

exam.answer_en: Microgranular variant of acute promyelocytic leukemia — abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed/butterfly nuclei, sparse fine granules, marked thrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：此型 Auer rod 與粗顆粒常不明顯，考官會問「看不到 faggot cell 可以診斷 APL 嗎」：可以，靠雙葉核形態＋MPO 強陽性＋PML::RARA。
右下破裂細胞露出粗大嗜天青顆粒，提示細胞質其實含顆粒，只是在完整細胞中細微不易見；電顯可見次微米級顆粒。
高 WBC 的微顆粒型屬高風險 APL，誘導治療常在 ATRA＋ATO 基礎上加入化療（如 anthracycline）或 gemtuzumab ozogamicin 以降低 differentiation syndrome。
血小板明顯減少且 fibrinogen 低時出血風險最高；APL 早期死亡主因為顱內出血，應在確診前即處理凝血病變。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 NPM1 突變 AML 的 cup-like blasts 或 monocytic leukemia；cup-like 為核凹陷而非雙葉，單核球系 HLA-DR 陽性、NSE 陽性，APL 則 HLA-DR 陰性。

quiz.q: 此片沒有明顯 Auer rod，憑哪個核形態特徵懷疑 APL？確診用什麼檢查？
quiz.a: 雙葉／蝴蝶形（bilobed, butterfly）核；PML::RARA 以 FISH 或 RT-PCR 確認

62972.recognize_zh: 肌肉切片低倍下，藍色的淋巴細胞浸潤沿肌束之間的肌內膜蔓延，呈網狀包圍單一肌纖維；CD20 與 CD10 以相同網狀分布強陽性，高倍 CD10 下為大型淋巴球，神經切片可見神經外膜血管旁淋巴細胞聚集，符合 DLBCL 侵犯肌肉與神經。
features: Skeletal muscle (A): dense lymphoid infiltrate dissecting between individual muscle fibers in an interstitial, lace-like pattern
CD20 (B) and CD10 (C): strong membranous staining of the same infiltrate outlining the muscle fibers
CD10 high power (E): sheets of large lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei and membranous positivity surrounding atrophic/unstained myofibers
Sural nerve (D): nerve fascicles with an adjacent perivascular/epineurial aggregate of lymphoid cells
Preserved muscle fiber outlines without obvious myonecrosis at this magnification
62972.describe_en: Biopsy of the gastrocnemius muscle shows a diffuse interstitial infiltrate of lymphoid cells percolating between individual skeletal muscle fibers in a reticular pattern. At high power the infiltrate consists of large lymphoid cells with vesicular nuclei that are strongly positive for CD20 and CD10. The sural nerve biopsy shows an epineurial, perivascular aggregate of similar lymphoid cells adjacent to nerve fascicles. Findings are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (germinal center B-cell phenotype by CD10) involving skeletal muscle and peripheral nerve (neurolymphomatosis).

ddx.vs: Myositis shows small T-cells (CD8+) invading non-necrotic fibers with myofiber degeneration, not sheets of large CD20+/CD10+ B-cells.
Vasculitis shows transmural mixed inflammation with fibrinoid necrosis of vessel walls rather than a monotonous large B-cell aggregate.
Burkitt lymphoma is also CD10+ but has medium-sized monotonous cells, starry-sky pattern, Ki-67 ~100% and MYC rearrangement without BCL2.
Rhabdomyosarcoma is desmin/myogenin-positive and CD20-negative.

62908.recognize_zh: 一排四個顆粒性白血球，細胞質內都有深紫黑色的粗顆粒；右側兩個細胞的黑色顆粒集中成帶狀覆蓋在核的一側，左側細胞核較圓、似較不成熟的骨髓系細胞；多個細胞同時出現相同黑色團塊，支持為外來色素而非單一細胞異常。
features: Four granulocytes in a row, including a band/segmented form and cells with rounder nuclei suggestive of metamyelocyte or myelocyte stage
Coarse dark purple-black granular clumps, in the right two cells aggregated in a band over one side of the nucleus
Background fine pink-lilac granules in the remaining cytoplasm
Occasional smudged pale cell and scattered platelets
Red cells normochromic with some echinocytes
62908.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows four granulocytes at different stages of maturation, including forms with rounder nuclei consistent with immature myeloid cells, each containing coarse dark purple-black cytoplasmic granular material. In two cells the dark material is aggregated in a band overlying one side of the nucleus, with finer pink granules in the remaining cytoplasm. A smudged cell, scattered platelets, and echinocytes are present in the background. The shared, clumped dark material across neutrophils and immature granulocytes, in a septic patient sampled after iodinated contrast, is consistent with pigment inclusions with left-shifted toxic granulopoiesis.

ddx.vs: Basophils have granules evenly overlying the whole cell and are not accompanied by a left-shifted neutrophil series with identical clumps.
Toxic granules are finer and diffusely scattered, lacking discrete black aggregates.
Hemozoin is brown-black and refractile, usually with visible intraerythrocytic parasites.

62844.recognize_zh: MPO 免疫染色下，大多數細胞呈棕色胞質陽性，代表骨髓以顆粒球系（myeloid）細胞為主；夾雜其間的藍色陰性細胞則包含紅血球系前驅細胞與漿細胞，這張圖本身不能診斷骨髓瘤。
features: Immunohistochemistry for myeloperoxidase (MPO) on a hypercellular marrow core
Majority of cells show granular brown cytoplasmic MPO positivity, variable in intensity
Positive cells range from larger immature forms to smaller maturing granulocytes
Interspersed MPO-negative cells with blue hematoxylin-counterstained nuclei, some in small aggregates
No fat spaces in the field; densely packed cellularity
62844.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for myeloperoxidase on the bone marrow trephine highlights a predominance of MPO-positive granulocytic cells with variable cytoplasmic staining intensity across maturing forms. Interspersed MPO-negative cells, including small clusters, are present and likely represent erythroid precursors and the plasma cell infiltrate. MPO does not stain plasma cells, so this stain alone does not quantify the neoplastic population. Findings indicate myeloid preponderance in a hypercellular marrow, which in this case accompanies plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia or other MPN
ddx.vs: CML shows granulocytic expansion with small hypolobated megakaryocytes and BCR::ABL1, whereas here the myeloid expansion accompanies a CD138-positive clonal plasma cell population.
AML shows sheets of blasts that are often MPO positive but also CD34/CD117 positive without maturation, unlike the maturing granulocytic spectrum here.
Reactive hyperplasia shows the same MPO pattern but lacks clusters of light chain-restricted CD138-positive plasma cells.

62780.recognize_zh: 抹片中的腫瘤細胞非常大，胞質豐富嗜鹼性並有大量清楚空泡，核呈腎形或馬蹄形凹陷（hallmark cell 樣）；在一般淋巴球門檻下流式看起來正常，擴大 FSC/SSC 門檻後才抓到大型 CD4+CD30 強陽性族群，符合 ALK 陰性退行性大細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Very large atypical cells, several times the size of red cells, with moderate N:C ratio
Reniform to horseshoe-shaped, indented nuclei with fine chromatin (hallmark-like cells)
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with numerous clear, well-defined vacuoles, often clustered near the nuclear indentation
Flow with standard lymphocyte gate: small population with normal CD4/CD8 distribution
Flow with expanded high FSC/SSC gate: large CD4-positive, CD30-bright population
62780.describe_en: Smear (apparently peripheral blood) shows scattered very large atypical cells with reniform to horseshoe-shaped nuclei, fine chromatin, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous sharply defined clear vacuoles. Flow cytometry analyzed with a conventional lymphocyte gate shows only small lymphocytes with an unremarkable CD4/CD8 distribution, whereas widening the gate to include high forward and side scatter events reveals a large CD4-positive population with bright CD30 expression. Findings are consistent with involvement by a CD30-positive T-cell lymphoma, in keeping with anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-negative; ALK immunostaining and DUSP22/TP63 rearrangement studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Morphology and CD30 expression are identical, so distinction requires ALK immunostaining or ALK rearrangement testing.
Burkitt cells also have vacuolated basophilic cytoplasm but are medium-sized, round-nucleated CD10+/CD20+ B cells rather than very large CD4+ CD30+ cells with horseshoe nuclei.
Monocytic cells can be vacuolated with folded nuclei but are CD14/CD64/CD33-positive and nonspecific esterase-positive, lacking uniform bright CD30.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma cells in circulation
