ddx.vs: Non-hematopoietic tumor cells are CD45-negative and form cohesive clusters, whereas these cells are CD4-positive and CD30-bright on flow.

62716.recognize_zh: 母細胞 gate 的 CD117 對 CD34 流式圖：大多數母細胞 CD34 陰性到弱，CD117 從陰性到約 10^4 連續性部分表現；另有一小群 CD34 強陽性、CD117 部分陽性的細胞。
features: Dot plot gated on blasts: CD117-APC (x) versus CD34-PC7 (y), log scales
Dominant population CD34 negative to dim (<10^3)
CD117 heterogeneous, negative to dim-moderate (up to ~10^4) on the dominant population
Minor CD34-bright (~10^4) subset with variable CD117, including CD34+CD117+ cells
No discrete CD117-bright (mast cell-level) population
62716.describe_en: Flow cytometric dot plot of the blast gate displays CD117 versus CD34. Most blasts are CD34 negative to dim with heterogeneous dim-to-moderate CD117 expression, and a minor CD34-bright subset shows variable CD117. Partial CD117 expression supports an immature myeloid-associated phenotype but is not lineage defining. Findings are compatible with the myeloid-associated component of the reported mixed phenotype acute leukemia, B/myeloid; myeloid lineage assignment requires MPO or monocytic differentiation markers.

ddx.vs: AML lacks the strong CD19 with CD79a, CD22 or CD10 required for the B component, which must be evaluated on other tubes.
B-ALL may express CD117/CD13/CD33, but without MPO or monocytic differentiation it is not MPAL.
ETP-ALL is also CD117/CD34 positive but expresses cytoplasmic CD3 and CD7, which are not features of B/myeloid MPAL.

62588.recognize_zh: HGAL 免疫染色：左側結節內密集的腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫性細胞質陽性，右側濾泡間區小淋巴球大多陰性，界線清楚；HGAL（GCET2）是生發中心標記，陽性表示腫瘤源自生發中心 B 細胞，支持濾泡性淋巴瘤，特別適用於 CD10 陰性的病例。
features: Diffuse cytoplasmic HGAL staining in densely packed neoplastic follicular cells
Sharp demarcation between positive nodule and largely negative interfollicular zone
Scattered stronger-staining larger cells within the nodule
Interfollicular small lymphocytes and stromal cells negative
62588.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for HGAL (GCET2) shows diffuse moderate cytoplasmic staining of the densely packed neoplastic cells within a nodule, with scattered larger cells staining more intensely. The adjacent interfollicular area, composed of small lymphocytes and stromal cells, is largely negative, producing a sharp boundary. HGAL expression confirms a germinal-center B-cell derivation of the neoplastic follicles and is particularly helpful when CD10 is weak or negative. Findings support follicular lymphoma (grade 3a in this case, as graded on H&E).

ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers are also HGAL positive, so distinction relies on architecture, BCL2 negativity of germinal-center cells and polarized proliferation.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: Marginal zone lymphoma cells are HGAL/CD10/BCL6 negative, whereas residual colonized germinal centers retain HGAL.
MCL is HGAL negative (typically) and cyclin D1/SOX11 positive.

62524.recognize_zh: Steiner 銀染色使背景呈黃棕色，壞死區內可見少數細小的深色短桿狀或顆粒狀構造，可能對應 Bartonella henselae 桿菌；但此圖解析度與對焦有限，菌體難以明確辨認，須在高倍油鏡下確認成簇的彎曲桿菌。
features: Silver (Steiner) stain with yellow-brown background of granular necrotic debris
Rare tiny dark short rod-like and punctate particles within the necrotic material
No definite clusters or chains of pleomorphic bacilli resolvable at this focus and magnification
Occasional larger dark brown granules, likely pigment or debris
62524.describe_en: Steiner silver stain of the necrotic area shows a yellow-brown background of granular debris with rare tiny dark rod-like and punctate particles. Definite clusters or chains of pleomorphic bacilli are not convincingly resolved at this magnification and focus, and nonspecific silver deposition on debris cannot be excluded. In cat scratch disease, Bartonella henselae appears as small black, pleomorphic, curved bacilli in clusters, often in necrotic areas and vessel walls, best evaluated under oil immersion; a negative or equivocal silver stain does not exclude the diagnosis, and serology or PCR is more sensitive.

ddx.vs: Precipitate is irregular in size and distributed in the background and extracellularly rather than forming uniform, clustered small bacilli.
Mycobacteria stain poorly with silver impregnation and are identified with acid-fast stains.
Treponema appear as long, thin, tightly coiled spirochetes rather than short pleomorphic bacilli.

62460.recognize_zh: 淋巴球 gate 的 CD4 對 CD7 流式圖：大群藍色細胞 CD4 表現偏弱（dim）且 CD7 陰性，與綠色的正常 CD4 T 細胞（CD4 較亮、CD7 陽性為主）分開，這種 CD4 dim、CD7 缺失的族群就是 Sézary 細胞的典型表型。
features: Dot plot of CD4-FITC versus CD7-APC700 gated on lymphocytes (60.35% of total events)
Dominant blue population with dim CD4 and absent CD7 expression (CD4dim CD7-)
Green population with brighter, normal-intensity CD4 spanning CD7-negative to CD7-positive, representing residual normal CD4 T cells
Small CD4-negative CD7-positive cluster in the lower right representing CD8 T cells and NK cells
Grey CD4-negative CD7-negative events consistent with B cells or other non-T lymphocytes; non-morphologic figure
62460.describe_en: Flow cytometric plot of CD4 versus CD7 on gated lymphocytes shows a dominant population with dim CD4 and complete loss of CD7 expression. A smaller population of residual normal CD4-positive T cells with brighter CD4 and largely retained CD7 is present, along with a minor CD4-negative, CD7-positive population representing CD8 T cells and NK cells. The expanded CD4-dim, CD7-negative population is an aberrant T-cell phenotype. Together with CD26 loss, the findings are consistent with peripheral blood involvement by mycosis fungoides/Sezary syndrome.

ddx.vs: Small CD7-negative subsets occur in normal and reactive blood but rarely exceed about 10-20% of CD4 T cells and retain normal CD4 intensity, whereas here a large CD4-dim CD7- population dominates.
ATLL is also CD4+ CD7- but characteristically CD25 bright with HTLV-1 serology positive.
T-PLL usually retains strong CD7 expression and may be CD4/CD8 co-positive, unlike this CD7-negative population.

exam.answer_en: Sézary cells by flow — expanded CD4-dim, CD7-negative T-cell population distinct from normal CD4+ T cells
pearls_zh: 判讀：先確認 gate 在淋巴球，找出與正常 CD4 T 細胞分離的族群；CD4 強度變弱加上 CD7 缺失，是 Sézary 細胞的異常抗原表現。
血液分期：ISCL/EORTC 以 Sézary 細胞絕對數 ≥1000/µL 為 B2；流式常用 CD4+CD7− 或 CD4+CD26− 族群計算，並需證明血中 T 細胞克隆性。
Sézary syndrome 三要素：紅皮症、全身淋巴結腫大、血中克隆性 Sézary 細胞；與 mycosis fungoides 同屬皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤但為不同疾病。
克隆性輔助：TCR 基因重組 PCR、TRBC1 流式判讀單一 TCR β constant region，或 KIR3DL2（CD158k）陽性。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把反應性 CD4+CD7− T 細胞增加當成 Sézary 細胞：發炎性皮膚病與老年人也有 CD7 陰性亞群；應同時看 CD26 缺失、CD4 強度異常與 TCR 克隆性。

quiz.q: 圖中藍色族群呈現哪兩項異常表型？代表何種細胞？
quiz.a: CD4 dim 與 CD7 缺失；Sézary 細胞（腫瘤性 CD4 T 細胞）

62396.recognize_zh: 這是左右兩格的比較圖：左圖（典型 MAHA）可見碎裂紅血球且血小板非常少；右圖（本例）同樣有盔形與三角形碎裂紅血球（schistocytes），但血小板數量不少且可見巨大血小板，背景紅血球多呈皺縮（crenation）假影。
features: Composite figure with two Leishman-stained peripheral smear panels at 400x
Panel (a): schistocytes with markedly reduced platelets, scattered polychromatic cells and neutrophils
Panel (b): numerous helmet and triangular fragmented red cells (schistocytes) among spherocytic/crenated cells
Panel (b): platelets present in normal numbers, including large/giant platelet forms
Panel (b): widespread echinocytic crenation of red cells, likely a drying/preparation artifact limiting assessment
62396.describe_en: This composite figure compares two Leishman-stained peripheral blood smears at 400x. Panel (a) shows schistocytes with a marked paucity of platelets, as expected in typical microangiopathic hemolytic anemia. Panel (b), from the index patient, shows numerous schistocytes including helmet and triangular forms, with adequate platelets and occasional giant platelets; many red cells are crenated, which likely reflects smear artifact and hampers fine red cell assessment. Findings are consistent with a microangiopathic hemolytic process with preserved platelet count; in a patient with severe ADAMTS13 deficiency this supports an atypical presentation of TTP, and the schistocyte percentage should be quantified per ICSH criteria.

ddx.vs: Macroangiopathic hemolysis produces similar schistocytes with normal platelets, so history of valve/device and ADAMTS13 activity distinguish it.
DIC shows schistocytes with thrombocytopenia plus prolonged PT/aPTT and low fibrinogen, whereas TTP typically has normal coagulation studies.
Crenated cells retain a full round outline with evenly spaced short projections, unlike sharp-angled helmet or triangular fragments.

ddx.dx: Hereditary pyropoikilocytosis or severe iron deficiency with fragments
ddx.vs: These show microcytic fragments with other poikilocytes on a chronic background and lack intravascular hemolysis markers and ADAMTS13 deficiency.

exam.answer_en: Fragmentation hemolysis — helmet/triangular schistocytes with preserved platelets (atypical MAHA), compared with classic thrombocytopenic MAHA
pearls_zh: 考法：左右兩圖比較，問兩者共同點（schistocytes）與差異（右圖血小板不少），並要求列出「有 schistocytes 但無血小板減少」的原因。
無血小板減少的碎裂溶血：人工機械瓣膜、瓣周漏或嚴重主動脈瓣狹窄、心室輔助裝置等機械性破壞，需從病史與心臟超音波找原因。
急症：若為 schistocytes 合併血小板減少，要先考慮 TTP，立刻送 ADAMTS13（<10% 支持）並不等結果即開始血漿置換。
計數：ICSH 建議 schistocyte 比例 >1% 支持血栓性微血管病變；判讀需在紅血球不重疊、無假影的區域計數。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把皺縮（crenation/echinocyte）乾燥假影或 bite cell 誤算為 schistocytes：真正 schistocyte 有銳角或直邊斷面、無中央淡染；皺縮細胞周邊為均勻小刺突。

quiz.q: 右圖有 schistocytes 但血小板數正常，舉一個此情況最常見的原因。
quiz.a: 人工機械瓣膜/瓣周漏等心臟瓣膜或裝置造成的機械性溶血

62204.recognize_zh: 此視野中多數淋巴細胞為中型，細胞質中等量淡藍、核呈圓形或凹陷、染色質中度濃縮並可見小核仁（前淋巴球），旁邊夾雜少數小而深染的成熟淋巴球及一個分葉核嗜中性球，顯示 CLL 中前淋巴球比例增加。
features: Medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate amounts of pale-blue cytoplasm
Round to indented or notched nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and occasional small nucleoli (prolymphocytes)
Few small mature lymphocytes with dense chromatin for size comparison
Segmented neutrophil present; platelet clumps in the background
Some cells show irregular nuclear contours, raising a morphologic differential with mantle cell lymphoma
62204.describe_en: The smear shows numerous medium-sized lymphoid cells with moderate pale-blue cytoplasm, round to notched nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and occasional small nucleoli, consistent with prolymphocytes, admixed with fewer small mature-appearing lymphocytes. A segmented neutrophil and platelet clumps are present. Because irregular nuclear contours are seen in some cells, immunophenotyping is required; in this case the CD5+/CD23+/FMC7-negative profile supports CLL. Findings are consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia with increased prolymphocytes.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma (including pleomorphic/blastoid leukemic variants)
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps with the notched medium cells here, so cyclin D1/SOX11 expression or t(11;14) and a CD23-negative phenotype are required to identify mantle cell lymphoma.
B-PLL shows >55% prolymphocytes with a conspicuous central nucleolus and lacks CD23, whereas CLL with increased prolymphocytes retains the CLL immunophenotype.
Richter transformation shows sheets of large cells (at least twice lymphocyte size) with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli, larger than the medium prolymphocytes here.

62076.recognize_zh: 一群比周圍造血細胞大數倍的細胞彼此黏聚成團，核大、染色質呈網狀並可見核仁，細胞質淡藍且含許多小空泡，這種黏聚性的大型異常細胞團是骨髓轉移性腫瘤的線索。
features: Cohesive cluster of large cells, several times the size of adjacent hematopoietic cells, with molding and overlap
Large round-to-oval nuclei with high N:C ratio and nuclear size variation
Open, coarsely reticulated chromatin with visible nucleoli in several nuclei
Moderate pale-blue cytoplasm with numerous small clear vacuoles
Several similar cells detaching at the edge of the cluster
Background of crushed/poorly spread marrow elements and a few small lymphocytes
62076.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cohesive cluster of large atypical cells that are clearly foreign to the marrow, with several similar cells detaching from its edge. The cells have large round to oval nuclei with moderate anisonucleosis, open reticulated chromatin, identifiable nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm. Cell cohesion and nuclear molding are evident. The surrounding marrow elements are poorly spread, and overall cellularity cannot be assessed from this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic non-hematopoietic malignancy; correlation with trephine biopsy and immunohistochemistry is recommended.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation
ddx.vs: Leukemic monoblasts are discohesive single cells with folded nuclei and fine chromatin, whereas these cells form a cohesive, molded cluster.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with clustered plasma cells
ddx.vs: Myeloma cells retain eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and a perinuclear hof, features absent in this vacuolated cohesive aggregate.
Histiocytes have small bland nuclei with abundant cytoplasm and phagocytosed debris, not the high N:C ratio and nuclear atypia seen here.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round blue cell tumor (e.g. neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: These tumors in children show smaller cells with scant cytoplasm and rosettes; separation from carcinoma relies on age and IHC (keratin, synaptophysin, myogenin).

exam.answer_en: Metastatic non-hematopoietic malignancy in marrow — cohesive cluster of large vacuolated cells with nuclear molding
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指這團細胞問「是不是造血細胞」；細胞黏聚成團、核互相擠壓（molding）是非造血腫瘤的關鍵。
腫瘤細胞團常分布在抹片尾端與邊緣，低倍掃描不可漏看；骨髓纖維化可致 dry tap，需 trephine biopsy 評估。
確認需 IHC：CD45 陰性，cytokeratin（癌）、S100/SOX10（黑色素瘤）、synaptophysin/chromogranin（神經內分泌），再依原發部位追加。
兒童骨髓轉移常見 neuroblastoma、rhabdomyosarcoma、Ewing sarcoma；成人以乳癌、前列腺癌、肺癌為多。
周邊血可見 leukoerythroblastic picture（NRBC 加未成熟顆粒球）與淚滴狀紅血球，提示骨髓浸潤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 monoblasts 或聚集的 plasma cells；白血病細胞分散不黏聚，漿細胞有偏心核與 hof，本圖為黏聚成團並有核擠壓。

quiz.q: 圖中成團的大型細胞最支持哪一類病變？依據為何？
quiz.a: 骨髓轉移性（非造血）腫瘤；細胞黏聚成團、核擠壓

62012.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞密集，可見數顆巨核細胞體積偏小、核分葉少或呈分離的圓形核，旁邊有成群的紅血球系前驅細胞；多系（巨核細胞、紅血球系）形態異常是 MDS 多系發育不良的線索。
features: Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis
Megakaryocytes of variable size, some small with hypolobated or separated round nuclear lobes
Megakaryocytes loosely grouped rather than evenly dispersed
Clusters of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Maturing granulocytes present; no sheets of blasts
62012.describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes vary in size and include small forms with hypolobated or widely separated round nuclear lobes, some loosely grouped. Erythroid precursors form clusters, and granulocytic maturation is present without sheets of blasts. The findings are compatible with multilineage dysplasia, in keeping with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia; aspirate morphology and iron stain provide confirmation.

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are typically large with hyperlobated or cloud-like nuclei in tight clusters, unlike the small hypolobated forms here.
Del(5q) megakaryocytes are predominantly monolobated with normal/large size and require karyotype confirmation.
Reactive states lack consistent multilineage dysplasia, ring sideroblasts, and clonal genetic abnormalities.

61948.recognize_zh: 這張是未標明抗體的免疫染色：許多中型至大型細胞呈膜狀／細胞質強陽性，散布於陰性小淋巴球之間，陽性細胞大小不一，屬反應性混合族群；標記名稱不明，判讀需對照病例其他染色。
features: Immunohistochemical stain (marker not specified in title) with strong membranous/cytoplasmic brown staining
Positive cells are intermediate to large and scattered or loosely clustered
Many small negative lymphocytes in the background
No cohesive sheets of positive atypical cells
61948.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (antibody not specified) shows numerous intermediate-to-large cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining, scattered and in loose clusters among negative small lymphocytes. The positive population varies in size and does not form cohesive sheets. Because the marker is not identified, the image cannot be interpreted in isolation; within the EBV reactivation case it likely represents one of the lymphocyte subset markers highlighting activated cells in a reactive process.

ddx.vs: DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of uniformly positive large cells for the lineage marker, rather than scattered positive cells of varying size.
cHL shows only rare large HRS cells positive for CD30/CD15, not numerous intermediate-sized positive cells.

61820.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中有一顆小型單核細胞，核深染、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質極少，細胞旁散落細小紫色顆粒，細胞身分不易確定（可能為破裂的嗜鹼性球或微小巨核細胞）；背景有淚滴形紅血球與一顆較大較淡的多染性紅血球。
features: Small mononuclear cell with dense, coarsely clumped hyperchromatic nucleus and scant cytoplasm
Fine purple granules scattered adjacent to the cell, suggesting disrupted cytoplasmic granules
Occasional teardrop red cell and a larger pale polychromatic red cell
Mild anisocytosis of red cells
Few small platelets
61820.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a small mononuclear cell with a dense, coarsely clumped hyperchromatic nucleus and scant cytoplasm, accompanied by fine purple granules scattered beside it. Its identity cannot be established with certainty from this single field; a degranulated or disrupted basophil and a micromegakaryocyte are the main considerations, and a small lymphocyte with nearby platelet debris is also possible. Background red cells show mild anisocytosis with an occasional teardrop form and a polychromatic macrocyte. The image does not by itself demonstrate a specific diagnostic abnormality and should be interpreted with the full smear in the context of the GATA2-associated myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: An intact basophil has large dark purple granules overlying the nucleus, whereas here granules are dispersed outside the cell.
Micromegakaryocytes have a small dense nucleus with pale, blebby cytoplasm and attached platelet-like budding, and can be confirmed with CD61.
Lymphocytes have a thin rim of clear blue agranular cytoplasm without associated granules.

61756.recognize_zh: H&E 可見成片的中到大型淋巴細胞，核呈泡狀、可見核仁、細胞質淡而中等量，沿血管間浸潤；細胞明顯比典型脾邊緣區淋巴瘤的小細胞大，需考慮大細胞增加或轉化。
features: Sheets of intermediate to large lymphoid cells
Round to oval nuclei with vesicular chromatin and distinct small nucleoli
Moderate pale to amphophilic cytoplasm with distinct cell borders
Few interspersed small lymphocytes
Thin-walled vessels with red cells traversing the infiltrate
61756.describe_en: Sections show a diffuse infiltrate of intermediate to large lymphoid cells with vesicular chromatin, distinct nucleoli, and moderate pale cytoplasm, traversed by thin-walled vessels. Small lymphocytes are few, and the cells are larger and more open than the small marginal zone cells typical of splenic marginal zone lymphoma. Mitotic figures are not prominent in this field. The image is only partially typical of SMZL and raises the question of increased large cells or large cell transformation, which should be assessed with Ki-67 and correlation with other areas.

ddx.vs: Transformation is defined by sheets of large cells with high Ki-67, whereas classic SMZL consists of small cells with pale cytoplasm.
Blastoid MCL has finer chromatin and scant cytoplasm and is cyclin D1- and SOX11-positive.
HCL cells have bland oval to bean-shaped nuclei without prominent nucleoli and abundant clear cytoplasm, with annexin A1 and BRAF V600E positivity.

61628.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見數個比周圍細胞大 2–3 倍的非典型大細胞，核圓或不規則、染色質細緻、細胞質深藍且有細小空泡；在正常造血細胞之間出現這種大型淋巴瘤細胞，配合切片中竇內分布才考慮血管內大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Large atypical cells 2-3 times the size of neighboring cells
Round to irregular/indented nuclei with finely granular chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous to small
Moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with fine vacuoles
Admixed normal hematopoietic elements, including erythroid precursors and a vacuolated histiocyte
Aspirate fat space and red cell background
61628.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered large atypical mononuclear cells, 2-3 times the size of adjacent hematopoietic cells, among residual erythroid and myeloid elements. The atypical cells have round to irregular nuclei with finely granular chromatin and moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing fine vacuoles. A vacuolated histiocyte is also present. The large basophilic vacuolated cells are suggestive of large cell lymphoma involvement; in the context of an intrasinusoidal CD20-positive infiltrate on biopsy, findings are consistent with intravascular large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have finer chromatin, higher N:C ratio, distinct nucleoli and possible Auer rods, and are CD34/CD117/MPO positive rather than CD20 positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized and uniform with sharply punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles, and show a CD10+ MYC-rearranged phenotype.
Plasmablasts have eccentric nuclei with perinuclear hof and are CD138 positive, CD20 negative.
Carcinoma cells occur in cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and are keratin positive, CD45 negative.

61564.recognize_zh: 兩顆大型母細胞核大而圓、染色質極細緻，細胞質藍色無顆粒；右下那顆細胞質豐富、邊緣有偽足樣突起，容易誤認為成熟單核球，但細緻的染色質顯示它仍是單核母細胞（monoblast）。
features: Two large blasts, roughly three times the diameter of red cells
Large round to slightly oval nuclei with very fine, evenly dispersed chromatin
Nucleoli not conspicuous at this magnification
Upper-left cell: moderate, deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Lower-right cell: abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with a small pseudopod/bleb; background crenated red cells and platelet clumps
61564.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two large circulating blasts with large round to slightly oval nuclei and very finely dispersed chromatin. The upper-left cell has a moderate rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm, while the lower-right cell has more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with a small pseudopod-like bleb, a feature that can lead to misidentification as a mature monocyte. Nucleoli are not well resolved at this magnification, and Auer rods are not seen. Background red cells are crenated and platelet clumps are present. Findings are consistent with circulating monoblasts as seen in acute monoblastic or myelomonocytic leukemia; confirmation by nonspecific esterase cytochemistry and flow cytometry (CD14/CD64/CD11b/CD36) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Mature monocytes have folded nuclei with condensed, lacy-to-clumped chromatin and gray cytoplasm with vacuoles, rather than fine blastic chromatin in a round nucleus.
Usually smaller with scant cytoplasm, may contain Auer rods and are MPO-positive and NSE-negative.
Have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with an eccentric nucleus, a perinuclear hof and a single prominent central nucleolus.
Smaller, with scant cytoplasm and no pseudopods; lineage confirmed by TdT/CD19 or cCD3.

exam.answer_en: Acute monoblastic leukemia — circulating monoblasts with large round nuclei, very fine chromatin and abundant gray-blue agranular cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指右下那顆胞質豐富、有偽足的細胞問「這是成熟單核球嗎」；答案是 monoblast，因染色質極細緻。
確認單核球系：nonspecific esterase 陽性（NaF 抑制）、MPO 陰性或弱；flow 以 CD64、CD14、CD11b、CD36 為主，CD34 可陰性。
WHO 2016 定義 acute monoblastic leukemia 為單核球系細胞中 monoblast ≥80%；WHO 5th 改依分化歸類為 acute monocytic leukemia，promonocyte 計入 blast。
遺傳：常見 KMT2A rearrangement，屬定義性遺傳異常時應優先分類；嬰兒 AML 與 therapy-related（topoisomerase II 抑制劑）常見。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把胞質豐富的 monoblast 誤認為成熟單核球或大型反應性淋巴球；成熟單核球染色質較粗、核常摺疊並有胞質空泡，monoblast 染色質細緻且可見核仁。

quiz.q: 右下有偽足的大細胞應判為成熟單核球還是 monoblast？關鍵特徵是什麼？
quiz.a: Monoblast；染色質極細緻均勻（immature chromatin）

61500.recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖而非形態學影像：性染色體區有 2 條 X 加 1 條 Y（X 對被圈起），其餘體染色體各 2 條，總數 47 條，即男性病人的 +X 數目異常（47,XY,+X）。
features: G-banded karyogram with 22 pairs of structurally normal-appearing autosomes
Two X chromosomes (circled) plus one Y chromosome, giving 47 chromosomes
No structural rearrangement or marker chromosome in this metaphase
Banding resolution is moderate; subtle structural changes cannot be excluded
61500.describe_en: This figure is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows 47 chromosomes with two X chromosomes (circled) and one Y chromosome, and no apparent structural abnormality of the autosomes. In a male patient, this represents a numerical gain of chromosome X, reported as 47,XY,+X in the analyzed metaphases. Because a constitutional 47,XXY (Klinefelter) karyotype produces an identical picture, a PHA-stimulated peripheral blood or remission sample is needed to confirm that the gain is acquired and leukemia-specific in this B-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: A constitutional gain is present in all tissues including PHA-stimulated lymphocytes and remission marrow, whereas an acquired +X is restricted to the leukemic clone.
High hyperdiploidy has 51-67 chromosomes with gains of X, 4, 6, 10, 14, 17, 18, and 21, not an isolated single gain.
Doubled hypodiploid clones show paired losses and uniparental disomy patterns across many chromosomes, not a single extra X.

61436.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖中第 9 對與第 22 對已圈起：一條 9 號長臂較長（der(9)），一條 22 號明顯變短（費城染色體 der(22)），其餘染色體正常，性染色體為 XY，即 46,XY,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)。
features: G-banded male karyogram (XY) with 46 chromosomes
Chromosome 9 pair circled: one homolog with elongated long arm, consistent with der(9)t(9;22)
Chromosome 22 pair circled: one homolog shortened, representing the Philadelphia chromosome der(22)
No additional numerical or structural abnormalities evident; empty marker slot
61436.describe_en: G-banded karyogram shows a male complement of 46 chromosomes with a reciprocal translocation between the long arms of chromosomes 9 and 22, evident as an elongated der(9) and a shortened der(22) (Philadelphia chromosome). No additional abnormalities are seen in this metaphase. The karyotype is 46,XY,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2). In a patient with B-lymphoblastic leukemia this defines B-ALL with BCR::ABL1, typically with the p190 (e1a2) transcript in adults; aberrant CD13/CD33 expression is common, and RT-PCR for transcript type and tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapy are indicated.

ddx.vs: Same karyotype, so a preceding chronic phase, basophilia/splenomegaly, p210 transcript, and BCR::ABL1 in neutrophils favor CML blast phase.
Shares a kinase-activated expression profile but lacks t(9;22) and BCR::ABL1 fusion.

ddx.dx: Mixed phenotype acute leukemia with BCR::ABL1
ddx.vs: Requires lineage-defining myeloid markers such as MPO, whereas CD13/CD33 alone do not assign myeloid lineage.

exam.answer_en: 46,XY,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2) — Philadelphia chromosome (shortened der(22)) on G-banded karyotype; B-ALL with BCR::ABL1 in this case
pearls_zh: 判讀法：找縮短的 22 號（der(22)，Ph chromosome）與變長的 9 號（der(9)）；ISCN 寫法 46,XY,t(9;22)(q34;q11.2)。
Ph 不只見於 CML：成人 B-ALL 中最常見的重現性異常之一，多為 p190（e1a2）transcript；CML 多為 p210（e13a2/e14a2）。
B-ALL with BCR::ABL1 治療需合併 TKI（如 imatinib、dasatinib、ponatinib），預後因 TKI 大幅改善；常見 IKZF1 deletion。
Ph+ B-ALL 須與 CML lymphoid blast phase 區分：後者有 CML 慢性期病史或骨髓背景，且多為 p210。
Karyotype 解析度有限，無法偵測 cryptic 重排；應以 FISH 與 RT-PCR 補足並定 transcript。
exam.pitfall_zh: 看到 Ph chromosome 易直接答 CML；Ph 亦見於 B-ALL（多為 p190）與 MPAL，須結合形態與免疫表型判斷。

quiz.q: 此 karyogram 中縮短的 22 號染色體稱為什麼？在 B-ALL 中最常見的 BCR::ABL1 transcript 為何？
quiz.a: Philadelphia chromosome [der(22)]；p190（e1a2）

61372.recognize_zh: 在小淋巴球與組織球的背景中，可見大型細胞的核呈多葉摺疊、像爆米花（popcorn/LP cell），染色質淡而呈泡狀、核仁小且多個，缺乏典型 Reed-Sternberg 細胞那種巨大嗜酸性核仁。
features: Scattered large cells with multilobated, folded 'popcorn' nuclei
Vesicular, pale chromatin with multiple small basophilic nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Absence of large, inclusion-like eosinophilic nucleoli typical of classic RS cells
Background of small lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pink cytoplasm
61372.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows scattered large atypical cells in a background of small lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes. The large cells have multilobated, folded nuclei with vesicular chromatin, multiple small nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale cytoplasm. Classic Reed-Sternberg cells with large eosinophilic nucleoli are not seen in this field. The findings are consistent with lymphocyte predominant (popcorn) cells of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (CD20+, OCT2+, CD15-, CD30-) is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HRS cells have large eosinophilic nucleoli and are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5, whereas LP cells are CD20+, OCT2+, BOB1+ and CD30/CD15-negative.
THRLBCL shows diffuse architecture without CD21-positive follicular dendritic meshworks and a background rich in T cells and histiocytes rather than small B cells.
PTGC contains centroblasts but lacks atypical popcorn cells rimmed by PD-1-positive T-cell rosettes.

exam.answer_en: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma — LP (popcorn) cells with multilobated nuclei and small nucleoli in a small-lymphocyte background
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指多葉摺疊核的大細胞，問「這是什麼細胞？與 RS 細胞有何不同？」答：LP/popcorn cell；核仁小而多，缺乏巨大嗜酸性核仁。
IHC：LP 細胞 CD20+、CD45+、PAX5 強、OCT2+、BOB1+、BCL6+；CD30−、CD15−；周圍常有 PD-1+ T 細胞環繞（rosettes），位於 CD21+ FDC 網中。
WHO 5th 仍稱 NLPHL，ICC 2022 改稱 nodular lymphocyte predominant B-cell lymphoma，反映其本質為 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
臨床：多為局限性、病程惰性，但可晚期復發或轉化為 DLBCL/THRLBCL；因 CD20 陽性，rituximab 可用於治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 lymphocyte-rich classic Hodgkin lymphoma 混淆；LP 細胞核仁小、CD20/OCT2 強陽性、CD30/CD15 陰性，CHL 的 HRS 細胞核仁巨大、CD30+/CD15+、PAX5 弱。

quiz.q: 圖中多葉核的大細胞稱為什麼？它在 CD20 與 CD30 的染色結果應為何？
quiz.a: LP（popcorn）cell；CD20 陽性、CD30 陰性

61244.recognize_zh: 這是血小板凝集檢查（light transmission aggregometry + lumi-aggregometry）的曲線與數據表，不是形態學影像；重點看各致效劑的凝集幅度與 ATP 釋放（Lum）是否缺失。
features: Light transmission aggregation tracings (Opt) with paired lumi-aggregometry ATP-release channels (Lum) for four agonist conditions
Ristocetin 2.0 mg/mL: 94% aggregation (normal agglutination, GPIb-vWF axis intact)
Convulxin 1.0 nM (GPVI agonist): 88% aggregation with a delayed but present lumi signal
U46619 (thromboxane analog) 2.5 uM and 1.0 uM: reduced, reversible aggregation (30% and 15%) with no ATP release
Absent or minimal secretion signal across most channels, indicating a platelet secretion defect
61244.describe_en: This figure shows platelet aggregation studies rather than a morphologic image. Ristocetin-induced agglutination is normal (94%), and convulxin produces full aggregation (88%), whereas the thromboxane A2 analog U46619 yields only weak, reversible primary-wave aggregation (30% at 2.5 uM, 15% at 1.0 uM) with no measurable ATP release. The pattern indicates intact GPIb and GPVI receptor function with impaired granule secretion-dependent (second-wave) aggregation. In a patient with large pale platelets on smear, these results are compatible with gray platelet syndrome; confirmation relies on electron microscopy showing absent alpha granules and NBEAL2 sequencing.

ddx.vs: Would show absent ristocetin agglutination with normal responses to other agonists, whereas ristocetin response here is normal.
Also shows absent ATP release and impaired secondary aggregation, but platelets are normal-appearing (not gray) and mepacrine uptake/whole-mount EM shows reduced dense bodies.
Arachidonic acid responses are absent while U46619 responses are normal in COX inhibition, and platelet alpha-granule content is normal.

61180.recognize_zh: 血液抹片中出現體積大、細胞質嗜鹼性且邊緣有突起的非典型淋巴細胞，染色質細、可見核仁；流式顯示單株輕鏈限制，骨髓切片 IHC 陽性細胞呈間質與竇內分布，符合瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤的白血病性表現。
features: Panels A/B: large atypical lymphoid cells, 2-3 times the size of a small lymphocyte, with moderate to abundant deep basophilic cytoplasm
Irregular, occasionally indented nuclei with finely dispersed to vesicular chromatin and visible nucleoli
Irregular cytoplasmic borders with blebs and short projections
Panel C flow cytometry: an abnormal population with light-chain restriction (single light chain) distinct from background leukocytes
Panel D: hypercellular marrow core with an interstitial infiltrate of large cells
Panel E: IHC highlights large neoplastic cells in an interstitial and intrasinusoidal-appearing distribution (marker not labeled)
61180.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating large atypical lymphoid cells with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, irregular cytoplasmic borders, irregular nuclei with dispersed chromatin, and nucleoli. Flow cytometry identifies an abnormal light-chain-restricted population. The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with an interstitial infiltrate of large cells, which are highlighted by immunohistochemistry in an interstitial and sinusoidal-appearing distribution. Findings are consistent with leukemic involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma; correlation with splenic imaging and B-cell marker immunophenotype is recommended.

ddx.vs: Blasts have finer chromatin with less cytoplasmic basophilia and express CD34/TdT without surface light-chain restriction.
Prolymphocytes are medium-sized with a single prominent central nucleolus and moderately condensed chromatin, less pleomorphic than these large basophilic cells.

ddx.dx: Splenic marginal zone lymphoma or hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: These are small to medium cells with villous or hairy projections and mature chromatin, not large cells with vesicular nuclei.
Reactive immunoblasts are polyclonal and accompanied by a spectrum of reactive lymphocytes, without light-chain restriction.

61116.recognize_zh: 組合圖中結膜下可見鮭魚肉色腫塊（A），切片為單一形態小至中型淋巴球瀰漫浸潤（B），CD20 陽性（C）且 cyclin D1 核染色陽性（D），PET-CT 顯示廣泛皮下組織 FDG 攝取（E、F），支持被套細胞淋巴瘤侵犯淚腺與皮下組織。
features: Clinical photo: salmon-pink subconjunctival/lacrimal region mass on eversion of the eyelid
Diffuse sheets of monotonous small to medium lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclei and scant cytoplasm; scattered pink hyalinized vessels
No follicles, proliferation centers or large transformed cells evident on H&E
Diffuse membranous CD20 positivity in the neoplastic cells
Nuclear cyclin D1 positivity in a large proportion of cells (variable, mostly weak to moderate intensity)
PET-CT: extensive FDG-avid subcutaneous soft-tissue involvement of the trunk and abdomen
61116.describe_en: Composite figure. The clinical photograph shows a salmon-colored mass in the ocular adnexa. Biopsy sections show a diffuse infiltrate of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclear contours, scant cytoplasm and scattered hyalinized small vessels, without follicular structures or large-cell sheets. The neoplastic cells are positive for CD20 and show nuclear cyclin D1 expression. PET-CT images demonstrate widespread FDG-avid subcutaneous soft-tissue disease. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma involving the lacrimal gland and subcutaneous tissue.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma of ocular adnexa
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma is the most common ocular adnexal lymphoma but is cyclin D1-negative and CD5-negative with marginal zone/monocytoid and plasmacytic differentiation.
CLL/SLL shows round nuclei with proliferation centers and is CD23+ LEF1+ and cyclin D1-negative (except occasional proliferation-center cells).
FL is CD10+ BCL6+ with a follicular pattern of centrocytes and centroblasts and lacks cyclin D1 expression.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia / plasma cell neoplasm with cyclin D1
ddx.vs: These can express weak cyclin D1 but HCL is CD103+ annexin A1+ and myeloma is CD138+ CD20-negative, unlike the CD20+ SOX11+ MCL cells.

61116.stain: H&E; IHC: CD20, cyclin D1; PET-CT

61052.recognize_zh: 多圖組合：周邊血有大型血小板／巨核細胞碎片，流式在 CD45 低、SSC 低區圈出一群 CD34 與 CD61/CD41 共表現的細胞，骨髓切片 CD34 染出大量巨核細胞並伴有小型低分葉巨核細胞，提示 MDS 中 CD34 陽性的異常巨核細胞。
features: Peripheral blood with a large platelet/megakaryocytic fragment (arrow) in a background of anisopoikilocytosis
Flow cytometry: CD45 dim/negative, low side-scatter gated events co-expressing CD34 with CD61 and CD41
Aspirate with small hypolobated megakaryocytes/micromegakaryocytes and larger megakaryocytes
Biopsy (H&E) hypercellular with increased, variably sized megakaryocytes
CD34 immunostain labels numerous megakaryocytes of varying size (normally CD34-negative)
61052.describe_en: Composite figure. The peripheral blood smear shows a circulating large platelet or megakaryocytic fragment. Flow cytometric analysis identifies a CD45-dim, low side-scatter population co-expressing CD34 and the megakaryocytic markers CD61 and CD41, and a CD34-positive cell is also shown on a cytospin/section. The aspirate contains small hypolobated megakaryocytes, and the hypercellular biopsy shows increased megakaryocytes that are aberrantly CD34-positive by immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with myelodysplastic syndrome with dysplastic, CD34-expressing megakaryocytes and circulating megakaryocytic fragments, which can falsely inflate the CD34+ blast count by flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: AMKL shows >=20% CD34/CD61+ blasts with cytologically blastic morphology, whereas here CD34 marks mature-appearing and small dysplastic megakaryocytes and fragments.
True myeloblasts are CD34+ but CD61/CD41-negative; co-expression with megakaryocytic antigens identifies megakaryocytic fragments rather than blasts.
MPN megakaryocytes are clustered, large and hyperlobated or cloud-like with fibrosis, rather than small hypolobated dysplastic forms.

61052.stain: Wright-Giemsa, H&E, IHC: CD34, flow cytometry

60988.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆大型漿細胞，核圓偏心、旁邊有淡染核周區，細胞質濃厚紫紅色、邊緣呈不規則毛邊狀，即「火焰細胞」（flame cell），常見於 IgA 型漿細胞增生；C 圖切片 IHC 呈瀰漫陽性。
features: Large plasma cells with abundant, intensely stained reddish-purple (fuchsinophilic) cytoplasm
Ragged, frayed cytoplasmic margins producing a flame-like outline
Round, eccentric nucleus with clumped chromatin and a paler perinuclear zone
Occasional plasma cell with conventional deep-blue cytoplasm (panel A, lower)
Blood-rich aspirate background with crowded red cells and scattered granulocytes
Panel C: marrow biopsy immunostain with widespread positive (brown) cells among fat spaces; antibody not labeled
60988.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered plasma cells, some with abundant, deeply fuchsinophilic cytoplasm with frayed, flame-shaped margins and round eccentric nuclei with clumped chromatin (flame cells); a plasma cell with conventional basophilic cytoplasm is also present. The background is blood-rich with crowded red cells and granulocytes. A corresponding biopsy immunostain (antibody not specified in the figure) shows abundant positive cells among adipocytes. Flame cells reflect accumulated glycoprotein-rich immunoglobulin, classically IgA; in this context the findings are consistent with a plasma cell proliferation producing IgA, and distinction between MGUS and myeloma requires clonal plasma cell quantitation and clinical criteria.

ddx.vs: Same flame-cell morphology; separated from MGUS by ≥10% clonal marrow plasma cells or myeloma-defining events, not by the cytology of individual cells.
Polytypic plasma cells on kappa/lambda staining without an M-protein; flame cells are uncommon and plasma cells are usually perivascular and mature.

ddx.dx: Mott cells / Russell body-containing plasma cells
ddx.vs: Show discrete round globular inclusions (grape-like) rather than diffuse red cytoplasm with frayed edges.
Contains a mixed population of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and mast cells with MYD88 L265P, rather than isolated flame-type plasma cells.

exam.answer_en: Flame cells in IgA plasma cell proliferation (IgA MGUS) — plasma cells with fuchsinophilic cytoplasm and frayed flame-like margins
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指細胞質紫紅、邊緣毛邊狀的漿細胞問名稱與相關免疫球蛋白 → flame cell，經典聯想為 IgA（醣化免疫球蛋白堆積）。
MGUS vs myeloma 不看單顆細胞形態，看數量與器官傷害：non-IgM MGUS 為 M-protein <3 g/dL、骨髓克隆漿細胞 <10%，且無 CRAB 或 SLiM 事件。
SLiM myeloma-defining events：骨髓克隆漿細胞 ≥60%、involved/uninvolved free light chain ratio ≥100、MRI 超過一處 ≥5 mm 局部病灶。
MGUS 進展風險因子（Mayo）：非 IgG 型（本例 IgA）、M-protein ≥1.5 g/dL、FLC ratio 異常；需長期追蹤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Mott cell 混淆：Mott cell 細胞質內是一顆顆圓形 Russell bodies（葡萄串狀），flame cell 則為瀰漫紫紅色細胞質與毛邊；flame cell 形態本身不代表惡性。

quiz.q: 圖中細胞質呈紫紅色、邊緣如火焰的漿細胞稱為什麼？最經典與哪一型免疫球蛋白相關？
quiz.a: Flame cell；IgA

60860.recognize_zh: CD3 染色在表皮下真皮結節中標示出大量膜陽性的小 T 細胞，表皮本身無 T 細胞浸潤（無親表皮性）；皮膚邊緣區淋巴瘤常混有大量反應性 T 細胞，不能因此誤判為 T 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Numerous small CD3-positive T cells with membranous staining within a superficial dermal nodule
T cells are dispersed throughout the nodule and extend into surrounding dermis
Epidermis essentially free of CD3-positive cells, with no epidermotropism
Small non-reactive (negative) cells interspersed, representing the B-cell component
60860.describe_en: CD3 immunostain of the skin biopsy highlights numerous small T cells within and around the dermal lymphoid nodules beneath an unremarkable epidermis. The positive cells are small and admixed with CD3-negative cells, and there is no epidermotropism. The abundance of reactive T cells is a common feature of primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma and should be interpreted together with CD20, light-chain studies and morphology. Findings are consistent with a T-cell-rich B-cell infiltrate compatible with cutaneous marginal zone lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: This shows a nodule dominated by CD4-positive T cells with PD-1-positive follicular helper cells, rather than a B-cell nodule with monotypic plasma cells.
MF has atypical CD3-positive T cells in the epidermis with Pautrier microabscesses and often loss of CD7, which is not present here.
Reactive infiltrates also contain many T cells but lack B-cell or plasma cell light-chain restriction.

60796.recognize_zh: 四顆小至中型淋巴細胞，核染色質中度凝集、核形略不規則或有切迹，胞質少量淡藍，特徵是胞質內散在數個清楚、邊界銳利的小空泡（A–D），這種不連續空泡是提示被套細胞淋巴瘤的細微線索。
features: Small to medium lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular or notched nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant pale blue cytoplasm containing several discrete, sharply punched-out clear vacuoles
Vacuoles located at the cytoplasmic rim, sometimes indenting the nuclear outline (panel D)
Panel B: slightly larger cell with irregular cytoplasmic borders; unremarkable background red cells
60796.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear panels (A-D) show small to medium-sized atypical lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular, notched nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and a scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm. Each cell contains a few discrete, well-circumscribed clear cytoplasmic vacuoles. The vacuoles are distinct rather than diffuse foamy change, and no large nucleoli or blastic chromatin are present. In the setting of a CD5-positive B-cell population, this morphology is suggestive of leukemic mantle cell lymphoma, which should be confirmed with cyclin D1/SOX11 or t(11;14).

ddx.vs: Cells have round nuclei with soccer-ball chromatin and usually lack discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles; CD23 is bright and cyclin D1 negative.
Cells are larger with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, fine chromatin, nucleoli and numerous vacuoles, and are CD10+/MYC-rearranged.

ddx.dx: Lysosomal storage disease or drug-induced vacuolated lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Vacuoles are seen in morphologically normal lymphocytes of a polyclonal population without a CD5+ light-chain-restricted clone.
Cells show deep narrow nuclear clefts without cytoplasmic vacuoles and are CD10+/CD5-negative.

60604.recognize_zh: 胸水細胞離心抹片中有大量大型芽細胞：核質比高、染色質細緻、有核仁，細胞質嗜鹼性且常有小空泡與細胞質突起，並有一群成團的芽細胞（插圖 B）；混雜少量嗜中性球與淋巴球，缺乏間皮細胞特徵，符合 AML 侵犯胸水。
features: Numerous large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and visible nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with small vacuoles and irregular blebs/pseudopods (cytospin artifact)
Some cells with folded/monocytoid nuclei and a very large cell with deep basophilic cytoplasm
Inset: cohesive-appearing aggregate of blasts with vacuolated cytoplasm, mimicking an epithelial cluster
Background: scattered neutrophils, lymphocytes and red cells
60604.describe_en: Cytospin preparation of pleural fluid shows a cellular specimen dominated by large atypical blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, finely dispersed chromatin, nucleoli and basophilic, often vacuolated cytoplasm with cytoplasmic blebs; some cells show folded nuclei. The blasts also form tight clusters (inset) that can mimic metastatic carcinoma or reactive mesothelial cells. Scattered neutrophils and lymphocytes are present. Findings are consistent with involvement of pleural fluid by acute myeloid leukemia; flow cytometry or cytochemistry on the fluid is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Mesothelial cells have dense two-toned cytoplasm with a peripheral lacy skirt, windows between cells and calretinin positivity, and lack blast chromatin.
Carcinoma clusters are truly cohesive with three-dimensional architecture and are keratin/EpCAM positive, whereas blasts are CD45 and myeloid-marker positive.
Lymphoma cells are discohesive lymphoid cells with scant cytoplasm and B/T markers, lacking MPO or monocytic markers.

ddx.dx: Peripheral blood contamination by circulating blasts
ddx.vs: Traumatic tap contamination is accompanied by many red cells and a blast proportion similar to blood, whereas true involvement shows blasts enriched out of proportion.

60668.recognize_zh: 左上周邊血可見大型卵圓紅血球、紅血球大小不一與有核紅血球（箭頭）；右側與下方骨髓抹片的紅血球系前驅細胞核大、染色質呈開放篩狀（箭頭，megaloblastoid），提示代謝性（甲基丙二酸血症相關鈷胺代謝異常）巨母細胞樣造血不良導致全血球減少。
features: Blood (inset): marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, schistocyte-like fragments, and nucleated red cells, including a binucleate/budding form (arrows)
Marrow: erythroid precursors with enlarged nuclei and open, sieve-like chromatin (megaloblastoid change, arrows)
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony in erythroid precursors with relatively mature basophilic-to-polychromatic cytoplasm
Scattered giant or open-chromatin precursors; granulocytic cells are sparse in this field
Ring-like refractile dark-outlined artifacts overlying some red cells, not interpretable as true inclusions
60668.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (inset) shows marked anisopoikilocytosis with macro-ovalocytes, fragmented forms, and circulating nucleated red cells with nuclear irregularity. The bone marrow aspirate shows erythroid precursors with enlarged nuclei and finely dispersed, sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, consistent with megaloblastoid erythropoiesis; granulocytic and megakaryocytic lineages cannot be adequately assessed in this field. Several dark-rimmed refractile ring-shaped objects over red cells are most likely preparation artifact. In a patient with methylmalonic acidemia, findings are consistent with megaloblastic-type ineffective hematopoiesis due to impaired cobalamin-dependent metabolism rather than true marrow aplasia.

ddx.dx: Nutritional vitamin B12 or folate deficiency
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, including hypersegmented neutrophils and megaloblasts; separation relies on serum B12/folate, methylmalonic acid, and homocysteine levels together with the known inborn error.

MDS may show megaloblastoid erythroid change but also shows ring sideroblasts, pseudo-Pelger neutrophils, micromegakaryocytes, and clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, and does not correct with metabolic therapy.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts (≥30%) with vacuolated deeply basophilic cytoplasm, not maturing megaloblastoid precursors.
Aplastic anemia shows a hypocellular marrow without megaloblastic dyserythropoiesis, whereas this aspirate is cellular with abnormal erythroid maturation.

60732.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞增多、以小淋巴球與漿細胞浸潤為主，血管壁被均質粉紅色無定形物質增厚，Congo red 偏光下血管周圍呈黃綠色雙折射；流式顯示 kappa 限制的 B 細胞與漿細胞，符合 Waldenström 巨球蛋白血症合併 AL 類澱粉沉積。
features: BM biopsy (A): hypercellular intertrabecular marrow with a diffuse infiltrate of small lymphoid cells and plasmacytoid cells
H&E (B): vessel walls thickened by homogeneous, acellular, pale eosinophilic amorphous material with surrounding lymphoplasmacytic cells
Congo red under polarized light (C): yellow-to-apple-green birefringence in a vessel wall
Flow (D): CD19+/CD20+ B cells with kappa light chain restriction (~95.9% kappa vs 1.3% lambda)
Flow (E): CD45−/dim CD38+ CD138+ plasma cells with cytoplasmic kappa restriction (~94% kappa vs 3.75% lambda)
60732.describe_en: The bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with an extensive interstitial to diffuse infiltrate of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells. Several small vessels show mural thickening by homogeneous, acellular eosinophilic material, which demonstrates yellow-green birefringence on Congo red staining viewed under polarized light, confirming amyloid deposition. Flow cytometry identifies a kappa-restricted CD19+/CD20+ B-cell population and kappa-restricted CD38+/CD138+ plasma cells. Findings are consistent with lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma (Waldenström macroglobulinemia) with associated AL amyloidosis; mass spectrometry typing of the amyloid and MYD88 L265P testing are recommended.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with AL amyloidosis
ddx.vs: Myeloma lacks the clonal CD19+/CD20+ B-cell component and usually has a non-IgM paraprotein without MYD88 L265P.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL can look similar but typically forms paratrabecular-sparing nodules with monocytoid cells and is usually MYD88 wild-type.
Congo red birefringence does not type the amyloid; mass spectrometry or immunostaining is needed to show light-chain rather than serum amyloid A or transthyretin protein.
Hyaline arteriolosclerosis is Congo red negative without apple-green birefringence under polarized light.

captions: BM biopsy: hypercellular marrow with lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate
H&E: vessels with walls thickened by amorphous eosinophilic material
Congo red, polarized: yellow-green birefringence in a vessel wall
Flow: CD38+/CD138+ plasma cells with cytoplasmic kappa restriction

60540.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中高度細胞化的造血組織裡，出現一個邊界清楚、淡染而均一的中型單核細胞大結節，缺乏紅血球前驅細胞與巨核細胞，與周圍混合造血形成對比，是漿細胞樣樹突細胞結節性聚集的線索。
features: Large well-circumscribed nodule of monotonous medium-sized mononuclear cells
Cells have round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and a moderate rim of pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Nodule lacks admixed erythroid precursors, granulocytes and megakaryocytes
Surrounding marrow is hypercellular with trilineage hematopoiesis and megakaryocytes
Adipocytes are reduced; scattered hemorrhage in the interstitium
60540.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis in which a large, discrete nodule of monotonous medium-sized mononuclear cells is present. The cells in the nodule have round to oval nuclei, fine chromatin and a moderate amount of pale cytoplasm, and the nodule is devoid of maturing myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocytic elements. The nodule is not a typical small-lymphocyte aggregate and warrants immunohistochemistry; with CD123 positivity (see companion image), findings are consistent with a nodular aggregate of plasmacytoid dendritic cells, which should prompt evaluation for an associated myeloid neoplasm (e.g. CMML).

ddx.vs: BPDCN usually infiltrates the marrow diffusely by blastoid cells co-expressing CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCL1 rather than forming a discrete nodule within otherwise preserved hematopoiesis.
Lymphoid aggregates consist of small lymphocytes with dark condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm and stain with CD3/CD20, not CD123.
Mast cell lesions are often paratrabecular/perivascular with spindled cells, fibrosis and eosinophils, and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.
AML blasts are CD34/CD117/MPO positive and usually replace the marrow diffusely rather than forming a single sharply demarcated nodule.

60476.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中央一顆單核細胞，圓核染色質均勻細緻，細胞質淡藍灰色，外緣環繞一圈細毛狀突起（circumferential hairy projections），即毛狀細胞白血病的毛狀細胞。
features: Single mononuclear cell somewhat larger than surrounding red cells
Round nucleus with moderately condensed, homogeneous ground-glass chromatin; no distinct nucleolus
Moderate grey-blue cytoplasm
Fine, circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections around the entire cell border
Background of normocytic red cells and a few platelets; no other leukocytes in field
60476.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mononuclear lymphoid cell slightly larger than a resting lymphocyte, with a round nucleus, homogeneous moderately condensed chromatin and no conspicuous nucleolus. The moderate grey-blue cytoplasm bears fine, hair-like projections around its entire circumference. The background red cells are normocytic. Findings are consistent with a hairy cell; confirmation of hairy cell leukemia requires flow cytometry (CD11c, CD25, CD103, CD123) and/or BRAF V600E testing.

ddx.vs: Villous lymphocytes have short polar villi at one or both ends and a more condensed chromatin, and are CD103/CD25/annexin A1 negative.
HCL-v cells have a prominent nucleolus like prolymphocytes, lack CD25 and annexin A1, and present with leukocytosis rather than monocytopenia.

ddx.dx: Splenic diffuse red pulp small B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: SDRPL cells have broad-based uneven villi and are typically CD25/annexin A1 negative, BRAF wild-type.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and vacuolated cytoplasm without circumferential hairy projections.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia — circulating hairy cell with circumferential fine cytoplasmic projections and homogeneous chromatin
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指這顆周緣一圈細毛突起的細胞，問名稱與確診需要的 flow 標記組合（CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123）。
flow 表型：CD19/CD20+（強）、CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 皆陽性，CD5−、CD10 多陰性；CD200 強陽性。
分子：BRAF V600E 突變幾乎見於所有 classic HCL，可用 VE1 免疫染色或 PCR 檢測；HCL-variant（WHO 5th 改稱 splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli）無此突變。
臨床：全血球低下合併明顯單核球低下（monocytopenia）與脾腫大，淋巴結腫大少見；骨髓因 reticulin 纖維化常 dry tap。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 SMZL 的 villous lymphocyte：後者突起短且集中於一或兩極（polar villi），CD103/CD123 多陰性；毛狀細胞突起環繞整個細胞。

quiz.q: 此細胞周緣環繞細毛狀突起，最可能的診斷為何？這種疾病的特徵性血球變化是哪一系列低下？
quiz.a: Hairy cell leukemia；單核球低下（monocytopenia）

60348.recognize_zh: G 帶核型圖為女性（XX）46 條染色體，箭頭分別指向 15 號與 17 號染色體各一條的長臂末端交換（der(15) 與 der(17)），即 t(15;17)(q24;q21)，形成 PML-RARA 融合，是 APL 的定義性異常。
features: G-banded karyogram of a female cell (XX) with 46 chromosomes
Arrow at one chromosome 15 showing altered distal long-arm banding (der(15))
Arrow at one chromosome 17 showing altered/shortened distal long arm (der(17))
Interpretation: 46,XX,t(15;17)(q24;q21), producing PML-RARA
No additional numerical or obvious structural abnormalities in this metaphase
60348.describe_en: This G-banded karyogram shows a female metaphase with 46 chromosomes and a reciprocal translocation between the long arms of chromosomes 15 and 17, highlighted by arrows on the derivative chromosomes 15 and 17. The karyotype is 46,XX,t(15;17)(q24;q21). This rearrangement fuses PML on 15q24 with RARA on 17q21 and is diagnostic of acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML-RARA, which responds to all-trans retinoic acid and arsenic trioxide. Because the translocation involves subtle terminal segments, confirmation by PML-RARA FISH or RT-PCR is standard, and it also detects cryptic or complex variants.

ddx.dx: APL with variant RARA translocation (e.g., t(11;17) ZBTB16-RARA)
ddx.vs: Variant partners involve chromosomes other than 15 and may be resistant to ATRA; the involvement of chromosome 15 here and PML-RARA FISH distinguish classic APL.

ddx.dx: Cryptic PML-RARA insertion with normal karyotype
ddx.vs: Some APL cases lack a visible t(15;17) and are detected only by FISH or RT-PCR, so a normal karyotype does not exclude APL.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia karyotype — 46,XX,t(15;17)(q24;q21) with der(15) and der(17) forming PML::RARA
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指著 15 與 17 號染色體末端交換，問融合基因（PML::RARA）與對應疾病（APL）；斷點在末端、變化細微，是核型判讀易漏的位置。
臨床上核型太慢（需培養），確認 APL 優先用 PML::RARA FISH 或 RT-PCR；RT-PCR 可分出 bcr1/bcr2/bcr3 轉錄本，並作 molecular MRD 追蹤。
少數 APL 為 cryptic insertion 或複雜重排，核型正常仍可能 PML::RARA 陽性；核型正常不能排除 APL。
Variant RARA 夥伴要會：ZBTB16::RARA［t(11;17)］對 ATRA 與 arsenic 反應差；WHO 5th 中 APL 以 PML::RARA 定義，不需 blast ≥20%。
t(15;17) 以外的附加核型異常（如 +8）在 APL 常見，但一般不改變 ATRA/ATO 治療策略。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 variant RARA translocation 如 t(11;17) 或正常核型混淆；本圖兩個箭頭分別在 15 與 17 號，variant 則涉及其他染色體（如 11），最終靠 PML::RARA FISH/RT-PCR 區分。

quiz.q: 圖中箭頭標出的易位名稱為何？若變異易位為 t(11;17)，對哪種治療反應差？
quiz.a: t(15;17)(q24;q21) PML::RARA；t(11;17) ZBTB16::RARA 對 ATRA（及 arsenic）反應差。

60284.recognize_zh: 流式圖以 CD45 亮、中等 SSC 圈出單核球群，CD64 與 CD13 陽性確認為單核球；兩種 CD14 殖株（MO2、MY4 對 MOP9）呈高度一致的亮陽性，部分細胞 CD56 弱表現，顯示單核球群擴增並帶異常 CD56，可支持 CMML（需配合 CD14/CD16 分群與周邊單核球數）。
features: CD45 vs SSC: prominent population with bright CD45 and intermediate side scatter gated as monocytes
Monocyte gate is uniformly CD64-positive with CD13 expression
CD14 detected by three clones (MO2, MY4, MOP9) with concordant bright expression in most cells and a minor CD14-dim subset
CD56 shows partial dim aberrant expression on the monocytes
CD16 is not displayed, so the classical monocyte (MO1) fraction cannot be calculated from these plots
60284.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis shows a prominent population with bright CD45 and intermediate side scatter, gated as monocytes. These cells are uniformly CD64-positive and express CD13, and most show bright, concordant CD14 expression with three different antibody clones, with only a small CD14-dim subset. A subset of the monocytes shows partial dim CD56 expression, an aberrancy that can be seen in clonal monocytic proliferations. In the context of persistent absolute monocytosis, these findings support chronic myelomonocytic leukemia; quantifying classical CD14+/CD16- monocytes (increased to at least 94% in CMML) and excluding increased blasts and promonocytes are needed.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytosis shows increased CD16+ intermediate/nonclassical monocytes and lacks aberrant CD56 or CD2 expression.
Leukemic monoblasts/promonocytes are CD14-dim to negative with CD34/CD117 or HLA-DR variability, whereas this population is mostly mature CD14-bright.
Separation depends on detection of BCR-ABL1 rather than on monocyte immunophenotype.

60220.recognize_zh: 紅血球大小不一，許多偏小且中央淡染區擴大（低色素），並混有鉛筆狀、淚滴形、口形與少數帶刺的不規則紅血球；以右上角小淋巴球作為大小參考，符合中度缺鐵性貧血。
features: Hypochromic red cells with widened central pallor; many smaller than the lymphocyte nucleus
Moderate anisocytosis with admixed larger, better hemoglobinized cells
Poikilocytosis including elongated pencil cells, teardrop forms, slit-like pallor and occasional spiculated cells
Small mature lymphocyte (upper right) and scattered platelets
60220.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows hypochromic, predominantly microcytic red cells with moderate anisopoikilocytosis. Poikilocytes include pencil cells, teardrop forms and occasional spiculated cells. A small lymphocyte is present for size comparison, and platelets are adequate in this field. Findings are consistent with moderate iron deficiency anemia.

ddx.vs: Shows more uniform microcytosis (low RDW) with target cells and basophilic stippling and normal ferritin.
Features a dimorphic population with Pappenheimer bodies and ring sideroblasts in the marrow.
Is typically normocytic to mildly microcytic with minimal poikilocytosis and normal or raised ferritin.

60156.recognize_zh: 骨髓腔內以纖維性基質為主，細胞沿纖維呈流線狀排列，並散在多顆核深染、形狀扭曲或拉長的異型巨核細胞，脂肪與正常造血明顯減少，為纖維化期MPN的典型切片表現。
features: Fibrotic stroma with spindled cells and hematopoietic elements streaming in parallel
Scattered atypical megakaryocytes with dense hyperchromatic, distorted or elongated nuclei
Reduced residual hematopoiesis with few scattered granulocytic and erythroid cells
Occasional small fat vacuoles and a bony trabecula at the left edge
Extravasated red cells within the fibrotic stroma
60156.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows extensive stromal fibrosis with streaming of spindled cells and residual hematopoietic elements. Megakaryocytes are atypical, with hyperchromatic, irregular and elongated nuclei distorted by the fibrotic background. Normal hematopoiesis and fat are reduced. No sheets of blasts or epithelial nests are seen. Findings are consistent with advanced myelofibrosis, compatible with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so the distinction depends on documented antecedent polycythemia vera.
Shows small hypolobated or micromegakaryocytes and multilineage dysplasia rather than large hyperchromatic MPN-type megakaryocytes.
Contains cohesive malignant cells highlighted by keratin or other lineage IHC, whereas atypical cells here are megakaryocytes (CD61/CD42b positive).

60092.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片高倍下幾乎全為核卵圓至不規則、染色質淡、有小核仁的未成熟細胞成片分布，正常成熟造血細胞稀少；中央可見細胞質粉紅、核分葉彼此分離的異常巨核細胞，在有化療史者提示治療相關髓系腫瘤。
features: Hypercellular marrow with sheets of immature cells replacing normal hematopoiesis
Medium to large cells with oval, folded or irregular nuclei, vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale eosinophilic to amphophilic cytoplasm
Scattered megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclear lobes (center)
Few residual erythroid precursors and eosinophilic granulocytes; interstitial red cells and hemosiderin
60092.describe_en: Bone marrow trephine core biopsy is hypercellular with sheets of immature cells that have oval to irregular, focally folded nuclei, vesicular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate pale cytoplasm, with only scattered residual erythroid and granulocytic elements. A megakaryocyte with widely separated nuclear lobes is present near the center, a dysplastic feature. There is focal hemosiderin pigment. In a patient with prior cytotoxic therapy, findings are consistent with therapy-related acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.dx: De novo AML with myelodysplasia-related changes
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; the therapy-related designation rests on documented prior cytotoxic chemotherapy or radiation.

ddx.dx: Marrow involvement by large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are lymphoid-marker positive (CD20/CD3) and lack associated megakaryocytic dysplasia; immunostains separate them.
Regeneration shows synchronized waves of maturing myeloid and erythroid cells with normal megakaryocytes, not persistent sheets of blasts with dysplastic megakaryocytes.

30972.recognize_zh: 這是腹部電腦斷層（CT）橫切面，紅色箭頭指向左上腹後方體積很小的脾臟，代表脾萎縮；慢性移植物抗宿主病（chronic GVHD）可造成功能性無脾，血液抹片可見 Howell-Jolly 小體。
features: Axial contrast-enhanced CT of the upper abdomen at the level of the liver and upper pole of kidneys
Red arrow indicates a markedly small soft-tissue structure in the posterior left upper quadrant, consistent with an atrophic spleen
Normal-sized liver with enhancing vessels; aorta and vertebral body shown for orientation
No focal splenic mass is evident in this single slice
30972.describe_en: This is not a morphologic image but an axial contrast-enhanced abdominal CT. The arrow marks a markedly small spleen in the posterior left upper quadrant, whereas the liver is normal in size. In a patient with chronic graft-versus-host disease, splenic atrophy correlates with functional hyposplenism, which is confirmed on blood film by Howell-Jolly bodies and carries an increased risk of infection with encapsulated organisms. Findings are consistent with splenic atrophy in chronic GVHD.

30780.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中許多細胞具大型細胞質內空泡、核被推擠成新月形，呈印戒細胞（signet ring cell）樣；抹片中單一細胞的空泡與偏位核類似漿細胞，但免疫染色（C 細胞質強陽性、D 核陽性）顯示為上皮性轉移癌，符合乳腺小葉癌。
features: Panel A: marrow infiltrated by discohesive single cells with eccentric, crescent-shaped hyperchromatic nuclei compressed by intracytoplasmic vacuoles (signet ring morphology)
Panel B: aspirate cell with eccentric nucleus and a large pale intracytoplasmic vacuole/target-like inclusion, superficially resembling a plasma cell
Panel C: strong cytoplasmic immunostaining outlining the vacuolated tumor cells, compatible with an epithelial marker
Panel D: strong nuclear immunostaining in tumor cells, compatible with a hormone receptor or lineage transcription factor
Individually dispersed rather than cohesive tumor cells, mimicking a plasma cell infiltrate
30780.describe_en: Bone marrow sections and aspirate composite. The biopsy (A, H&E) is infiltrated by discohesive cells with eccentric crescentic nuclei displaced by intracytoplasmic vacuoles, imparting a signet ring appearance, and the aspirate (B, Wright-Giemsa) contains a similar cell with an eccentric nucleus and a large cytoplasmic vacuole that can mimic a plasma cell. Immunohistochemistry shows strong cytoplasmic staining (C) and nuclear staining (D) of the tumor cells; the specific antigens are not labeled in the image but the pattern supports an epithelial origin. Findings are consistent with metastatic lobular breast carcinoma mimicking a plasma cell neoplasm, which should be confirmed with cytokeratin, GATA3/ER and negative CD138/light chain restriction (noting CD138 can also stain carcinoma).

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells have a clockface nucleus with a perinuclear hof and basophilic cytoplasm without mucin vacuoles, and are cytokeratin-negative with light chain restriction.
Gastric signet ring carcinoma is CDX2/CK20-positive and GATA3/ER-negative, whereas lobular breast carcinoma is GATA3/ER-positive and E-cadherin-negative.
Histiocytes have small bland nuclei and foamy cytoplasm and are CD68/CD163-positive and cytokeratin-negative.
Lymphoma cells express CD45 and B-cell markers with immunoglobulin-filled vacuoles and are keratin-negative.

30588.recognize_zh: A 圖抹片中一群大型淋巴樣細胞，細胞質深藍、核大、染色質細緻並有小核仁，部分核有凹陷或切痕，細胞質可見少量空泡；B 圖組織免疫染色瀰漫性核陽性。典型花瓣狀（flower cell）多葉核在此視野並不明顯。
features: Panel A: cluster of large lymphoid cells, about 2-3 times red cell diameter, with high N:C ratio
Nuclei round to indented with occasional clefts/notches, finely dispersed chromatin and small nucleoli
Moderately basophilic cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles
Background crenated red cells (echinocytes) and a macrophage with foamy cytoplasm
Panel B: tissue section with diffuse sheets of cells showing strong nuclear immunostaining (antigen not labeled)
30588.describe_en: Composite figure. The smear (A, Wright-Giemsa) shows a cluster of large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, round to indented and notched nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm, admixed with crenated red cells. Distinct multilobated flower-like nuclei are only subtly suggested by nuclear notching in this field. The tissue section (B) shows a diffuse infiltrate with strong nuclear immunostaining, antigen not specified. Findings are suggestive of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase, which should be confirmed by flow cytometry showing a clonal large B-cell population.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells are medium-sized with condensed chromatin and deeply lobulated petal-like nuclei, express CD4/CD25 and are HTLV-1 positive rather than B-cell markers.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing prominent sharply punched-out lipid vacuoles and have MYC rearrangement with Ki-67 near 100%.
Blasts express CD34/TdT (ALL) or MPO/CD33 (AML) and lack mature surface immunoglobulin light chain restriction.
Blastoid MCL can look identical but is CD5-positive with cyclin D1 and t(11;14).

29116.recognize_zh: 嬰兒軀幹與頭皮布滿紅棕色丘疹，皮膚切片見真皮上層密集組織球浸潤並侵入表皮，免疫染色強陽性，是皮膚型 Langerhans cell histiocytosis 的典型表現；骨髓切片的組織球浸潤在高倍免疫染色則大多不著色，呈非典型表現。
features: Clinical photograph of an infant with numerous disseminated reddish-brown papules and petechial-appearing lesions over the back, neck and scalp (panel A)

Dense band-like infiltrate of histiocytoid cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm filling the papillary dermis and extending into the epidermis (epidermotropism), with extravasated red cells (panel B)
Strong membranous/cytoplasmic immunostaining of the dermal and intraepidermal infiltrate (panel C; likely CD1a or langerin)
Marrow biopsy with bony trabeculae and an interstitial infiltrate of spindled to oval histiocytic cells (panel Di)
High-power immunostain of the marrow infiltrate with oval/grooved nuclei and largely absent or only faint staining (panel Dii)
29116.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows an infant with widespread red-brown papules over the trunk and scalp. Skin biopsy demonstrates a dense infiltrate of histiocytoid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm occupying the superficial dermis with epidermotropism and red cell extravasation; the lesional cells are strongly positive on immunohistochemistry, highlighting the dermal and intraepidermal distribution. The bone marrow biopsy shows an interstitial infiltrate of oval to spindled histiocytic cells between trabeculae, which at high power show only weak or absent staining for the marker. Findings are consistent with multisystem Langerhans cell histiocytosis with an atypical histiocytic marrow infiltrate; marrow involvement should be confirmed with a CD1a/langerin panel and BRAF V600E studies, as marrow histiocytes may be reactive (HLH-like) rather than Langerhans cells.

ddx.vs: JXG shows foamy histiocytes and Touton giant cells that are CD1a- and langerin-negative, without epidermotropic grooved Langerhans cells.
Leukemia cutis is composed of blasts with fine chromatin expressing CD34/CD117 or monocytic markers rather than grooved CD1a-positive histiocytes.
Mast cell infiltrates have round-to-oval central nuclei with metachromatic granules and are CD117/tryptase-positive, not CD1a-positive.
Reactive marrow macrophages are CD68/CD163-positive and CD1a-negative with hemophagocytosis, which may explain the non-staining marrow histiocytes.

27900.recognize_zh: 皮膚浸潤的單一型態中型腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫、細緻顆粒狀的淡棕色細胞質／膜染色（右下方表皮為陰性對照），代表腫瘤細胞表現所染的造血標記；確切標記名稱未標示，須與其他染色一起判讀是否為骨髓肉瘤。
features: Sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with oval to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Weak-to-moderate, finely granular cytoplasmic/membranous brown staining in most tumor cells
Occasional strongly positive single cell
Overlying epidermis (lower right) negative, serving as internal negative control
Scattered larger pale cells/histiocytes with little or no staining
27900.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of the dermal infiltrate shows sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with oval nuclei and fine chromatin, the majority of which display weak-to-moderate, finely granular cytoplasmic and membranous staining; a rare cell stains strongly. The adjacent epidermis is negative. The specific antibody is not indicated in the image, so the stain must be interpreted alongside the rest of the panel. In context, diffuse positivity of the infiltrate with a myeloid-associated marker supports myeloid sarcoma.

ddx.vs: BPDCN is positive for CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 and negative for MPO and lysozyme.
Lymphoma cells express CD20/PAX5 or CD3 with a lineage-appropriate pattern and lack myeloid markers such as MPO, CD33 and lysozyme.
Histiocytes are CD68/CD163-positive with abundant cytoplasm and lack CD34/CD117 and blastic chromatin.

22844.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中漿細胞明顯增加，核偏心、染色質粗塊狀，部分較不成熟；箭頭所指的漿細胞胞質內可見被吞噬的整顆紅血球（染成淡綠色），把核推向一側，顯示腫瘤性漿細胞的紅血球吞噬現象。
features: Markedly increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face to more open chromatin and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Occasional immature plasma cells with larger nuclei and nucleoli
Plasma cells containing one or more intact phagocytosed red cells in the cytoplasm, indenting the nucleus (arrows)
Red cells stain grey-green in this preparation
Few residual myeloid and erythroid precursors
22844.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate shows a marked increase in plasma cells, including mature and immature forms with eccentric nuclei, coarse-to-open chromatin and moderately basophilic cytoplasm. Several plasma cells contain intact phagocytosed erythrocytes within the cytoplasm, which displace and indent the nucleus (arrows). Residual hematopoiesis is reduced. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with erythrophagocytosis by neoplastic plasma cells; CD138 immunostaining and flow cytometry for light chain restriction confirm the phagocytic cells are clonal plasma cells.

ddx.vs: HLH phagocytes are histiocytes with abundant pale foamy cytoplasm, no perinuclear hof and CD163/CD68 positivity.
Russell bodies are homogeneous immunoglobulin globules that are pink or pale, not biconcave red cells matching background erythrocytes.
Superimposed red cells extend beyond the cell border and do not indent the nucleus or sit within a vacuole.

24956.recognize_zh: 血片中紅血球呈兩群（dimorphic）：一群大小與血色正常，另一群明顯淡染、薄而小，常呈拉長、淚滴或不規則形；在女性慢性小球性貧血中，這種雙群紅血球提示 X 染色體連鎖鐵粒母細胞貧血（XLSA）帶因者的 X 染色體失活偏移。
features: Dimorphic red cell population: normochromic normocytic cells admixed with a distinct population of hypochromic cells
Hypochromic cells thin, often microcytic, with elongated, teardrop and irregular shapes
Some very pale ghost-like red cells with only a rim of hemoglobin
No polychromasia, consistent with a non-regenerative anemia
Platelets present and normal in appearance
24956.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a dimorphic red cell picture with a population of normochromic normocytic erythrocytes and a second population of markedly hypochromic, thin, often microcytic cells, many of which are elongated or teardrop-shaped. Polychromasia is not evident. Platelets appear normal. In a woman with longstanding non-regenerative microcytic anemia, findings are suggestive of X-linked sideroblastic anemia in a heterozygous female with skewed X inactivation; bone marrow iron stain for ring sideroblasts, iron studies and ALAS2 sequencing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Treated iron deficiency shows a dimorphic picture with polychromasia and a rising reticulocyte count, with low ferritin before therapy.
Post-transfusion dimorphism is transient and history-dependent, and ring sideroblasts are absent.
MDS-RS typically occurs in older patients with a macrocytic dimorphic picture, dysplasia and SF3B1 mutation rather than a germline ALAS2 variant.
Thal trait shows uniform microcytosis with target cells and basophilic stippling rather than two distinct populations.

exam.answer_en: Dimorphic red cells suggesting X-linked sideroblastic anemia in a heterozygous female — normochromic plus hypochromic microcytic populations
pearls_zh: 考法：給雙群紅血球血片問「dimorphic picture 的鑑別診斷？」→ sideroblastic anemia、治療中的缺鐵、近期輸血、MDS-RS。
XLSA 由 ALAS2 突變造成 heme 合成障礙；女性帶因者因 X-inactivation 偏移而出現兩群紅血球，且可能隨年齡加重。
確診需骨髓鐵染色見 ring sideroblasts（ICSH：≥5 顆鐵顆粒環繞核周至少 1/3）並做 ALAS2 基因檢測。
部分 XLSA 對 pyridoxine（vitamin B6）有反應；即使不輸血也易鐵過載，需監測 ferritin 並考慮放血或螯合。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為缺鐵性貧血（或其治療中）；缺鐵治療中有多染性紅血球與低 ferritin，XLSA 則鐵存量高、骨髓見 ring sideroblasts。

quiz.q: 女性慢性小球性貧血、血片呈兩群紅血球且無多染性，懷疑遺傳性 sideroblastic anemia 時應檢測哪個基因？
quiz.a: ALAS2（X-linked sideroblastic anemia）

24572.recognize_zh: D 圖骨髓鐵染色可見大量紅血球母細胞核周圍環狀排列的藍色鐵顆粒（環狀鐵粒母細胞, ring sideroblasts），配合周邊血中血小板增多與部分低色素紅血球（雙相性族群），指向 RARS-T（現稱 MDS/MPN-RS-T）。
features: Peripheral blood with increased platelets, including some large platelets (panels A and B)
Red cells show mild anisocytosis with a subpopulation of hypochromic cells (dimorphic picture)
Bone marrow aspirate with erythroid precursors and myeloid cells showing mild dyspoiesis (panel C)
Prussian blue stain shows numerous erythroblasts with coarse perinuclear iron granules encircling the nucleus (ring sideroblasts, panel D)
24572.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows increased platelets with occasional large forms and red cells with mild anisocytosis including a subpopulation of hypochromic cells. Bone marrow aspirate shows active erythropoiesis with erythroid and granulocytic precursors. An iron stain demonstrates numerous ring sideroblasts, with coarse iron granules encircling the nuclei of many erythroblasts. Megakaryocyte morphology and the ring sideroblast percentage cannot be fully assessed from these images. In the setting of chronic anemia with thrombocytosis, findings are consistent with refractory anemia with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis (MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis, typically SF3B1-mutated with JAK2 V617F in about half of cases).

ddx.vs: Shares ring sideroblasts but lacks a platelet count >=450 x 10^9/L and the proliferative, MPN-like megakaryocytes of MDS/MPN-RS-T.
ET shows thrombocytosis with large hyperlobated megakaryocytes but lacks anemia, dyserythropoiesis and >=15% ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Congenital or acquired non-clonal sideroblastic anemia (ALAS2 defect, copper deficiency, alcohol, isoniazid)
ddx.vs: Ring sideroblasts are also present, but history, reversibility with removal of the cause, and absence of SF3B1/JAK2 mutations separate them.
Iron deficiency also causes hypochromia and thrombocytosis but shows absent marrow iron and no ring sideroblasts.

exam.answer_en: MDS/MPN with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis (former RARS-T) — numerous ring sideroblasts on iron stain with thrombocytosis and dimorphic red cells
pearls_zh: 考法：指著鐵染色中核周藍色鐵顆粒環問「這是什麼細胞？」→ ring sideroblast；再結合血小板增多問分類 → MDS/MPN-RS-T。
WHO 5th 稱 MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis；診斷需血小板 ≥450 ×10⁹/L 合併貧血，並具 SF3B1 突變或 ring sideroblasts ≥15%。
分子：SF3B1 突變為主，約半數合併 JAK2 V617F（少數 CALR/MPL）；需排除 BCR::ABL1 與 del(5q)、t(3;3)、inv(3)。
治療：貧血可考慮 luspatercept，血栓風險高者評估 aspirin；預後通常優於其他 MDS/MPN。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 essential thrombocythemia（尤其 JAK2 陽性時）；ET 無貧血、無 dyserythropoiesis 及 ring sideroblasts，需做骨髓鐵染色與 SF3B1 檢測區分。

quiz.q: D 圖鐵染色中核周環狀藍色顆粒的細胞叫什麼？此疾病最具代表性的基因突變為何？
quiz.a: Ring sideroblast；SF3B1（常合併 JAK2 V617F）

20412.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片低倍（A）可見與周圍造血細胞明顯分開、緊密黏聚成團的非造血細胞群（箭頭），高倍（B）為大小一致、細胞質稀少、核互相擠壓的小圓形細胞，符合轉移性神經母細胞瘤（small round blue cell tumor）。
features: Large cohesive syncytial cluster of tumor cells distinct from dispersed marrow elements (panel A, arrow)
Small to medium round cells with high N:C ratio and scant, poorly defined cytoplasm
Round nuclei with finely granular chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli; focal nuclear molding within clusters
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles at cell edges (panel B)
Background hematopoietic cells present; staining has an unusual red-orange cast that limits chromatin detail
20412.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows, at low power, a large cohesive cluster of tumor cells that is clearly separate from the dispersed background hematopoietic elements. At high power the cells are small-to-medium, round, with high N:C ratios, finely granular chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, scant cytoplasm, and focal nuclear molding; a few cells show small cytoplasmic vacuoles. Definite rosettes or fibrillary neuropil are not clearly resolved, and the red-orange staining cast limits fine detail. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by a small round cell tumor, in keeping with metastatic neuroblastoma; confirmation by biopsy with immunohistochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, chromogranin; CD45 negative) and urine catecholamines is recommended.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are dispersed singly rather than in cohesive clusters with molding, and are CD45/TdT/CD19 or CD3 positive by flow, whereas neuroblastoma is CD45-negative and CD56/GD2 positive.
Ewing sarcoma cells may also cluster and contain cytoplasmic glycogen vacuoles, and are separated by CD99/NKX2.2 positivity and EWSR1 rearrangement rather than PHOX2B.
Rhabdomyosarcoma cells often have more abundant, sometimes vacuolated cytoplasm and occasional multinucleation, and express desmin and myogenin.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles, are non-cohesive, and are CD45/CD20/CD10 positive with MYC rearrangement.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic neuroblastoma in bone marrow — cohesive clusters of small round cells with scant cytoplasm and nuclear molding, separate from hematopoietic cells
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍考官指成團的細胞問「這是造血細胞嗎」；答案：緊密黏聚成團、核互相擠壓（molding）提示非造血的 small round blue cell tumor，兒童首先想 neuroblastoma。
確認：IHC PHOX2B、synaptophysin、chromogranin 陽性，CD45 陰性；flow 可見 CD45−CD56+、GD2+ 族群。尿液 VMA/HVA 升高支持診斷。
分期與預後：骨髓侵犯評估需雙側抽吸與切片；MYCN amplification 為不良預後指標，MIBG 掃描評估轉移。
典型臨床線索：眼眶轉移造成眼周瘀青（raccoon eyes）、opsoclonus-myoclonus 症候群；Homer Wright rosettes 與 neuropil 若可見更支持診斷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 ALL（L1 blasts）；ALL 細胞呈單顆分散、無黏聚與核擠壓，flow 為 CD45+ 且表現 CD19/CD10 或 TdT，neuroblastoma 則 CD45 與 TdT 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖 A 箭頭所指、與周圍造血細胞分開的黏聚細胞團，在兒童最可能是什麼腫瘤？哪一項尿液檢查可支持診斷？
quiz.a: 轉移性 neuroblastoma；尿液 catecholamine 代謝物 VMA/HVA。

18364.recognize_zh: 這是 Kaplan-Meier 整體存活曲線（非形態學影像）：DLBCL 移植後復發時依年齡校正 IPI 分組，aaIPI 0–1（紅線，長期約 60%）存活明顯優於 aaIPI 2–3（藍線，約 36%），p < 0.0001。
features: Kaplan-Meier overall survival curves over about 72 months
