Red curve: age-adjusted IPI 0-1, about 72% at 4 years and plateau near 60%
Blue curve: age-adjusted IPI 2-3, early steep decline to about 60% at 2 years and about 36% at 5-6 years
Log-rank p < 0.0001
Numerous censoring tick marks
18364.describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows Kaplan-Meier overall survival for patients with relapsed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma stratified by the age-adjusted International Prognostic Index (aaIPI) at the time of relapse. Patients with aaIPI 0-1 had markedly better survival, plateauing at about 60%, than those with aaIPI 2-3, whose survival fell to about 36% (p < 0.0001). The separation appears early, within the first 12 months, indicating that the aaIPI at relapse remains a strong prognostic factor in the transplant setting.

16892.recognize_zh: 成熟嗜中性球的細胞核只有兩葉，呈對稱的眼鏡狀（pince-nez）或花生狀，染色質非常粗糙團塊狀，而細胞質顆粒正常，是 Pelger-Huët 異常的典型表現。
features: Mature-sized neutrophils with bilobed nuclei forming symmetric spectacle-like (pince-nez) or peanut-shaped configurations
Markedly coarse, clumped, mature chromatin inappropriate for the degree of lobation
Normal pale cytoplasm with fine specific granules; no hypogranulation
Uniform involvement of all neutrophils in the field
Background red cells largely normocytic and normochromic
16892.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils of normal size whose nuclei are uniformly hyposegmented, forming bilobed pince-nez or peanut-shaped configurations with coarsely clumped, mature chromatin. The cytoplasm is normally granulated, and no dysplastic hypogranulation is seen. Red cells are essentially unremarkable. In a patient without myelodysplasia or drug exposure, findings are consistent with congenital Pelger-Huët anomaly (LBR mutation).

ddx.vs: Acquired pseudo-Pelger cells usually affect only a subset of neutrophils and are accompanied by cytoplasmic hypogranulation, cytopenias and other dysplastic features, whereas congenital PHA involves nearly all neutrophils with normal granulation.
Agents such as mycophenolate, taxanes, valproate or tacrolimus cause reversible hyposegmentation with a temporal drug association; morphology alone may be indistinguishable.
Bands have a non-segmented horseshoe nucleus with less condensed chromatin, and are accompanied by toxic granulation or Döhle bodies in infection.
Immature precursors have round or kidney-shaped nuclei with finer chromatin and more basophilic cytoplasm, not symmetric bilobed nuclei with dense chromatin.

exam.answer_en: Congenital Pelger-Huët anomaly — uniformly bilobed pince-nez/peanut nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin and normal granulation
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指雙葉對稱眼鏡狀核問名稱→Pelger-Huët cell，並問「先天或後天怎麼分？」答：看是否幾乎全部中性球受影響、顆粒是否正常、有無血球減少與家族史。
遺傳：lamin B receptor（LBR）基因突變，體染色體顯性；heterozygote 為雙葉核且中性球功能正常，罕見 homozygote 核呈圓形並可合併骨骼異常。
臨床陷阱：自動或人工分類可能把 Pelger 細胞當成 band，造成假性「left shift」，被誤判為感染。
檢查家族成員的周邊血抹片可以快速確認先天性，避免不必要的骨髓檢查。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易與 MDS 的 pseudo-Pelger 混淆：先天型全面且均一、顆粒正常、血球數正常；pseudo-Pelger 僅部分細胞、常低顆粒並伴血球減少或其他 dysplasia。

quiz.q: 圖中雙葉對稱、染色質粗糙的中性球稱為什麼？先天型的致病基因為何？
quiz.a: Pelger-Huët cell；lamin B receptor（LBR）

14396.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中在脂肪空泡之間有瀰漫浸潤的單一型小至中型細胞，核圓至卵圓或腎形、彼此間距均勻，周圍有清楚的淡染胞質暈，形成「荷包蛋（fried egg）」外觀，這是毛狀細胞白血病的典型骨髓切片表現。
features: Interstitial to diffuse infiltrate of monotonous small to intermediate lymphoid cells
Round, oval to reniform nuclei with bland chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Abundant clear to pale cytoplasm creating evenly spaced nuclei with perinuclear halos (fried egg appearance)
Cells separated by clear space rather than tightly packed; residual fat spaces and a bony trabecula present
Scattered extravasated red cells; mitotic figures are not evident
14396.describe_en: H&E-stained bone marrow trephine biopsy shows an interstitial to diffuse infiltrate of monotonous small to intermediate cells between residual fat spaces. The cells have round to reniform nuclei with bland chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and abundant clear cytoplasm, so that nuclei appear widely and evenly spaced with a fried egg appearance. Normal hematopoietic elements are reduced in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia; confirmation with CD20, annexin A1, cyclin D1, CD103/CD25/CD11c flow cytometry and BRAF V600E is recommended, together with reticulin staining.

ddx.vs: Mast cells form spindle-shaped aggregates with eosinophils and fibrosis and stain for tryptase, CD117 and CD25 rather than CD20 and annexin A1.
SMZL forms nodular and intrasinusoidal infiltrates with less cytoplasm and is annexin A1 and BRAF V600E negative.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular myelodysplastic neoplasm or aplastic anemia
ddx.vs: Hypocellular marrow lacks a monotonous CD20-positive infiltrate and shows residual trilineage hematopoiesis instead.
HCL-variant cells have prominent nucleoli, less reticulin fibrosis and are CD25 and annexin A1 negative.

exam.answer_en: Hairy cell leukemia in marrow biopsy — monotonous cells with evenly spaced nuclei and abundant clear cytoplasm (fried egg appearance)
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 骨髓切片問「這是什麼外觀、代表什麼」→ fried egg，核與核間距寬且均勻，為 HCL 骨髓侵犯的經典表現。
抽吸常為 dry tap，因為 reticulin 纖維增加；所以 HCL 的骨髓侵犯程度要靠切片與 CD20、annexin A1 等 IHC 評估。
部分 HCL 骨髓呈低細胞性，易被誤判為 aplastic anemia 或 hypoplastic MDS；全血球減少合併脾腫大時一定要做 CD20 IHC。
治療反應與預後：cladribine 或 pentostatin 可達長期緩解；復發或難治者可考慮 BRAF inhibitor（如 vemurafenib，可合併 rituximab）。
exam.pitfall_zh: fried egg 型透亮胞質也見於 systemic mastocytosis；mastocytosis 常為紡錘形細胞、在血管或骨小樑旁聚集，tryptase/CD117 陽性，HCL 則為 CD20、annexin A1 陽性。

quiz.q: 這張骨髓切片中細胞核間距均勻、胞質透亮的外觀稱為什麼？為什麼 HCL 骨髓抽吸常失敗？
quiz.a: Fried egg appearance；reticulin 纖維增加造成 dry tap

12540.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中三顆嗜中性球的外緣被一圈血小板環繞黏附（platelet satellitism），這是 EDTA 採血管體外現象，會讓自動計數誤判為血小板低下（pseudothrombocytopenia）。
features: Rosettes of numerous platelets adherent around the cell membrane of neutrophils
Encircled neutrophils are morphologically normal with segmented nuclei and fine granules
Platelets elsewhere in the background are sparse
No platelet phagocytosis or large platelet clumps evident in this field
Red cells normocytic without significant poikilocytosis
12540.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from an EDTA-anticoagulated sample shows several neutrophils each rimmed by a ring of adherent platelets (platelet satellitism). The neutrophils and red cells otherwise appear morphologically unremarkable, and free platelets in the background are relatively sparse because many are sequestered around the granulocytes. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism causing spurious (pseudo) thrombocytopenia; a repeat count on citrate- or heparin-anticoagulated blood is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumping forms free aggregates of platelets in the smear, particularly at the feathered edge, rather than platelets rosetting around neutrophils.
ITP shows genuinely few, often large platelets without satellitism, and the low count persists in citrate-anticoagulated samples.
Phagocytosed platelets appear within the neutrophil cytoplasm, sometimes in vacuoles, rather than adhering to the outer cell surface.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism (EDTA-induced) — rosettes of platelets adhering around neutrophils, causing spurious thrombocytopenia
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中性球外圍一圈血小板，問現象名稱與對血小板計數的影響；被環繞的中性球本身型態正常。
機轉：EDTA 依賴性 IgG 自體抗體同時結合血小板 GPIIb/IIIa 與中性球 FcγRIII（CD16），使血小板黏附於中性球外緣；屬體外現象，無臨床出血意義。
處理：與 EDTA 依賴性血小板聚集相同，改以 citrate 或 heparin 抗凝管重抽，或直接指尖血抹片；可與 platelet clumping 同時存在。
報告原則：凡自動計數血小板低下且無出血，應在抹片上排除 satellitism 與 clumping，並於報告註記，避免不必要的骨髓檢查或輸血。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為中性球吞噬血小板（platelet phagocytosis）：吞噬時血小板位於中性球細胞質內；satellitism 的血小板排列在細胞膜外緣呈花環狀。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球周圍環繞血小板的現象叫什麼？它會使血小板計數產生什麼偏差？
quiz.a: Platelet satellitism；假性血小板低下（pseudothrombocytopenia）

3516.recognize_zh: 中央一顆大小正常、未脹大的紅血球內同時有兩個纖細的環狀滋養體，各帶一個深紅色染色質點，單一紅血球多重感染加上細環形態，是惡性瘧（P. falciparum）的典型線索。
features: Normal-sized red cell containing two delicate ring-form trophozoites (multiply infected red cell)
Each ring has a thin rim of blue cytoplasm and a single dark red chromatin dot
Infected red cell is not enlarged and lacks Schüffner stippling
A separate red cell (upper left) with a small dark chromatin body that may be another early ring
Background normocytic red cells and scattered small platelets; no gametocytes or schizonts in this field
3516.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells, one of which contains two small delicate ring-form trophozoites, each with a single chromatin dot. The infected cell is not enlarged and shows no Schüffner stippling, and a second red cell contains a small chromatin body suggestive of an additional ring. Mature trophozoites, schizonts and banana-shaped gametocytes are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium infection, most suggestive of P. falciparum; quantify parasitemia and confirm species urgently.

ddx.vs: Babesia rings are pleomorphic, may be extracellular or form tetrads, and lack hemozoin pigment and gametocytes, often in an asplenic patient with tick exposure.
P. vivax infects enlarged red cells with Schüffner dots and shows thicker amoeboid trophozoites; multiple rings per cell are uncommon.
Early rings may look similar, but later stages show band-form trophozoites and rosette schizonts, and species confirmation requires PCR.
Artifacts lie in a different focal plane and lack the combination of a blue cytoplasmic ring with a discrete red chromatin dot.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium falciparum malaria — two delicate ring forms within a single normal-sized red cell (multiply infected RBC)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指含兩個環狀體的紅血球，問物種；falciparum 線索：細小環狀體、單一紅血球多重感染、紅血球不脹大、可見 appliqué 型、香蕉狀配子體。
判讀要點：falciparum 周邊血通常只見環狀體與配子體；成熟 trophozoite/schizont 隔離於微血管。若見大量 schizont，要提高 P. vivax/ovale/knowlesi 等懷疑。
檢查：thick smear 看有無、thin smear 定物種與算寄生率；快篩（如 HRP2 抗原）輔助；單次陰性不能排除，應重複抹片。
臨床：falciparum 可快速進展為重症（腦性瘧疾、嚴重貧血、急性腎損傷、低血糖、高寄生率）；重症首選靜脈 artesunate。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Babesia：Babesia 環狀體可呈四聯 Maltese cross、常見紅血球外蟲體、無瘧色素且無配子體；另需排除疊在紅血球上的血小板（無環形胞質）。

quiz.q: 此紅血球內含兩個細環狀體且紅血球未脹大，最可能是哪一種瘧原蟲？重症首選治療為何？
quiz.a: Plasmodium falciparum；靜脈 artesunate。

1276.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中多顆中小型淋巴球，核圓或有凹陷（notched／腎形），染色質中度凝集，部分可見小核仁，胞質少到中等且偏深藍、邊緣有時有小突起；這群外觀成熟但核不規則、胞質嗜鹼性的淋巴球增多，符合 T 細胞前淋巴球白血病（T-PLL）。
features: Small to medium-sized lymphoid cells, larger than a small mature lymphocyte
Round to irregular nuclei with notches or indentations; moderately condensed chromatin
Small but visible nucleoli in some cells
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm, occasionally with small cytoplasmic protrusions
Adjacent normal segmented neutrophil for size comparison; red cells without significant abnormalities
1276.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase in small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with round to irregular, notched nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, small visible nucleoli in a subset, and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm that occasionally forms small protrusions. A normal segmented neutrophil is present for comparison, and red cells appear unremarkable. The cells lack the fine blastic chromatin of lymphoblasts. Findings are consistent with T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia, to be confirmed by flow cytometry (mature T-cell phenotype, often CD4+, TdT-negative with TCL1A overexpression) and cytogenetics for inv(14)/t(14;14) or t(X;14).

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts have fine blastic chromatin and are TdT/CD1a positive, whereas T-PLL cells have more condensed chromatin and a mature TdT-negative phenotype.
Sezary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei with condensed chromatin and no nucleoli, and occur with erythroderma, lacking TCL1A rearrangement.
ATLL shows multilobated flower cells and is HTLV-1 associated and CD25 positive.
CLL cells are small B cells with block-like clumped chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm, and are CD5+/CD23+/CD19+ rather than T-cell.

exam.answer_en: T-cell prolymphocytic leukemia — lymphocytosis of small-to-medium cells with notched nuclei, visible nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm with protrusions
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著核有凹陷、胞質嗜鹼性且有小突起的淋巴球問診斷與確認方法；答 T-PLL，需 flow 證明成熟 T 細胞表型並做 TCL1 相關遺傳檢查。
Flow：TdT−、CD1a−（成熟 T 細胞），sCD3+、CD7 強陽性；多數 CD4+CD8−，少數 CD4+CD8+ 或 CD4−CD8+；CD52 高表現。
遺傳：inv(14)(q11.2q32.1) 或 t(14;14) 造成 TCL1A 活化，少數為 t(X;14) MTCP1；常合併 ATM 異常；TCL1 IHC 或 FISH 可輔助診斷。
臨床：常見淋巴球顯著增多、脾腫大、皮膚浸潤與漿膜腔積液，病程侵襲性；第一線常用 alemtuzumab（anti-CD52），適合者以 allogeneic HSCT 鞏固。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Sézary syndrome 混淆：Sézary 細胞核為 cerebriform、常 CD7− 與 CD26−，且有紅皮症；T-PLL 核圓或凹陷、核仁可見、CD7 強陽性並有 TCL1A 重排。另 T-ALL 為 TdT+。

quiz.q: 圖中這群淋巴球若為 T-PLL，最具特徵的染色體異常與過度表現的基因為何？

1212.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組織化學染色中，幾乎整片造血組織被強陽性、呈膜狀棕色染色的單一細胞群瀰漫性取代，只殘留少數藍色未染的正常造血細胞，符合毛細胞白血病的瀰漫間質浸潤；標記名稱未註明，推測為 B 細胞標記（如 CD20）。
features: Hypercellular marrow with diffuse, sheet-like replacement of the intertrabecular space
Strong, uniform membranous brown staining of nearly all hematopoietic-space cells
Cells are evenly spaced with regular outlines, producing a honeycomb-like pattern
Only small clusters of unstained (blue) residual hematopoietic cells remain
Interspersed fat spaces without paratrabecular or nodular aggregation
1212.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunohistochemical stain at low magnification shows a hypercellular marrow diffusely infiltrated by a monotonous cell population with strong, uniform membranous staining. The positive cells are evenly spaced in an interstitial-to-diffuse pattern and replace most of the marrow, with only small foci of unstained residual hematopoietic cells. The specific antibody is not stated; the membranous pattern is most consistent with a pan-B-cell marker such as CD20. In conjunction with morphology and hairy cell-specific markers (annexin A1, cyclin D1, BRAF V600E VE1), findings are consistent with extensive marrow involvement by hairy cell leukemia.

ddx.vs: SMZL typically shows intrasinusoidal and nodular patterns rather than diffuse evenly spaced infiltration, and is annexin A1, cyclin D1 and BRAF VE1 negative.
CLL infiltrates are nodular or packed without the widely spaced fried-egg pattern and are CD5/CD23-positive with LEF1 expression.
HCL-v shows a similar B-cell infiltrate but is annexin A1 and BRAF VE1 negative.
DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and a high Ki-67, rather than small evenly spaced cells.

1020.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片上方有一團黏著的大細胞群，其中散布黑褐色粗大色素顆粒，下方血液背景中也見到含黑色色素的細胞，提示轉移性黑色素瘤（melanin色素）。
features: Low-power field with a cohesive cluster of large cells at the top of the smear
Coarse black-brown intracellular pigment (melanin) in many cells of the cluster
Scattered isolated pigment-laden cells and small clusters within the peripheral blood background
Large cells with abundant cytoplasm and prominent nuclei, though nuclear detail is limited at this magnification
Normal hematopoietic elements sparse in the field
1020.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a cohesive aggregate of large cells at the edge of a particle, with numerous cells containing coarse black-brown cytoplasmic pigment. Similar pigmented cells and small clusters are scattered in the blood background. Nuclear detail is limited at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of metastatic malignant melanoma involving the marrow; confirmation with immunostains (SOX10, S100, HMB-45, Melan-A) on the biopsy is recommended.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin appears as blue-green to golden refractile granules in dispersed histiocytes and is Prussian blue positive, whereas melanin is black-brown in cohesive atypical cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters but lacks melanin pigment and is keratin positive and SOX10 negative.
Precipitate lies on top of cells and in cell-free areas in a different focal plane rather than within cytoplasm.

1148.recognize_zh: 淋巴結壞死區中大量核碎片與發炎細胞，並散在數顆細胞核增大、呈均質毛玻璃樣紫色並有核邊緣化的細胞，提示疱疹病毒核內包涵體，符合HSV淋巴結炎。
features: Necrotic background with abundant karyorrhectic debris and fibrin
Scattered enlarged cells with homogeneous glassy purple nuclei and marginated chromatin (suggestive of viral cytopathic effect)
Mixed inflammatory cells including neutrophils and apoptotic cells
Extravasated red cells and a round fat vacuole
Nuclear molding and multinucleation not clearly resolved at this magnification
1148.describe_en: Lymph node section shows necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic nuclear debris, fibrin, neutrophils, and extravasated red cells. Scattered enlarged cells within the necrotic area have homogeneous, glassy purple nuclei with peripheral chromatin margination, suggestive of herpesvirus intranuclear inclusions. Classic multinucleation and molding are not clearly seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with necrotizing herpes simplex virus lymphadenitis; HSV immunohistochemistry or PCR is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: CMV cells are much larger with a single owl-eye inclusion surrounded by a halo plus granular cytoplasmic inclusions, and necrosis is usually less extensive.
Kikuchi lacks neutrophils and viral inclusions, featuring crescentic histiocytes and plasmacytoid dendritic cells.
Lymphoma shows sheets of atypical large cells at the viable edge with B- or T-cell markers, rather than scattered ground-glass nuclei.

4220.recognize_zh: 皮膚切片免疫染色中，真皮血管周圍成團的中型異型淋巴球呈強陽性，且有陽性細胞散入表皮基底層（epidermotropism），符合 T 細胞淋巴瘤侵犯皮膚；需配合 HTLV-1 血清學才能歸為 ATLL。
features: Dermal perivascular aggregates of medium-sized lymphoid cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic brown immunoreactivity
Positive cells have irregular, somewhat enlarged nuclei compared with background stromal cells
Scattered positive cells within the basal layer of the epidermis and hair follicle epithelium (epidermotropism/folliculotropism)
Scattered single positive cells in the intervening dermis
Fibroblasts, endothelium and keratinocytes are negative (internal negative control)
4220.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a skin biopsy (specific marker not indicated in the image) highlights perivascular dermal aggregates of atypical medium-sized lymphoid cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining. Positive cells also infiltrate the basal epidermis and follicular epithelium as single cells. Keratinocytes and stromal cells are negative. The staining pattern supports a cutaneous T-cell infiltrate; in the appropriate context (HTLV-1 seropositivity, CD4+/CD25+ phenotype), findings are consistent with cutaneous involvement by adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: MF shows a similar epidermotropic CD4+ infiltrate, so separation relies on HTLV-1 serology/monoclonal integration and the strong, diffuse CD25 expression typical of ATLL.
Lymphomatoid papulosis/cutaneous ALCL show large anaplastic cells with uniform strong CD30, whereas this infiltrate is composed of medium-sized cells.
Reactive infiltrates consist of small, non-atypical mixed T cells without clonal markers or HTLV-1 association.

4092.recognize_zh: 免疫染色中大型、細胞質豐富、核形怪異的腫瘤細胞呈強膜狀加核旁高爾基體點狀（Golgi dot）陽性，背景小淋巴球陰性，這正是 CD30 的典型染色型態，見於間變型 DLBCL 或 ALCL。
features: Large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm and irregular, sometimes kidney-shaped or multilobated nuclei
Strong membranous staining with paranuclear Golgi-zone dot accentuation
Positive cells scattered singly and in small clusters
Background small lymphocytes and histiocytes negative
Staining pattern typical of CD30 (marker not labeled in image)
4092.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain (marker not labeled; pattern typical of CD30) shows scattered and clustered large pleomorphic tumor cells with abundant cytoplasm and irregular to horseshoe-shaped nuclei displaying strong membranous and paranuclear Golgi-dot staining. Background small lymphocytes are negative. In a tumor classified as the anaplastic variant of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, CD30 expression is expected; confirmation of B-cell lineage (CD20, PAX5, CD79a) and absence of ALK and T-cell markers is required to exclude anaplastic large cell lymphoma and classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: ALCL shows similar CD30+ hallmark cells but is PAX5/CD20-negative with T-cell or cytotoxic markers, whereas anaplastic DLBCL expresses strong B-cell antigens.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and loss of CD20/CD45, set in a mixed inflammatory background rather than sheets.
ALK-positive ALCL shows ALK protein expression (nuclear/cytoplasmic) by IHC.
Carcinoma and melanoma are CD45-negative and express keratins or S100/SOX10.

4156.recognize_zh: 整片密集排列的中小型淋巴細胞呈強烈、完整的細胞膜型（membranous）免疫染色；此為表面標記染色，本身無法單獨確立被套細胞淋巴瘤，需搭配 cyclin D1／SOX11。
features: Diffuse sheet of densely packed, medium-sized lymphoid cells
Strong, crisp circumferential membranous brown staining in nearly all tumor cells
Unstained pale nuclei that appear round to slightly irregular; nuclear detail limited by the chromogen
No residual negative background population evident in this field
Antigen not specified in the image; pattern fits a surface marker (e.g., CD20 or CD5)
4156.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows a diffuse, monotonous population of medium-sized lymphoid cells with strong, uniform membranous staining. Nuclear features are partially obscured, and the specific antigen is not identified in the image. A diffuse membranous-positive neoplastic infiltrate of this type supports a mature lymphoid neoplasm, and in combination with cyclin D1 or SOX11 nuclear positivity, CD5 co-expression, and t(11;14), it is consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Also CD5+/CD20+ but shows proliferation centers, dim surface markers, LEF1/CD23 positivity and lacks cyclin D1/SOX11.
Cells are larger with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, and cyclin D1 is typically negative.
CD10/BCL6 positive and CD5/cyclin D1 negative, usually with a follicular dendritic meshwork.
CD5-negative and cyclin D1-negative, often with monocytoid cells and plasmacytic differentiation.

4028.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血中血小板明顯偏多、散布整個視野，白血球僅見少數嗜中性球、單核球與淋巴球，紅血球大小不一且部分色淡；血小板增多合併貧血時，需以骨髓鐵染色找環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblast）來診斷伴環狀鐵粒母細胞與血小板增多之 MDS/MPN（MDS/MPN-RS-T）。
features: Increased platelets scattered throughout the field, including occasional large forms
Mild anisocytosis with a subset of paler, hypochromic-appearing red cells (possible dimorphic population)
Normal-appearing segmented neutrophils without obvious dysplasia at this power
Occasional monocytes and lymphocytes; no blasts seen
No nucleated red cells or teardrop cells evident
4028.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows thrombocytosis with scattered large platelets. Red cells show mild anisocytosis with a suggestion of a paler hypochromic subpopulation. White cells include segmented neutrophils, occasional monocytes and lymphocytes, without blasts or leukoerythroblastic features. The blood findings are nonspecific; in a patient with anemia and thrombocytosis, they are compatible with myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis, which requires bone marrow iron stain and SF3B1/JAK2 studies for confirmation.

ddx.vs: ET shows thrombocytosis without anemia, dimorphic red cells or marrow ring sideroblasts of 15% or more.
Iron deficiency causes thrombocytosis with uniformly hypochromic microcytes and absent marrow iron, rather than ring sideroblasts.
MDS-RS has a normal or low platelet count, whereas MDS/MPN-RS-T requires a platelet count of at least 450 x 10^9/L.
Congenital forms present young with microcytosis and without thrombocytosis or clonal SF3B1/JAK2 mutations.

3836.recognize_zh: 箭頭指出數個細胞核圓而極度深染緻密、周圍僅剩少量嗜酸性細胞質的巨核細胞，旁邊仍有正常分葉的巨核細胞可比較，即為「木乃伊化」巨核細胞。
features: Megakaryocytes with round, dense, homogeneously hyperchromatic nuclei and a rim of eosinophilic cytoplasm (arrows)
Adjacent megakaryocyte with a normal lobulated nucleus for comparison (left)
Hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis
Megakaryocytes dispersed singly, not clustered
Bony trabecula at top; interstitial fat spaces preserved
3836.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Scattered megakaryocytes (arrows) have round, dense, homogeneously hyperchromatic nuclei with a thin rim of eosinophilic cytoplasm, consistent with degenerating 'mummified' megakaryocytes, while others retain normal lobulated nuclei. No megakaryocyte clustering or fibrosis is apparent. Findings are consistent with increased megakaryocyte turnover as seen in immune thrombocytopenia, in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Micromegakaryocytes are small with a single non-lobated nucleus but retain open chromatin and preserved cytoplasm, and occur with multilineage dysplasia.
Plasma cells have eccentric clock-face nuclei and amphophilic cytoplasm, and immunostains (CD61 vs CD138) resolve difficult cases.

ddx.dx: Mitotic figures or apoptotic hematopoietic cells
ddx.vs: Mitoses show clumped chromosomes and apoptotic cells are smaller with fragmented nuclei, unlike the larger megakaryocytes with dense round nuclei here.

3772.recognize_zh: 背景是大量小淋巴球和淡粉紅細胞質的組織球，其中散在少數大型細胞，核大、空泡狀染色質且核仁明顯，大細胞並未成片，符合 T 細胞／組織球豐富型大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Diffuse effacement with a mixed background of small, dark, round lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Scattered, singly dispersed large atypical cells with vesicular chromatin and distinct nucleoli
Large cells do not form sheets or clusters
Occasional mitotic figure and apoptotic bodies
Eosinophils and plasma cells are not conspicuous
3772.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows diffuse effacement by a polymorphous infiltrate composed predominantly of small lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes. Scattered among these are isolated large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, which do not form aggregates or sheets. Eosinophils and plasma cells are not prominent. Findings are consistent with T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD3, CD30, CD15, EMA) is needed to confirm B-cell lineage of the large cells and exclude classic and nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: NLPHL retains at least a partial nodular pattern with FDC meshworks and small B cells, whereas THRLBCL is diffuse with a T-cell/histiocyte background lacking small B cells.
HRS cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and CD20-negative or weak, often in a background rich in eosinophils and plasma cells.
In PTCL the atypical cells are T cells (CD3+, CD20-) with a spectrum of sizes rather than isolated large CD20+ B cells.

exam.answer_en: T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma — scattered single large atypical cells in a diffuse background of small lymphocytes and histiocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指那幾顆有明顯核仁的大細胞問「這些是什麼細胞、背景是什麼」，答腫瘤性大 B 細胞散在於大量反應性 T 細胞與組織球之中，不成片。
IHC 必考組合：大細胞 CD20+、PAX5+、BCL6+，CD30−、CD15−；背景為 CD3+ T 細胞與 CD68/CD163+ 組織球，小 B 細胞極少，CD21/CD23 染不出 FDC meshwork。
腫瘤性大 B 細胞通常只佔少數（常 <10%），因此容易被當作反應性淋巴結炎或 Hodgkin lymphoma。
臨床：常為中年男性、診斷時多已晚期並侵犯脾、肝、骨髓，治療比照 DLBCL（R-CHOP）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤診為 classic Hodgkin lymphoma；CHL 的 HRS 細胞 CD30+/CD15+、CD20 陰性或弱，背景富含嗜酸性球與漿細胞，THRLBCL 大細胞 CD20 強陽性、CD30/CD15 陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中散在的大型細胞應以哪組 IHC 證明是 B 細胞並排除 Hodgkin lymphoma？
quiz.a: CD20/PAX5 陽性，CD30 與 CD15 陰性

3580.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 H&E 中央有一大片界線清楚、由淡嗜酸性紡錘形細胞構成的纖維化病灶，夾雜外滲紅血球，與周邊保留的正常造血組織和脂肪細胞形成對比；這種局部紡錘形細胞纖維化病灶是系統性肥大細胞症的典型切片表現。
features: Well-demarcated focal lesion composed of spindle-shaped cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and oval bland nuclei
Associated fibrosis with streaming/fascicular arrangement and extravasated red cells
Adjacent preserved hematopoietic marrow with fat cells at the periphery
Scattered small lymphocytes at the lesion edge
No marked nuclear atypia or mitotic activity at this power
3580.describe_en: Section of bone marrow trephine biopsy shows a well-circumscribed focal lesion composed of spindle-shaped cells with pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and bland oval nuclei in a fibrotic, streaming background with extravasated red cells. The lesion is sharply demarcated from adjacent preserved hematopoietic marrow and fat, with scattered lymphocytes at its periphery. No significant atypia or mitotic activity is seen at this magnification. The findings are suggestive of a mast cell lesion of systemic mastocytosis, to be confirmed with tryptase, CD117, and CD25 immunostains and KIT D816V testing.

ddx.vs: Fibrosis is diffuse with atypical clustered megakaryocytes rather than a sharply demarcated tryptase-positive spindle cell focus.

ddx.dx: Reactive fibrotic focus or healing biopsy site
ddx.vs: Spindle cells are fibroblasts or histiocytes negative for tryptase and CD25.
Infiltrate consists of CD20+/annexin A1+ fried-egg cells with reticulin fibrosis, not tryptase-positive spindle cells.
Tumor cells show nuclear pleomorphism and mitoses with lineage-specific markers rather than bland mast cells.

exam.answer_en: Systemic mastocytosis, bone marrow biopsy — well-circumscribed fibrotic focal lesion of spindle-shaped mast cells
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 上考官指界線清楚的紡錘形細胞纖維化病灶，問下一步；答需做 tryptase、CD117、CD25 IHC 證實為肥大細胞。
SM 骨髓病灶常伴嗜酸球與淋巴球聚集於周邊；紡錘形肥大細胞 >25% 是 WHO 次要準則之一。
應同時檢測 serum tryptase 與 KIT D816V；並評估 B-findings、C-findings 以區分 indolent、smoldering 與 advanced SM。
部分 SM 合併其他骨髓性腫瘤（SM-AHN），骨髓切片需同時評估背景造血是否有 MDS/MPN/CMML 等病變。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 myelofibrosis 或活檢後修復性纖維化；SM 病灶為局部界線清楚、以紡錘形細胞為主並伴嗜酸球，周邊造血正常，IHC tryptase/CD25 陽性可確認。

quiz.q: 骨髓切片見此界線清楚的紡錘形細胞纖維化病灶，應加做哪三種 IHC 以證實系統性肥大細胞症？
quiz.a: Tryptase、CD117（KIT）、CD25（可加 CD30）。

3644.recognize_zh: 非常細胞化的骨髓抹片中絕大多數是顆粒球系：核圓或凹陷、細胞質帶淡粉顆粒的骨髓細胞與後骨髓細胞，以及帶狀核、分葉核，而深藍細胞質的紅血球母細胞相對少，符合顆粒球增生。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate with a predominance of granulocytic precursors
Numerous myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to kidney-shaped nuclei and pink-granular cytoplasm
Many bands and segmented neutrophils indicating preserved maturation
Relatively fewer erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei, giving an increased M:E ratio
No obvious blast excess; scattered promyelocytes and occasional larger precursors only
3644.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly cellular and composed predominantly of granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation, with numerous myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils. Erythroid precursors are relatively decreased, resulting in an increased myeloid-to-erythroid ratio. Maturation appears orderly and blasts are not conspicuously increased in this field. Findings are consistent with granulocytic hyperplasia; correlation with infection, growth factor therapy and CBC is recommended, and BCR::ABL1 testing should be considered if basophilia or a myelocyte bulge is present.

ddx.vs: Shows a similar left-shifted granulocytic expansion but typically with basophilia, eosinophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes, and requires BCR::ABL1 demonstration.
Has ≥20% myeloblasts, often with Auer rods, whereas this field shows predominantly maturing forms without a blast excess.
Features predominantly mature neutrophils with minimal left shift and a CSF3R mutation, and is a diagnosis of exclusion after reactive causes.

3196.recognize_zh: 高倍下大量大型組織球有豐富淡染、泡沫狀的細胞質與圓形空泡狀核及小核仁，其中數顆細胞質內可見完整的淋巴球或中性球被包在空隙中（emperipolesis），背景夾雜漿細胞與淋巴球，是 Rosai-Dorfman 病的典型線索。
features: Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale, foamy to finely vacuolated cytoplasm
Round vesicular nuclei with fine chromatin and small distinct nucleoli
Intact lymphocytes and neutrophils within histiocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis), often in clear halos
Admixed plasma cells and small lymphocytes in the background
No significant nuclear atypia or atypical mitoses
3196.describe_en: High-power section of lymph node shows sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale, foamy cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli. Several histiocytes contain intact lymphocytes and neutrophils within their cytoplasm, surrounded by clear halos (emperipolesis). Plasma cells and small lymphocytes are admixed, and there is no significant nuclear atypia. Findings are consistent with Rosai-Dorfman disease (sinus histiocytosis with massive lymphadenopathy), to be confirmed by S100 and OCT2 positivity and CD1a negativity.

ddx.vs: LCH cells have grooved, folded coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophil-rich background and are CD1a/langerin positive, lacking prominent emperipolesis.
Ordinary sinus histiocytes are smaller with less abundant cytoplasm, lack emperipolesis and are S100 negative.
Metastatic tumor cells show nuclear pleomorphism, macronucleoli and mitoses and are keratin or melan-A/HMB45 positive rather than bland S100-positive histiocytes engulfing lymphocytes.

exam.answer_en: Rosai-Dorfman disease — large pale histiocytes with vesicular nuclei showing emperipolesis of lymphocytes and neutrophils
pearls_zh: 考法：H&E 高倍指胞質內含完整淋巴球的大型淡染組織球，問現象（emperipolesis）與疾病，並追問確認用的 IHC。
臨床典型：年輕人雙側無痛巨大頸部淋巴結，可伴發燒、ESR 上升、polyclonal hypergammaglobulinemia；結外好發皮膚、鼻腔、眼眶與骨。
低倍型態：淋巴竇明顯擴張並充滿這些組織球，竇間常見大量漿細胞。
IHC：S100 與 OCT2 陽性，CD1a 與 langerin 陰性。多數病程自限，但廣泛結外或壓迫重要器官者需治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被當成一般 reactive sinus histiocytosis：後者組織球小、無 emperipolesis 且 S100 陰性；RDD 組織球大、核空泡狀有小核仁，並吞入完整淋巴球。

quiz.q: 圖中組織球胞質內含完整淋巴球的現象稱為什麼？最可能的診斷為何？
quiz.a: Emperipolesis；Rosai-Dorfman disease

3452.recognize_zh: 數顆紅血球（含一顆偏大、偏藍的多染性細胞）充滿均勻散佈的深紫色粗顆粒，符合嗜鹼性點彩；許多紅血球邊緣帶亮框的粉紫色小斑塊則是乾燥折光假影，不要誤認為包涵體。
features: Several red cells with coarse, evenly distributed blue-purple granules, including a larger polychromatophilic stippled cell
One small dense cell at left-center is heavily stippled with a bluish tint
A pale bluish round cell at top with faint stippling (polychromatophilic red cell)
Numerous refractile, dark-rimmed magenta crescents and dots at red cell edges consistent with drying artifact
Background red cells are normocytic with occasional target-like cells; a large pale macrocyte with a single central dot
3452.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic red cells with scattered polychromatophilic cells. Several red cells, including polychromatophilic forms, contain coarse, evenly dispersed basophilic granules consistent with coarse basophilic stippling. Many red cells show sharply outlined, refractile magenta crescents at their margins, which represent slide drying artifact rather than true inclusions. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are few clustered peripheral granules that are Prussian blue positive, unlike the numerous diffuse granules seen here.
Artifacts are sharply outlined, refractile and change with focus, whereas true stippling is non-refractile granules within the cell.
Howell-Jolly bodies are usually single, larger, round dense purple nuclear remnants rather than many small granules.
Intraerythrocytic parasites have defined ring or tetrad shapes with cytoplasm and chromatin, not uniform punctate dots.

exam.answer_en: Coarse basophilic stippling — diffuse coarse basophilic granules in RBCs; refractile magenta rims are drying artifact
pearls_zh: 考法：此圖混入大量折光乾燥假影，考官會問「哪顆是真正的點彩、哪些是假影」，要能以調焦時折光是否改變來分辨。
真點彩常出現在多染性（偏藍）紅血球，反映不成熟紅血球的 ribosome 異常聚集；應與 reticulocyte count 一併解讀。
鑑別疾病：lead poisoning、thalassemia、pyrimidine 5'-nucleotidase deficiency、MDS、酒精。
建議檢查：血鉛、Hb 分析（HPLC）、鐵學檢查；並檢討抹片製作（乾燥速度、濕度）以減少假影。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常把紅血球邊緣帶亮框的折光乾燥假影當成包涵體：假影邊界銳利、會折光並隨調焦變化；真 stippling 是位於細胞內、不折光的藍紫色顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球邊緣帶亮框的粉紫色斑塊是什麼？
quiz.a: 乾燥折光假影（drying artifact），不是包涵體

3324.recognize_zh: 抹片中一群中型淋巴細胞，核圓或橢圓、染色質中度濃縮，部分可見單一明顯核仁，細胞質淡藍、邊緣毛糙不規則，符合毛細胞白血病變異型（核仁明顯是與典型 HCL 區別的線索）。
features: Cluster of intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round to oval nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin with a distinct central nucleolus in some cells
Moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with ragged, irregular borders suggesting fine projections
Occasional binucleate-appearing or indented nuclei within the cluster
Paucicellular background with scattered red cells, one small dark cell, and clear lipid-like spaces
3324.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of intermediate-sized atypical lymphoid cells in a paucicellular background containing clear lipid-like spaces, suggestive of an aspirate preparation. The cells have round to oval nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin, a conspicuous nucleolus in several cells, and moderate pale blue-gray cytoplasm with ragged borders. Normal hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by hairy cell leukemia variant; immunophenotyping (CD25 and annexin A1 negative) and BRAF V600E testing are needed to exclude classic HCL.

ddx.vs: Classic hairy cells lack prominent nucleoli, often yield a dry tap, and are CD25/annexin A1/BRAF V600E positive.
Prolymphocytes have prominent nucleoli but scant cytoplasm without hairy projections and lack CD103/CD11c co-expression.
SMZL cells have more condensed chromatin, no prominent nucleoli and polar villi, and are CD103 negative.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, blastoid or pleomorphic
ddx.vs: MCL is CD5 and cyclin D1 positive with t(11;14), while cytoplasmic projections are not a feature.

3388.recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片高倍率可見兩顆巨大的巨核細胞相鄰，細胞核多葉且重疊、細胞質豐富帶細小粉紅顆粒，其中一顆細胞質內含一顆小細胞（emperipolesis）；在同一視野出現多顆成熟巨核細胞，支持巨核細胞增生，但真正增生仍需低倍率計數評估。
features: Two very large mature megakaryocytes side by side
Multilobated, overlapping nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin
Abundant pale blue-grey cytoplasm with fine pink-purple granules
A small cell engulfed within megakaryocyte cytoplasm (emperipolesis)
Adjacent clump of small dark cells and surrounding fat vacuoles
3388.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows two large, mature megakaryocytes lying adjacent to each other, with multilobated overlapping nuclei and abundant finely granular cytoplasm. A small hematopoietic cell is present within the cytoplasm of one megakaryocyte, consistent with emperipolesis. The megakaryocytes lack obvious hypolobation, micro-forms or bizarre hyperchromatic nuclei in this field. Although two megakaryocytes in a single high-power field suggest increased numbers, megakaryocytic hyperplasia should be assessed by low-power evaluation of particles or the core biopsy; findings are compatible with megakaryocytic hyperplasia.

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are often enlarged, hyperlobated (staghorn) or form tight clusters on biopsy, and require JAK2/CALR/MPL testing and clinical correlation.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic hyperplasia (ITP, blood loss, inflammation)
ddx.vs: Reactive megakaryocytes are normal-appearing and dispersed, without clustering or atypia, and there is a clinical cause for increased platelet turnover.
MDS megakaryocytes are small, hypolobated or have separated round nuclei, which are not seen here.
Osteoclasts have multiple separate uniform round nuclei rather than a single multilobated nucleus.

3132.recognize_zh: 中倍周邊血液抹片中標靶細胞佔多數，並散見數個深染的棒狀結晶與摺疊細胞，是血紅素C症的特徵組合。
features: Numerous target cells in a normocytic red cell population
Several dense, dark-staining elongated rod-shaped crystals
Folded cells and small dense red cells
Neutrophil with normal segmentation at lower right
Adequate platelets; no sickle cells seen
3132.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at intermediate power shows many target cells with scattered folded and small dense cells. Several dark-staining rod-shaped crystals are present within red cells. A normal-appearing neutrophil and adequate platelets are seen, and no sickle cells are identified. Findings are consistent with homozygous hemoglobin C disease.

ddx.vs: SC disease shows irregular, blunt-projection crystals and occasional sickle cells, with both HbS and HbC on electrophoresis.
HbC trait has only occasional target cells and crystals are rare or absent.
Beta-thalassemia shows microcytic hypochromic target cells with basophilic stippling and no crystals.

exam.answer_en: Homozygous hemoglobin C disease — predominance of target cells with scattered rod-shaped HbC crystals and folded cells, no sickle cells
pearls_zh: 考法：中倍視野要同時講出 target cells、HbC crystals 與 folded cells 三個組合，並說明未見 sickle cell。
Target cells 的鑑別：hemoglobinopathy（HbC、HbE、HbS）、thalassemia、肝病（膜脂質增加）、脾切除後。
HbC 為 beta-globin β6 Glu→Lys；鹼性電泳與 HbA2/HbE 同位置，需 HPLC 或酸性電泳確認。
CC disease 為輕度溶血加脾腫大；HbC trait 無貧血，結晶罕見。
與 HbS 併存（HbSC）會出現血管阻塞併發症，視網膜病變尤為常見，臨床意義遠大於 CC。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易只答 thalassemia（target cells）；thalassemia 為小球性低色素、有 basophilic stippling 且無結晶，找到棒狀結晶才指向 HbC。

quiz.q: 本圖以 target cells 為主，還需找到哪一種紅血球內構造才能指向 homozygous HbC disease？
quiz.a: 深染的棒狀／六角形 HbC crystals

3004.recognize_zh: 皮膚低倍切片：表皮呈不規則棘皮增生、表皮釘突延長，真皮乳頭層與淺層被帶狀（band-like）密集小淋巴球浸潤填滿，並緊貼真表皮交界，這種淺層帶狀浸潤是蕈狀肉芽腫（mycosis fungoides）斑塊期的低倍樣式。
features: Irregular acanthosis with elongated, club-shaped rete ridges and overlying parakeratotic scale
Dense band-like infiltrate of small lymphocytes filling the papillary and superficial dermis
Infiltrate abuts the dermal-epidermal junction without a grenz zone
Lymphocytes appear to extend into the lower epidermis, but epidermotropism is not resolvable at this power
Papillary dermal fibrosis not clearly assessable owing to image quality
3004.describe_en: Low-power view of a skin biopsy shows irregular psoriasiform acanthosis with elongated rete ridges and overlying compact scale. A dense, band-like lymphoid infiltrate fills the papillary and superficial reticular dermis and abuts the dermal-epidermal junction without an intervening grenz zone. Individual cytology and the degree of epidermotropism cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The pattern is compatible with plaque-stage mycosis fungoides; high-power assessment for epidermotropic atypical lymphocytes and Pautrier microabscesses, immunophenotyping, and TCR clonality are needed.

ddx.dx: Lichenoid dermatitis (lichen planus, lichenoid drug reaction)
ddx.vs: Lichenoid dermatitis shows basal vacuolar damage, Civatte bodies, and wedge-shaped hypergranulosis with non-atypical lymphocytes, rather than atypical lymphocytes lining the basal layer.
These have a sparse perivascular infiltrate with spongiosis or neutrophils in scale, not a dense lymphoid band with epidermotropism disproportionate to spongiosis.
B-cell infiltrates are usually nodular and deeper with a grenz zone, whereas MF is band-like and epidermotropic.

exam.answer_en: Mycosis fungoides, plaque stage pattern — psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with dense band-like superficial dermal lymphoid infiltrate abutting the epidermis
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍題只要求辨認「superficial band-like lymphoid infiltrate + 表皮增生」，並說出下一步要在高倍找 epidermotropism 與 Pautrier microabscess。
IHC：腫瘤細胞通常 CD3+、CD4+、CD8−，常失去 CD7，也可有 CD2 或 CD5 缺失；TCR gene rearrangement 證明單株性。
分期採 TNMB（patch、plaque、tumor、erythroderma 加血液侵犯）；早期 patch/plaque 預後良好。
Large cell transformation 與 folliculotropic MF 預後較差；CD30 表現可作為 brentuximab vedotin 的治療標的。
早期以皮膚導向治療為主：topical corticosteroids、phototherapy（nbUVB、PUVA）、topical mechlorethamine、局部放療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 lichenoid dermatitis 或 psoriasis；lichenoid dermatitis 有基底層空泡變性與 Civatte bodies，MF 則為非典型淋巴球沿基底層排列且少角質細胞傷害。

quiz.q: 此低倍皮膚切片的淋巴球浸潤分布模式為何？MF 腫瘤細胞最常見的 T 細胞表型與抗原缺失是什麼？
quiz.a: Superficial band-like（帶狀）浸潤；CD4+ T cell，常 CD7 缺失

2428.recognize_zh: 抹片以藍紫色無結構壞死物與空泡為主，只零星散布幾個小而深染、固縮的核殘影（pyknotic nuclei），看不到正常成熟的造血細胞，符合骨髓壞死。
features: Amorphous, smudged basophilic granular material with numerous clear vacuoles
Scattered small, dense, dark pyknotic nuclear remnants without discernible cytoplasm
Absence of recognizable intact myeloid, erythroid or megakaryocytic elements
Fine purple granular/fibrillar debris in the background
Faint pale tan-gray ghost red cell outlines within the debris
2428.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Wright-Giemsa) shows aggregates of amorphous, smudged basophilic material with multiple clear vacuoles and fine granular debris. Only scattered small, hyperchromatic pyknotic nuclear remnants are seen; intact hematopoietic cells with preserved cytoplasm and chromatin detail are not identified. Pale ghost red cell outlines are present in the background. Findings are consistent with bone marrow necrosis; the trephine biopsy and any viable areas should be examined for an underlying neoplasm or other cause.

ddx.vs: Technical artifacts still preserve intact cells with cytoplasm in thinner areas, whereas necrosis shows only pyknotic remnants in structureless debris.
Serous atrophy shows homogeneous pink-lilac extracellular material with intact (though sparse) cells, not granular debris with pyknotic nuclei.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia with extensive cell smudging
ddx.vs: Smudged blasts in leukemia leave identifiable nuclear chromatin strands and some intact blasts, whereas necrotic smears lack viable cells.

2300.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一群單一的中大型細胞，核為圓形、染色質細緻，周圍有中等量灰藍色、帶細小顆粒的細胞質，符合以圓核單核母細胞為主的急性單核球性白血病。
features: Monotonous medium to large cells with round nuclei
Fine, finely granular chromatin with inconspicuous small nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules
Occasional cell with slightly indented nucleus
Few admixed mature elements; background of red cells
2300.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a monotonous population of medium to large cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli, surrounded by a moderate rim of gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules. Occasional nuclei are slightly indented. No Auer rods are seen. Findings are consistent with acute monoblastic leukemia; round-nucleated monoblasts should be confirmed with NSE cytochemistry and immunophenotyping.

ddx.vs: Myeloblasts have a higher N:C ratio with MPO-positive granules and Auer rods, accompanied by maturing neutrophils.
AMML contains at least 20% neutrophil lineage cells with MPO positivity, unlike this monotonous monocytic population.
Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm and are MPO/NSE negative with TdT expression.

2108.recognize_zh: 中央嗜中性球核分葉少、染色質粗糙，胞質含細紫色顆粒而略呈灰藍；本張圖中 Döhle body 不明顯，無法清楚辨認出分立的藍色斑塊，需結合同張抹片其他細胞判讀（題目類別為懷孕相關變化）。
features: Neutrophil with hyposegmented, folded nucleus and coarse clumped chromatin
Fine purple cytoplasmic granulation with faint grayish-blue cytoplasmic tone
No discrete, well-defined Döhle body clearly identifiable at this resolution
Background red cells with refractile drying artifact and a crenated/ghost red cell at lower center
Occasional platelets
2108.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a hyposegmented neutrophil with coarse chromatin and fine purple cytoplasmic granules on a faintly grayish-blue cytoplasm. A discrete Döhle body is not clearly identifiable in this image, although subtle cytoplasmic basophilia may be present. Red cells show refractile drying artifact. Findings are only partially consistent with the labeled Döhle body; mild reactive neutrophil changes of this type are common in normal pregnancy.

ddx.vs: Without a definite blue cytoplasmic patch or toxic granulation, this cell may simply represent a normal band form.
Dysplastic hyposegmented neutrophils are usually hypogranular and occur with other cytopenias or dysplasia.
MYH9 inclusions are distinct blue bodies in most neutrophils with macrothrombocytopenia, which are not seen here.

1980.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中可見多顆細長兩端尖的鐮狀紅血球（細箭頭），粗箭頭指出一顆帶有深染固縮核的有核紅血球；背景幾乎看不到多染性（polychromasia）紅血球，提示網狀紅血球生成低下的 aplastic crisis。
features: Scattered elongated sickle cells with pointed ends (thin arrows)
Nucleated red blood cell with a small dense pyknotic nucleus (thick arrow)
Occasional target cells and irregularly contracted red cells
Paucity of polychromatophilic (bluish) red cells despite hemolytic disease
Two small lymphocytes at upper left; scattered platelets
1980.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with scattered elongated sickle cells (thin arrows), occasional target cells, and a nucleated red blood cell with a pyknotic nucleus (thick arrow). Polychromatophilic red cells are notably scarce, which is unexpected for chronic hemolysis and suggests suppressed reticulocyte production. Two small lymphocytes and adequate platelets are present. Findings are consistent with sickle cell disease; the lack of polychromasia supports aplastic crisis, which should be confirmed with a reticulocyte count and parvovirus B19 testing.

ddx.vs: SC disease shows abundant target cells and blunt-ended crystal-containing cells with fewer classic elongated sickle forms.
Sickle beta-thalassemia shows marked microcytosis and hypochromia with target cells, requiring hemoglobin quantitation to separate.

ddx.dx: Sickle cell disease in steady state or hemolytic crisis
ddx.vs: Steady-state or hyperhemolytic SCD shows prominent polychromasia and reticulocytosis, whereas aplastic crisis shows reticulocytopenia.
Elliptocytes are symmetric oval to rod shapes with blunt rounded ends, not crescent forms with pointed ends.

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell disease with aplastic crisis — sickle cells and a nucleated RBC with conspicuous lack of polychromasia (reticulocytopenia)
pearls_zh: 考法：指著細長兩端尖的紅血球問名稱，再問「這張圖缺了什麼？」答：sickle cells；缺少 polychromasia，暗示網狀紅血球生成停止。
病因：aplastic crisis 最常由 parvovirus B19 感染 erythroid progenitors（P antigen 受體）造成；應查 reticulocyte count 與 B19 IgM 或 PCR。
臨床：慢性溶血病人紅血球壽命短，網狀紅血球停產數日即造成 Hb 急降，常需輸血；通常 1–2 週自行恢復，需注意傳染給其他溶血病人與孕婦。
鑑別 Hb 急降：aplastic crisis（retic 低）vs splenic sequestration（脾急性腫大、retic 高）vs hyperhemolysis（retic 高、LDH 高）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易只答「sickle cell disease」而漏掉 aplastic crisis：題目關鍵是背景缺乏 polychromatophilic cells；有核紅血球存在不代表骨髓造紅功能正常。

quiz.q: 此病人 Hb 急降且抹片缺乏多染性紅血球，最可能的感染病原為何？
quiz.a: Parvovirus B19

1916.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中出現多顆細胞質內充滿粗大、深紫黑色嗜鹼性顆粒（basophilic granules）且顆粒覆蓋細胞核的細胞，數量明顯偏多；但圖中細胞多呈較成熟的嗜鹼性球外觀，是否為胚細胞需配合計數與流式細胞儀判定。
features: Increased cells packed with coarse, dark purple-black basophilic granules
Granules overlie and partly obscure the nucleus
Nuclei round to lobulated; chromatin detail obscured by granules
Cell size roughly that of neutrophils to slightly larger
Background red cells largely unremarkable with occasional teardrop-shaped cell
1916.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows several granulated cells with abundant coarse, dark basophilic granules that overlie the nucleus. Nuclei range from round to lobulated, and nuclear detail is largely obscured by the granules. Most cells at this field resemble basophils rather than unequivocal blasts, so blast enumeration and immunophenotyping (CD123, CD203c, CD13/CD33 with CD117 negativity) are needed. In the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context, findings are suggestive of acute basophilic leukemia, after exclusion of BCR-ABL1-positive CML.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia with basophilia / blast phase
ddx.vs: CML shows a full left-shifted granulocytic spectrum with basophilia and requires BCR-ABL1 testing, whereas acute basophilic leukemia is BCR-ABL1 negative with ≥20% blasts.
Mast cells have oval nuclei with spindled or elongated shapes and are tryptase-strong and CD117-bright, whereas basophilic blasts are CD117 negative and CD203c/CD123 positive.
APL promyelocytes have azurophilic red-purple granules, Auer rod bundles and bilobed nuclei with strong MPO, whereas basophilic granules are dark purple-black, metachromatic and MPO negative.

1852.recognize_zh: 骨髓中胚細胞與單核樣細胞（核折疊、細胞質灰藍）增生，箭頭所指的細胞含有粗大、深紫黑色的異常嗜伊紅性顆粒（abnormal eosinophil），這種單核球分化加上異常嗜伊紅球的組合是 inv(16) 急性骨髓性白血病的典型線索。
features: Increased blasts and monocytoid cells with moderate gray-blue cytoplasm
Folded, indented or reniform nuclei with fine chromatin (myelomonocytic differentiation)
Abnormal eosinophil precursor with large, dark purple-black (basophilic-staining) granules (arrow)
Some cells with cytoplasmic vacuoles
Few mature neutrophils; a small nucleated red cell present
1852.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts and monocytoid cells with folded or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm, some with vacuoles. An abnormal eosinophil precursor with coarse, dark purple-black granules is present (arrow). Mature granulocytes are reduced. Findings are consistent with acute myelomonocytic leukemia with abnormal eosinophils, suggestive of AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22) or t(16;16); CBFB-MYH11, which should be confirmed by cytogenetics/FISH or RT-PCR.

ddx.vs: AMML lacks the dysplastic eosinophils with large basophilic-staining granules and lacks CBFB-MYH11 on molecular testing.
CMML has <20% blasts plus promonocytes and persistent monocytosis, while inv(16) AML is diagnostic regardless of blast count.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangement
ddx.vs: These show increased but cytologically less dysplastic eosinophils without the coarse basophilic granules, and are identified by FISH/RT-PCR for the specific rearrangement.

exam.answer_en: AML with inv(16)(p13.1q22)/CBFB::MYH11 — myelomonocytic blasts with abnormal eosinophil containing large dark purple-black basophilic-staining granules (arrow)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指箭頭那顆滿是深紫黑色粗顆粒的細胞，問「這是什麼細胞？聯想哪個染色體異常？」答 abnormal eosinophil → inv(16)/t(16;16), CBFB::MYH11。
inv(16) 在傳統核型上變化細微、容易漏看，應以 FISH 或 RT-PCR 偵測 CBFB::MYH11 確認；RT-PCR 也可用於追蹤 MRD。
屬 core-binding factor AML，預後佳（ELN favorable）；常合併 KIT 突變，治療上 intensive chemotherapy 含 high-dose cytarabine，可加 gemtuzumab ozogamicin。
WHO 5th 中 CBFB::MYH11 AML 不需 20% 母細胞門檻即可診斷；ICC 2022 則要求 ≥10% 母細胞。
細胞化學：異常嗜伊紅球 chloroacetate esterase（CAE）陽性，正常嗜伊紅球為陰性；母細胞常有 MPO 與 NSE 雙陽性（骨髓單核球分化）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把異常嗜伊紅球誤認為嗜鹼性球或肥大細胞；嗜鹼性顆粒水溶、蓋在核上且呈 metachromatic，異常嗜伊紅球則深紫與橘紅顆粒混雜、CAE 陽性。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指含粗大深紫黑色顆粒的細胞是什麼？應以哪個檢查確認其背後的融合基因？
quiz.a: 異常嗜伊紅球（abnormal eosinophil）；以 FISH 或 RT-PCR 檢測 CBFB::MYH11（inv(16)/t(16;16)）。

1788.recognize_zh: 左下方的白血球（核呈雙葉、細胞質略帶顆粒）內，箭頭所指為一個被透亮暈圈包圍、內含深染小體的圓形酵母菌，旁邊還有空泡；右上角另一顆白血球內也可見類似的圓形包涵體，符合被吞噬的有莢膜真菌（本例為隱球菌）。
features: Leukocyte (neutrophil or monocyte) with bilobed nucleus and finely granular cytoplasm
Arrowed round intracytoplasmic yeast with a defined wall, central dark-staining body and surrounding clear halo
Adjacent clear cytoplasmic vacuole
Similar round inclusion with a halo in a second leukocyte at the upper right
Thick smear area with crenated, blurred red cells; platelets scattered
1788.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with crenated red cells, shows leukocytes containing intracytoplasmic fungal organisms. A phagocyte with a bilobed nucleus contains a round yeast with a defined wall, central dark-staining material and a surrounding clear halo (arrow), with an adjacent vacuole; a similar organism is present in another leukocyte at the upper right. The halo suggests a capsule, although budding pattern cannot be assessed. Findings are consistent with intracellular encapsulated yeasts, compatible with disseminated cryptococcal infection; confirmation by blood culture and cryptococcal antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Yeasts are smaller and more uniform, typically multiple per cell with a crescent nucleus, and lack a mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Display budding yeasts with pseudohyphae and no capsular halo.
Show a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast, usually within macrophages, and lack a clear capsule.
Are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus rather than round encapsulated yeasts.

1724.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中可見多個一端拉長成單一尾巴的淚滴狀紅血球（dacryocyte），並伴隨橢圓形紅血球與輕度大小不一，是原發性骨髓纖維化等骨髓浸潤疾病常見的抹片表現。
features: Several teardrop-shaped red cells (dacryocytes) with a single tapered tail
Accompanying elliptocytes and oval cells with moderate poikilocytosis
Mild anisocytosis with most cells normochromic and preserved central pallor
Occasional irregular fragment-like or folded red cells
Scattered small platelets; no nucleated red cells or leukocytes in this field
1724.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows moderate poikilocytosis with numerous teardrop cells (dacryocytes), elliptocytes, and occasional irregular red cell forms, with mild anisocytosis and normochromic cells. Platelets are present, and no nucleated red cells or immature myeloid cells are seen in this field. The teardrops are well spread in a thin area, so drying artifact is less likely because their tails point in different directions. Findings are consistent with dacryocytosis, as seen in primary myelofibrosis and other causes of marrow infiltration; review for leukoerythroblastosis and a bone marrow biopsy are recommended.

ddx.vs: Artifactual teardrops have tails all pointing in the same direction, whereas true dacryocytes are oriented randomly as here.

ddx.dx: Myelophthisis from metastatic tumor or granulomatous disease
ddx.vs: Myelophthisis produces identical teardrops with leukoerythroblastosis, and separation requires marrow biopsy rather than smear morphology.
Thalassemia shows microcytic hypochromic cells and target cells, and megaloblastic anemia shows oval macrocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils, alongside teardrops.

exam.answer_en: Dacryocytosis — numerous randomly oriented teardrop cells with elliptocytes; suggests myelofibrosis/marrow infiltration
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指單尾拉長的紅血球問「叫什麼？聯想哪些疾病？」答 dacryocyte（teardrop cell）；primary myelofibrosis、myelophthisis（轉移癌、肉芽腫）、thalassemia、megaloblastic anemia。
PMF 驅動突變：JAK2 V617F、CALR、MPL 三者互斥；triple-negative 預後較差；並應查 ASXL1 等高風險突變。
周邊血另找 leukoerythroblastosis（有核紅血球 + 未成熟顆粒球），骨髓常 dry tap，需切片以 reticulin/trichrome 評 MF-0 至 MF-3 纖維化。
機轉：紅血球擠過纖維化骨髓或脾臟髓外造血時被拉長變形。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為推片假象；假象造成的淚滴細胞尾巴都朝同一方向，真正 dacryocyte 方向隨機，且應在紅血球剛好不重疊的薄片區判讀。

quiz.q: 如何判斷圖中淚滴狀紅血球不是推片假象？發現後周邊血還要找什麼變化？
quiz.a: 尾巴方向隨機不一致；另找 leukoerythroblastosis（有核紅血球與未成熟顆粒球）。

1660.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓抹片中母細胞緊密排列、互相擠壓，核佔滿細胞、染色質細緻並帶有許多小淡染點（疑似重疊的小空泡），細胞質極少；夾雜較小深染的細胞，背景有白色脂肪滴。
features: Densely packed, molded blasts with very high N:C ratio
Round to polygonal nuclei with fine chromatin and numerous small punched-out pale spots
Scant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles
Admixed smaller cells with dense, dark nuclei (residual lymphocytes or erythroid precursors)
Background fat droplets and occasional red cells
1660.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a densely packed population of blasts with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, nuclear molding, fine chromatin with multiple small punched-out pale spots, and scant pale grey-blue cytoplasm with occasional small vacuoles. Scattered smaller cells with dense dark nuclei and background fat droplets are present. Granules and Auer rods are not seen. Findings are consistent with acute lymphoblastic leukemia; the vacuolated appearance warrants exclusion of Burkitt leukemia by immunophenotyping (TdT, surface immunoglobulin) and MYC studies.

ddx.vs: Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent sharply defined lipid vacuoles and a TdT-negative, sIg-positive phenotype with MYC rearrangement.
Myeloblasts often show a few azurophilic granules or Auer rods and MPO positivity, which are absent here.
Blastoid MCL cells are cyclin D1-positive and TdT-negative mature B cells despite similar blastic chromatin.

1532.recognize_zh: 大型芽細胞具豐富、偏灰藍色的胞質，部分胞質含細小嗜天青顆粒並可見核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），核染色質細緻、部分核有凹陷，旁邊有成熟的小淋巴球作為大小對照，符合 t(8;21) AML 的芽細胞形態。
features: Large blasts, roughly 3 times the size of an adjacent small lymphocyte
Moderate to abundant basophilic to grayish-blue cytoplasm, some with fine azurophilic granules
Round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and faint nucleoli
Suggestion of a paranuclear clear zone (hof) in some cells
No definite Auer rods visible at this resolution
1532.describe_en: Smear at high power shows a cluster of large myeloblasts with moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm, several containing fine azurophilic granules, and round to indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and faint nucleoli. Some blasts show a paranuclear pale zone. A small mature lymphocyte is present for size comparison. Auer rods are not definitely identified in this field. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia and are suggestive of AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1); RUNX1::RUNX1T1, which should be confirmed by cytogenetics or molecular testing.

ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei with heavy granules or bundles of Auer rods (faggot cells) and PML::RARA, rather than basophilic cytoplasm with hofs.
AML with inv(16) shows a myelomonocytic picture with abnormal eosinophils containing large basophilic granules.
Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm and are MPO-negative, whereas these blasts have abundant granular cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: AML with t(8;21)(q22;q22.1) RUNX1::RUNX1T1 — large blasts with abundant grayish-blue cytoplasm, fine azurophilic granules, perinuclear hof
pearls_zh: 考法：指大型芽細胞問診斷；線索是胞質豐富、帶顆粒與 perinuclear hof，可有單根細長 Auer rod 或 pseudo-Chédiak-Higashi granules。
Flow：CD34+、HLA-DR+、MPO+，常異常表現 B 標記 CD19 與 PAX5，並可有 CD56；此組合強烈提示 RUNX1::RUNX1T1。
分類門檻：WHO 5th 對 RUNX1::RUNX1T1 AML 不設芽細胞比例下限；ICC 2022 要求 blasts ≥10%。
預後：ELN 2022 列為 favorable risk；KIT mutation 可能影響復發風險，治療後以 RT-qPCR 追蹤 MRD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 APL；APL 核雙葉、顆粒密集、常 CD34−/HLA-DR−，並伴 DIC；t(8;21) 芽細胞 CD34+ 且具 hof。

quiz.q: 這些芽細胞最可能帶有哪個融合基因？flow 常出現哪個異常 B 細胞標記？
quiz.a: RUNX1::RUNX1T1；CD19（或 PAX5）

1468.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中小型成熟淋巴球明顯增加，染色質緻密；箭頭所指為數顆稍大、染色質較疏鬆、細胞質淡藍的淋巴樣細胞（疑為前淋巴球／副免疫母細胞），混在 CLL 的小淋巴球背景中。
features: Increased small mature lymphocytes with dense, clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm
Arrows mark slightly larger lymphoid cells with more open chromatin and a rim of pale blue cytoplasm, suggestive of prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts
Admixed residual hematopoietic cells including granulocytic and erythroid precursors
Marrow particle/fat spaces with refractile bubbles and thick smear artifact
Nucleoli are not clearly resolved due to smear thickness and image quality
1468.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a thick, cellular preparation with fat spaces and refractile artifact. Small mature lymphocytes with dense clumped chromatin and scant cytoplasm are increased. Scattered slightly larger lymphoid cells with more open chromatin and pale blue cytoplasm (arrows) are present, suggestive of prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts, though nucleoli cannot be reliably assessed because of smear thickness. Residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors are seen. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by chronic lymphocytic leukemia, and the proportion of prolymphocytes should be counted on a well-spread peripheral smear.

ddx.vs: MCL cells often have irregular or cleaved nuclei and are CD23 dim/negative with cyclin D1/SOX11 positivity, unlike CD23-positive CLL.
B-PLL requires >55% prolymphocytes with prominent central nucleoli in blood, whereas CLL has predominantly small cells with only a minority of prolymphocytes.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with marrow involvement
ddx.vs: MZL cells show moderate pale cytoplasm, sometimes villous or plasmacytoid, and are CD5 and CD23 negative.
Reactive lymphocytes are polyclonal and hematogones show a maturation spectrum with TdT/CD10 expression, lacking light-chain restriction.

60924.recognize_zh: 高核質比的大圓形母細胞，染色質細緻開放，細胞質為一圈藍色邊緣；右上方細胞質中可見細長的粉紅色棒狀包涵體（Auer rod），這是骨髓母細胞（myeloblast）的關鍵證據。
features: Large round cell, roughly twice the red cell diameter, with a high N:C ratio
Round nucleus with finely granular, open (blastic) chromatin; nucleoli not sharply defined at this resolution
Thin rim of basophilic, blue cytoplasm without conspicuous granules
Slender, linear pink-red rod-shaped inclusion(s) in the upper right cytoplasm, consistent with Auer rod(s)
Background normochromic red cells
60924.describe_en: High-power smear shows a large blast with a round nucleus, finely dispersed chromatin and a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio. The scant basophilic cytoplasm lacks conspicuous granules but contains slender, needle-like pink-red inclusions in the upper right portion, consistent with Auer rods. Nucleoli are not well resolved in this image. Findings are consistent with a myeloblast containing Auer rods, which establishes myeloid lineage and supports a diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia (or a myeloid neoplasm with increased blasts) in the appropriate context.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts never contain Auer rods and are MPO negative, often with scantier cytoplasm and less distinct nucleoli.
APL cells have bilobed or folded nuclei with abundant coarse azurophilic granules and often bundles of multiple Auer rods (faggot cells).
Artifacts sit in a different focal plane or outside the cell and are not needle-shaped azurophilic rods within the cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Myeloblast with Auer rod — high N:C blast with fine chromatin and a slender pink-red cytoplasmic rod, proving myeloid lineage
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著細胞質內的細長粉紅棒狀物，問「這是什麼構造？代表什麼 lineage？」答 Auer rod，表示 myeloid lineage，可排除 ALL。
Auer rod 由融合的 primary（azurophilic）granules 構成，MPO 染色陽性；Sudan black B 亦陽性。
單一 Auer rod 見於各種 AML 及 MDS/增加 blasts 的骨髓性腫瘤；成束多條（faggot cell）則強烈提示 APL，需立即排除 PML::RARA。
ICC 2022 將 Auer rods 作為 MDS/AML 相關分類的考量之一；WHO 5th 已不再以 Auer rod 單獨決定 MDS 分型，考試時要能說明兩系統差異。
AML 確立後必做的檢查：karyotype、FISH，以及分子（NPM1、FLT3-ITD/TKD、CEBPA、IDH1/2 等）以決定分類與治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為 lymphoblast：lymphoblast 永遠不會有 Auer rod 且 MPO 陰性；也要與重疊在細胞上的血小板或染劑沉積區分，Auer rod 為位於細胞質內的細針狀結構。

quiz.q: 這顆母細胞細胞質中的粉紅色細棒狀物叫什麼？用哪個細胞化學染色會呈陽性？
quiz.a: Auer rod；MPO（或 Sudan black B）陽性

124.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中可見兩端尖細的鐮刀狀紅血球與船形紅血球（boat cells），偏亞硫酸氫鈉鐮變試驗中大量紅血球變成鐮刀或冬青葉形；HPLC 顯示 S-window 71.8%、HbF 16.1%，父親 HbS 32.9% 為帶因者。
features: Elongated sickle cells with pointed ends and boat-shaped (oat) cells
Anisopoikilocytosis with crenated cells, occasional target-like and folded cells
Sodium metabisulfite wet preparation: numerous sickled and holly-leaf red cells (positive sickling test)
Patient HPLC: S-window 71.8% at 4.36 min, HbF 16.1%, HbA0 8.5% (residual transfused cells), HbA2 1.9%
Alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis: dominant band in the S/D/G region (arrow)
Father HPLC: HbA0 57.1% with S-window 32.9%, pattern of sickle cell trait
124.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows anisopoikilocytosis with numerous elongated sickle cells, boat-shaped cells, crenated cells and occasional folded forms. A sodium metabisulfite wet preparation shows extensive sickling with classic sickle and holly-leaf forms, a positive sickling test. Hemoglobin HPLC shows a dominant peak in the S window (71.8%, retention time 4.36 min) with HbF 16.1%, HbA2 1.9% and a small HbA0 fraction (8.5%) attributable to transfusion three months earlier; alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis shows a prominent band in the S/D/G region. Paternal HPLC shows HbA 57.1% with an S-window peak of 32.9%, consistent with sickle cell trait. Findings are consistent with homozygous sickle cell disease (HbSS) with a transfusion effect; confirmation of the S variant by solubility testing or acid electrophoresis separates it from HbD/HbG, which co-migrate at alkaline pH.

ddx.vs: Shows microcytosis with elevated HbA2 (typically >3.5%) and absent (beta0) or reduced (beta+) HbA, whereas here MCV is normal, HbA2 is 1.9% and one parent has plain sickle trait.
Has target cells and HbC crystals with a second variant peak in the C window on HPLC, not seen here.
Co-migrates with HbS on alkaline electrophoresis but elutes in a different HPLC window, gives a negative sickling test, and does not form sickle cells.
HbA exceeds HbS (about 55-60% vs 35-40%) with no sickle cells on the smear, as in the father, whereas the patient has HbS >70% with sickled cells.

captions: Peripheral blood: sickle cells and boat-shaped cells with anisopoikilocytosis
Sodium metabisulfite sickling test: numerous sickled and holly-leaf red cells
Patient HPLC: S-window 71.8%, HbF 16.1%, HbA0 8.5%, HbA2 1.9%
Alkaline cellulose acetate electrophoresis: prominent band in S/D/G region (arrow)
Father HPLC: HbA 57.1% and S-window 32.9%, sickle cell trait

exam.answer_en: Sickle cell anemia — sickle and boat cells on smear, positive metabisulfite test, predominant HbS on HPLC with raised HbF; father HbAS
pearls_zh: 考法：血片指兩端尖細的鐮刀細胞與船形細胞，再給 HPLC 問 S-window 71.8% 與 HbF 16.1% 的解讀（少量 HbA0 來自輸血）。
HbS 為 β6 Glu→Val；metabisulfite 或 solubility test 只能證明 HbS 存在，無法區分 trait 與疾病，需 HPLC/電泳定量。
印度（Arab-Indian haplotype）病人 HbF 常較高、臨床相對較輕；hydroxyurea 可提升 HbF、減少疼痛危象。
急症：急性胸部症候群、腦中風（兒童以 TCD 篩檢）、脾臟急性滯留與再生不良危象（parvovirus B19）；功能性無脾需疫苗與預防性 penicillin。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 HbS/β0-thalassemia 或 HbSD 混淆；前者小球性、HbA2 上升且父母一方為 β-thal trait，後者 HPLC 有 D-window 峰。

quiz.q: 鐮變試驗陽性能否區分 sickle cell trait 與 sickle cell anemia？該如何確認？
quiz.a: 不能；以 HPLC 或電泳定量 HbS、HbA 比例並做家族研究

60.recognize_zh: 血小板在抹片中呈淡灰藍色、缺乏紫紅色 α 顆粒，部分體積偏大，紅血球形態正常；血小板凝集／分泌圖顯示所有促效劑的 ATP 釋放（Lum）幾乎為 0，U46619 凝集下降，符合灰色血小板症候群。
features: Platelets are pale gray-blue and agranular/hypogranular, lacking the normal purple azurophilic (alpha) granulation
Some platelets are enlarged relative to normal platelets
Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without significant poikilocytosis
Lumi-aggregometry: normal aggregation to ristocetin (94%) and convulxin (88%)
Reduced aggregation to the thromboxane analog U46619 (30% at 2.5 uM, 15% at 1.0 uM) with reversible curves
Absent or near-absent ATP secretion (Lum amplitude 0%) with all agonists
60.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells and platelets that are pale gray-blue, agranular to hypogranular, with some enlarged forms; no platelet clumping is evident in this field. Whole-blood lumi-aggregometry demonstrates normal aggregation with ristocetin (94%) and convulxin (88%), but reduced and reversible aggregation with U46619 (30% and 15%), and absent ATP secretion with all agonists tested. Findings are consistent with gray platelet syndrome (alpha-granule deficiency) with an associated secretion defect; exclusion of EDTA-induced in vitro degranulation (pseudo-gray platelets) and confirmation by electron microscopy or NBEAL2 testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: Pseudo-gray platelets are an EDTA artifact that disappears on citrate-anticoagulated or fingerstick smears, with normal aggregation studies.
MDS shows accompanying dysplasia such as hypogranular neutrophils, pseudo-Pelger cells or macrocytosis, and cytopenias.
Bernard-Soulier platelets are giant but granulated and show absent ristocetin aggregation, whereas ristocetin response is normal here.
Delta-storage pool disease has normally granulated platelets on light microscopy with reduced dense granules on whole-mount EM.

captions: PB: pale gray agranular platelets among normal red cells
Lumi-aggregometry: normal ristocetin/convulxin aggregation, reduced U46619 response, absent ATP release

exam.answer_en: Gray platelet syndrome — pale gray-blue agranular, partly large platelets (alpha-granule deficiency) with absent ATP secretion on lumi-aggregometry
pearls_zh: 考法：考官會指抹片中淡灰藍、缺紫紅顆粒的大血小板問診斷，並問缺的是哪種顆粒——α granule。
遺傳：多為 NBEAL2 雙對偶突變（體染色體隱性）；表現大血小板性血小板減少、脾腫大、進行性骨髓纖維化，血清 B12 常升高。
確診靠電子顯微鏡顯示 α 顆粒缺乏，或 NBEAL2 基因檢測；α 顆粒內含 fibrinogen、VWF、PF4、PDGF。
凝集/分泌圖判讀：ristocetin 正常代表 GPIb-VWF 軸正常（排除 Bernard-Soulier），ATP 分泌缺乏提示合併分泌缺陷。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常見的假象是 EDTA 或延遲處理造成的血小板脫顆粒（pseudo-gray platelets）：以 citrate 或新鮮指尖血抹片複查；MDS 也可見低顆粒血小板。

quiz.q: 灰色血小板症候群缺乏的是哪一種血小板顆粒？最常見的致病基因？
quiz.a: α granule；NBEAL2

3964.recognize_zh: 白血球鹼性磷酸酶（LAP）染色中，三顆分葉核嗜中性球的細胞質有中等至密集的藍色沉澱顆粒，核以紅色對比染色，紅血球為淡黃背景；依沉澱密度分級計分（0 至 4+）。
features: Three segmented neutrophils with red-counterstained lobulated nuclei
Cytoplasm filled with moderate to dense blue granular precipitate indicating alkaline phosphatase activity
Precipitate distributed throughout the cytoplasm with variable density between cells (roughly 2+ to 3+)
Unstained, pale yellow erythrocytes in the background
3964.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained for leukocyte alkaline phosphatase (LAP) shows three segmented neutrophils with moderate to dense blue granular cytoplasmic precipitate, corresponding to approximately 2+ to 3+ reactivity, with red nuclear counterstain. The LAP score is calculated by grading 100 consecutive neutrophils from 0 to 4+ and summing the grades. A high score reflects neutrophil activation, as seen in leukemoid reaction, infection, pregnancy, and polycythemia vera, whereas a low score is characteristic of CML and PNH. A complete 100-cell count is required for interpretation of a single field.

ddx.vs: CML neutrophils show absent or minimal (0 to 1+) precipitate, giving a markedly low score, unlike the strong staining shown here.
PNH neutrophils also show low LAP activity, which is confirmed by FLAER/CD55/CD59 flow cytometry.

ddx.dx: Myeloperoxidase or Sudan black B stain
ddx.vs: These stain primary granules of all granulocytes and are not graded for activation, whereas LAP is a graded activation marker of mature neutrophils.

exam.answer_en: Leukocyte alkaline phosphatase (LAP) stain — neutrophils with moderate-to-dense blue cytoplasmic precipitate (about 2+ to 3+)
pearls_zh: 判讀：連續計數 100 顆成熟中性球（band/segmented），每顆依沉澱密度 0–4+，加總為 LAP score（0–400），需同時做正常對照。
LAP 低：CML 慢性期、PNH；LAP 高：leukemoid reaction、感染、懷孕、polycythemia vera、類固醇使用。
經典考題是以 LAP 區分 CML 與 leukemoid reaction；現在確診已由 BCR::ABL1 檢測取代。
檢體需新鮮，酵素活性會隨放置時間下降，判讀時要考慮檢體條件。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 MPO 或 Sudan black B 等判定母細胞譜系的細胞化學染色混淆；LAP 只評估成熟中性球的酵素活性，是半定量計分。

quiz.q: CML 慢性期與 leukemoid reaction 的 LAP score 分別偏高或偏低？
quiz.a: CML 偏低；leukemoid reaction 偏高

3708.recognize_zh: 組織切片的免疫染色中，大量細胞呈強烈膜狀/細胞質陽性並成片分布，左下方則為陰性區；在移植後 AML 復發的脈絡下，應理解為腫瘤性骨髓系細胞浸潤。圖中未標示抗體，單憑此圖無法確定譜系。
features: Tissue section with dense sheets of cells showing strong membranous and cytoplasmic immunoreactivity
Positive cells are medium-sized, closely packed, with a diffuse infiltrative pattern
Sharp demarcation from a less cellular, largely negative area in the lower left
Scattered positive cells extend into the negative region
Antibody and tissue site not labeled; nuclear detail not assessable
3708.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain on a tissue section shows dense sheets of medium-sized cells with strong membranous and cytoplasmic staining in a diffuse infiltrative pattern, with a less cellular, largely negative area in the lower left containing scattered positive cells. The antibody and the anatomic site are not indicated in the image, so lineage cannot be assigned from this figure alone. In the context of recurrent acute myeloid leukemia after peripheral stem cell transplantation, the findings are suggestive of an infiltrate of recurrent leukemia (e.g., marrow relapse or myeloid sarcoma); correlation with a myeloid panel (CD34, CD117, MPO, CD33, CD43, lysozyme) and chimerism studies is required.

ddx.vs: PTLD expresses B-cell markers (CD20, CD79a) and is frequently EBER-positive, whereas relapsed AML expresses MPO, CD33, CD117, or CD34 without B-cell markers.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid or histiocytic infiltrate (e.g., GVHD-related inflammation)
ddx.vs: Reactive infiltrates are polymorphous with mixed T cells and macrophages rather than monotonous sheets of a single immature myeloid immunophenotype.
Morphology and immunophenotype are identical to recipient relapse, so separation requires chimerism analysis and cytogenetic/molecular comparison with the original leukemia.
